                                        class="btn btn-link btn-sm px-1 py-0 text-decoration-none text-danger delete-address-button">

                                        Xóa

                                    </button>


                                </form>


                            </div>


                        </div>

                    </div>


                </c:forEach>


                <p
                    id="addressListEmpty"
                    class="text-muted mb-0"
                    style="${empty addresses ? '' : 'display:none;'}">

                    Chưa có địa chỉ giao hàng.

                </p>


            </div>


            <form
                id="editAddressForm"
                class="d-none"
                method="post"
                action="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/checkout">


                <div class="modal-body">


                    <h6 class="fw-bold">

                        Chỉnh sửa địa chỉ

                    </h6>


                    <input
                        type="hidden"
                        id="editAddressId"
                        name="addressId">


                    <input
                        type="hidden"
                        name="action"
                        value="editAddress">


                    <input
                        type="hidden"
                        name="addressActionToken"
                        value="<c:out value='${sessionScope.addressActionToken}'/>">


                    <div class="mb-3">

                        <label
                            for="editRecipientName"
                            class="form-label">

                            Tên người nhận

                        </label>


                        <input
                            id="editRecipientName"
                            name="recipientName"
                            class="form-control"
                            type="text"
                            maxlength="100"
                            required>

                    </div>


                    <div class="mb-3">

                        <label
                            for="editPhoneNumber"
                            class="form-label">

                            Số điện thoại

                        </label>


                        <input
                            id="editPhoneNumber"
                            name="phoneNumber"
                            class="form-control"
                            type="tel"
                            pattern="[0-9]{9,11}"
                            maxlength="11"
                            required>

                    </div>


                    <div class="mb-3">

                        <label
                            for="editAddressLine"
                            class="form-label">

                            Địa chỉ chi tiết

                        </label>


                        <textarea
                            id="editAddressLine"
                            name="addressLine"
                            class="form-control"
                            rows="3"
                            required></textarea>

                    </div>


                </div>


                <div class="modal-footer">

                    <button
                        id="cancelEditAddressButton"
                        type="button"
                        class="btn btn-outline-secondary">

                        Hủy chỉnh sửa

                    </button>


                    <button
                        id="saveEditAddressButton"
                        type="submit"
                        class="btn btn-primary">

                        Lưu thay đổi

                    </button>

                </div>


            </form>


            <div
                class="modal-footer"
                id="addressListFooter">


                <button
                    type="button"
                    class="btn btn-outline-secondary"
                    data-bs-dismiss="modal">

                    Đóng

                </button>


                <button
                    type="button"
                    id="confirmAddressButton"
                    class="btn btn-primary"
                    ${empty addresses ? 'disabled' : ''}>

                    Xác nhận địa chỉ

                </button>


            </div>


        </div>

    </div>

</div>



<div
    class="modal fade"
    id="addAddressModal"
    tabindex="-1"
    aria-hidden="true">


    <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">

        <div class="modal-content rounded-4">


            <form
                id="addAddressForm"
                action="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/checkout"
                method="post">


                <div class="modal-header">

                    <h5 class="modal-title fw-bold">

                        Thêm địa chỉ giao hàng

                    </h5>


                    <button
                        type="button"
                        class="btn-close"
                        data-bs-dismiss="modal">
                    </button>

                </div>


                <div class="modal-body">


                    <input
                        type="hidden"
                        name="action"
                        value="addAddress">


                    <input
                        type="hidden"
                        name="addressAddToken"
                        value="<c:out value='${sessionScope.addressAddToken}'/>">


                    <div class="mb-3">

                        <label class="form-label">

                            Tên người nhận

                        </label>


                        <input
                            type="text"
                            name="recipientName"
                            class="form-control"
                            maxlength="100"
                            required>

                    </div>


                    <div class="mb-3">

                        <label class="form-label">

                            Số điện thoại

                        </label>


                        <input
                            type="tel"
                            name="phoneNumber"
                            class="form-control"
                            pattern="[0-9]{9,11}"
                            maxlength="11"
                            required>

                    </div>


                    <div class="mb-3">

                        <label class="form-label">

                            Địa chỉ chi tiết

                        </label>


                        <textarea
                            name="addressLine"
                            class="form-control"
                            rows="3"
                            required></textarea>

                    </div>


                </div>


                <div class="modal-footer">


                    <button
                        type="button"
                        class="btn btn-outline-secondary"
                        data-bs-dismiss="modal">

                        Hủy

                    </button>


                    <button
                        type="submit"
                        id="saveAddressButton"
                        class="btn btn-primary">

                        Lưu địa chỉ

                    </button>


                </div>


            </form>


        </div>

    </div>

</div>


<script>

    document.addEventListener(
            "DOMContentLoaded",
            function () {

                const checkoutUrl =
                        "${pageContext.request.contextPath}/checkout";


                const addressActionToken =
                        "${sessionScope.addressActionToken}";



                const addressInput =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "orderAddressId"
                                );


                const selectedCard =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "selectedAddressCard"
                                );


                const selectedName =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "selectedAddressName"
                                );


                const selectedLine =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "selectedAddressLine"
                                );


                const selectedDefaultBadge =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "selectedDefaultBadge"
                                );


                const noAddressMessage =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "noAddressMessage"
                                );


                const needAddressMessage =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "needAddressMessage"
                                );


                const addressList =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addressList"
                                );


                const addressListEmpty =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addressListEmpty"
                                );


                const openAddressModalButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "openAddressModalButton"
                                );


                const confirmAddressButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "confirmAddressButton"
                                );


                const placeOrderButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "placeOrderButton"
                                );


                const modalMessage =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addressModalMessage"
                                );


                const addressModal =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addressModal"
                                );


                const addressListFooter =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addressListFooter"
                                );



                const editAddressForm =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "editAddressForm"
                                );


                const editAddressId =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "editAddressId"
                                );


                const editRecipientName =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "editRecipientName"
                                );


                const editPhoneNumber =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "editPhoneNumber"
                                );


                const editAddressLine =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "editAddressLine"
                                );


                const saveEditAddressButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "saveEditAddressButton"
                                );


                const cancelEditAddressButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "cancelEditAddressButton"
                                );


                let committedAddressId =
                        addressInput
                        ? addressInput.value
                        : "";


                let addressRequestBusy =
                        false;


                let editingOption =
                        null;



                function showModalMessage(
                        message,
                        success
                        ) {

                    if (!modalMessage) {
                        return;
                    }


                    modalMessage.textContent =
                            message;


                    modalMessage.className =
                            success
                            ? "alert alert-success mx-3 mt-3 mb-0"
                            : "alert alert-danger mx-3 mt-3 mb-0";
                }



                async function postAddressAction(
                        data
                        ) {

                    const response =
                            await fetch(
                                    checkoutUrl,
                                    {
                                        method: "POST",

                                        credentials:
                                                "same-origin",

                                        headers: {

                                            "Accept":
                                                    "application/json",

                                            "Content-Type":
                                                    "application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8"
                                        },

                                        body:
                                                new URLSearchParams(
                                                        data
                                                        ).toString()
                                    }
                            );


                    let result;


                    try {

                        result =
                                await response.json();

                    } catch (e) {

                        throw new Error(
                                "Phản hồi từ server không hợp lệ."
                                );
                    }


                    if (!response.ok
                            || !result.success) {

                        throw new Error(
                                result.message
                                || "Không thể thực hiện thao tác."
                                );
                    }


                    return result;
                }



                function getOptions() {

                    if (!addressList) {
                        return [];
                    }


                    return Array.from(
                            addressList.querySelectorAll(
                                    ".address-option"
                                    )
                            );
                }


                function updateAddressListState() {

                    const options =
                            getOptions();


                    if (addressListEmpty) {

                        addressListEmpty.style.display =
                                options.length === 0
                                ? ""
                                : "none";
                    }


                    if (openAddressModalButton) {

                        openAddressModalButton.disabled =
                                options.length === 0;
                    }


                    if (confirmAddressButton) {

                        confirmAddressButton.disabled =
                                options.length === 0;
                    }
                }



                function updateDeleteButtons() {

                    getOptions().forEach(
                            function (option) {

                                const id =
                                        option.dataset
                                        .addressId;


                                const button =
                                        option.querySelector(
                                                ".delete-address-button"
                                                );


                                if (!button) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                button.disabled =
                                        addressRequestBusy
                                        || id === committedAddressId;
                            }
                    );
                }



                function updateSelectedAddress(
                        address,
                        setDefaultBadge
                        ) {

                    if (!address) {
                        return;
                    }


                    committedAddressId =
                            String(
                                    address.addressId
                                    );


                    if (addressInput) {

                        addressInput.value =
                                committedAddressId;
                    }


                    if (selectedName) {

                        selectedName.textContent =
                                address.recipientName
                                + " | "
                                + address.phoneNumber;
                    }


                    if (selectedLine) {

                        selectedLine.textContent =
                                address.addressLine;
                    }


                    if (selectedCard) {

                        selectedCard.style.display =
                                "";
                    }


                    if (noAddressMessage) {

                        noAddressMessage.style.display =
                                "none";
                    }


                    if (needAddressMessage) {

                        needAddressMessage.style.display =
                                "none";
                    }


                    if (placeOrderButton) {

                        placeOrderButton.disabled =
                                false;
                    }


                    if (selectedDefaultBadge) {

                        selectedDefaultBadge.style.display =
                                setDefaultBadge
                                && address.defaultAddress
                                ? ""
                                : "none";
                    }


                    updateDeleteButtons();
                }



                function closeEditMode() {

                    editingOption =
                            null;


                    if (editAddressForm) {

                        editAddressForm.reset();

                        editAddressForm.classList.add(
                                "d-none"
                                );
                    }


                    if (addressList) {

                        addressList.classList.remove(
                                "d-none"
                                );
                    }


                    if (addressListFooter) {

                        addressListFooter.classList.remove(
                                "d-none"
                                );
                    }


                    if (modalMessage) {

                        modalMessage.className =
                                "alert mx-3 mt-3 mb-0 d-none";
                    }
                }



                if (addressList) {

                    addressList.addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            function (event) {

                                const button =
                                        event.target.closest(
                                                ".edit-address-button"
                                                );


                                if (!button
                                        || addressRequestBusy) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                editingOption =
                                        button.closest(
                                                ".address-option"
                                                );


                                if (!editingOption) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                editAddressId.value =
                                        editingOption.dataset
                                        .addressId;


                                editRecipientName.value =
                                        editingOption
                                        .querySelector(
                                                ".address-recipient"
                                                )
                                        .textContent
                                        .trim();


                                editPhoneNumber.value =
                                        editingOption
                                        .querySelector(
                                                ".address-phone"
                                                )
                                        .textContent
                                        .trim();


                                editAddressLine.value =
                                        editingOption
                                        .querySelector(
                                                ".address-line"
                                                )
                                        .textContent
                                        .trim();


                                addressList.classList.add(
                                        "d-none"
                                        );


                                addressListFooter.classList.add(
                                        "d-none"
                                        );


                                editAddressForm.classList.remove(
                                        "d-none"
                                        );
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (cancelEditAddressButton) {

                    cancelEditAddressButton.addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            function () {

                                closeEditMode();
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (editAddressForm) {

                    editAddressForm.addEventListener(
                            "submit",
                            async function (event) {

                                event.preventDefault();


                                if (addressRequestBusy) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                editRecipientName.value =
                                        editRecipientName.value
                                        .trim();


                                editPhoneNumber.value =
                                        editPhoneNumber.value
                                        .trim();


                                editAddressLine.value =
                                        editAddressLine.value
                                        .trim();


                                if (!editAddressForm
                                        .reportValidity()) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                addressRequestBusy =
                                        true;


                                saveEditAddressButton.disabled =
                                        true;


                                saveEditAddressButton.textContent =
                                        "Đang lưu...";


                                updateDeleteButtons();


                                try {

                                    const result =
                                            await postAddressAction(
                                                    {
                                                        action:
                                                                "editAddress",

                                                        addressId:
                                                                editAddressId.value,

                                                        recipientName:
                                                                editRecipientName.value,

                                                        phoneNumber:
                                                                editPhoneNumber.value,

                                                        addressLine:
                                                                editAddressLine.value,

                                                        addressActionToken:
                                                                addressActionToken
                                                    }
                                            );


                                    const address =
                                            result.address;


                                    editingOption
                                            .querySelector(
                                                    ".address-recipient"
                                                    )
                                            .textContent =
                                            address.recipientName;


                                    editingOption
                                            .querySelector(
                                                    ".address-phone"
                                                    )
                                            .textContent =
                                            address.phoneNumber;


                                    editingOption
                                            .querySelector(
                                                    ".address-line"
                                                    )
                                            .textContent =
                                            address.addressLine;

                                    if (String(
                                            address.addressId
                                            ) === committedAddressId) {

                                        updateSelectedAddress(
                                                address,
                                                false
                                                );
                                    }


                                    closeEditMode();


                                    showModalMessage(
                                            "Đã cập nhật địa chỉ.",
                                            true
                                            );


                                } catch (error) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            error.message,
                                            false
                                            );


                                } finally {

                                    addressRequestBusy =
                                            false;


                                    saveEditAddressButton.disabled =
                                            false;


                                    saveEditAddressButton.textContent =
                                            "Lưu thay đổi";


                                    updateDeleteButtons();
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }


                if (addressModal) {

                    addressModal.addEventListener(
                            "show.bs.modal",
                            function () {

                                closeEditMode();


                                if (addressList) {

                                    addressList
                                            .querySelectorAll(
                                                    'input[name="modalAddressId"]'
                                                    )
                                            .forEach(
                                                    function (radio) {

                                                        radio.checked =
                                                                radio.value
                                                                === committedAddressId;
                                                    }
                                            );


                                    const currentOption =
                                            getOptions()
                                            .find(
                                                    function (option) {

                                                        return option.dataset
                                                                .addressId
                                                                === committedAddressId;
                                                    }
                                            );


                                    if (currentOption) {

                                        addressList.prepend(
                                                currentOption
                                                );
                                    }
                                }


                                updateDeleteButtons();
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (addressList) {

                    addressList.addEventListener(
                            "change",
                            function (event) {

                                if (event.target.matches(
                                        'input[name="modalAddressId"]'
                                        )) {

                                    updateDeleteButtons();
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (confirmAddressButton) {

                    confirmAddressButton.addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            async function () {

                                if (addressRequestBusy
                                        || !addressList) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                const selectedRadio =
                                        addressList
                                        .querySelector(
                                                'input[name="modalAddressId"]:checked'
                                                );


                                if (!selectedRadio) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            "Vui lòng chọn địa chỉ giao hàng.",
                                            false
                                            );

                                    return;
                                }


                                const id =
                                        selectedRadio.value;


                                addressRequestBusy =
                                        true;


                                updateDeleteButtons();


                                try {

                                    const result =
                                            await postAddressAction(
                                                    {
                                                        action:
                                                                "selectAddress",

                                                        addressId:
                                                                id,

                                                        addressActionToken:
                                                                addressActionToken
                                                    }
                                            );


                                    const option =
                                            selectedRadio
                                            .closest(
                                                    ".address-option"
                                                    );


                                    updateSelectedAddress(
                                            result.selectedAddress,
                                            true
                                            );


                                    if (option) {

                                        addressList.prepend(
                                                option
                                                );
                                    }


                                    bootstrap.Modal
                                            .getOrCreateInstance(
                                                    addressModal
                                                    )
                                            .hide();


                                } catch (error) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            error.message,
                                            false
                                            );


                                } finally {

                                    addressRequestBusy =
                                            false;


                                    updateDeleteButtons();
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (addressList) {

                    addressList.addEventListener(
                            "submit",
                            async function (event) {

                                const form =
                                        event.target.closest(
                                                ".delete-address-form"
                                                );


                                if (!form) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                event.preventDefault();


                                if (addressRequestBusy) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                const option =
                                        form.closest(
                                                ".address-option"
                                                );


                                if (!option) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                const id =
                                        option.dataset
                                        .addressId;


                                if (id === committedAddressId) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            "Không thể xóa địa chỉ đang sử dụng. "
                                            + "Vui lòng xác nhận địa chỉ khác trước.",
                                            false
                                            );

                                    return;
                                }


                                if (!window.confirm(
                                        "Bạn chắc chắn muốn xóa địa chỉ này?"
                                        )) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                addressRequestBusy =
                                        true;


                                updateDeleteButtons();


                                try {

                                    await postAddressAction(
                                            {
                                                action:
                                                        "deleteAddress",

                                                addressId:
                                                        id,

                                                addressActionToken:
                                                        addressActionToken
                                            }
                                    );


                                    option.remove();


                                    updateAddressListState();


                                    showModalMessage(
                                            "Đã xóa địa chỉ thành công.",
                                            true
                                            );


                                } catch (error) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            error.message,
                                            false
                                            );


                                } finally {

                                    addressRequestBusy =
                                            false;


                                    updateDeleteButtons();
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }



                const addAddressForm =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addAddressForm"
                                );


                const saveAddressButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "saveAddressButton"
                                );


                if (addAddressForm) {

                    addAddressForm.addEventListener(
                            "submit",
                            function (event) {

                                if (addAddressForm
                                        .dataset
                                        .submitting
                                        === "true") {

                                    event.preventDefault();

                                    return;
                                }


                                if (!addAddressForm
                                        .checkValidity()) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                addAddressForm
                                        .dataset
                                        .submitting =
                                        "true";


                                if (saveAddressButton) {

                                    saveAddressButton.disabled =
                                            true;


                                    saveAddressButton.textContent =
                                            "Đang lưu...";
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }


                const orderForm =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "orderForm"
                                );


                if (orderForm) {

                    orderForm.addEventListener(
                            "submit",
                            function (event) {

                                if (orderForm
                                        .dataset
                                        .submitting
                                        === "true") {

                                    event.preventDefault();

                                    return;
                                }


                                if (!orderForm
                                        .checkValidity()) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                orderForm
                                        .dataset
                                        .submitting =
                                        "true";


                                if (placeOrderButton) {

                                    placeOrderButton.disabled =
                                            true;


                                    placeOrderButton.textContent =
                                            "Đang xử lý đơn hàng...";
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }


                updateAddressListState();

                updateDeleteButtons();

            }
    );

</script>

<%@ include file="/WEB-INF/include/header.jsp" %>

<div class="row justify-content-center my-4">
    <div class="col-lg-8">

        <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm rounded-4">
            <div class="card-body p-4 p-md-5">

                <div class="text-center mb-4">
                    <i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill text-success display-4"></i>

                    <h3 class="fw-bold mt-3">
                        Đơn hàng đã được ghi nhận
                    </h3>

                    <p class="text-muted mb-0">
                        Cảm ơn bạn đã mua sắm tại OECS.
                    </p>
                </div>

                <div class="alert alert-success text-center">
                    Mã đơn hàng:
                    <strong>
                        #<c:out value="${order.orderId}" />
                    </strong>
                </div>

                <h5 class="fw-bold mb-3">
                    Thông tin giao hàng
                </h5>

                <p class="mb-1">
                    <strong>
                        <c:out value="${order.recipientName}" />
                    </strong>

                    |

                    <c:out value="${order.recipientPhone}" />
                </p>

                <p class="text-muted">
                    <c:out value="${order.shippingAddress}" />
                </p>

                <p class="text-muted small mb-0">
                    Ngày đặt:
                    <fmt:formatDate
                        value="${order.createdAt}"
                        pattern="dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm" />
                </p>

                <hr class="my-4">

                <h5 class="fw-bold mb-3">
                    Thông tin thanh toán
                </h5>

                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between mb-2">
                    <span>Tiền hàng</span>

                    <span>
                        <fmt:formatNumber
                            value="${order.totalAmount + order.discountAmount - order.shippingFee}"
                            type="number"
                            maxFractionDigits="0" />đ
                    </span>
                </div>

                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between mb-2">
                    <span>Phí vận chuyển</span>

                    <span>
                        <fmt:formatNumber
                            value="${order.shippingFee}"
                            type="number"
                            maxFractionDigits="0" />đ
                    </span>
                </div>

                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between mb-3">
                    <span>Giảm giá</span>

                    <span class="text-success">
                        -<fmt:formatNumber
                            value="${order.discountAmount}"
                            type="number"
                            maxFractionDigits="0" />đ
                    </span>
                </div>

                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center border-top pt-3 mb-3">
                    <strong>Tổng thanh toán</strong>

                    <strong class="text-danger fs-4">
                        <fmt:formatNumber
                            value="${order.totalAmount}"
                            type="number"

<script>
    function closeCustomerToast(button) {
        const toast = button.closest(".customer-toast");

        if (toast) {
            toast.classList.add("hide");

            setTimeout(function () {
                toast.remove();
            }, 250);
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        document.querySelectorAll(".customer-toast").forEach(function (toast) {
            setTimeout(function () {
                if (toast.isConnected) {
                    toast.classList.add("hide");

                    setTimeout(function () {
                        toast.remove();
                    }, 250);
                }
            }, 4000);
        });
    });


    const cancelDialog = document.getElementById("cancelModal");
    if (cancelDialog) {
        cancelDialog.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
            if (event.target === cancelDialog) {
                cancelDialog.close();
            }
        });

        cancelDialog.querySelector("form").addEventListener("submit", function () {
            this.querySelector('button[type="submit"]').disabled = true;
        });

        if (window.location.hash === "#cancel-order") {
            cancelDialog.showModal();
        }
    }
</script>

                        </c:otherwise>

    <c:if test="${pageCount > 1}">

            <c:if test="${currentPage > 1}">

            </c:if>

            <span>

            <c:if test="${currentPage < pageCount}">
                <c:url var="nextUrl" value="/my-orders">
                    <c:param name="status" value="${activeTab}" />
                    <c:param name="q" value="${query}" />
                    <c:param name="page" value="${currentPage + 1}" />
                </c:url>

                <a class="ph-secondary"
                   href="<c:out value='${nextUrl}' />">
                    Trang sau
                    <i class="bi bi-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                </a>
            </c:if>
        </nav>
    </c:if>

<script>
    (function () {


        document.querySelectorAll(
            ".return-form-page .notification"
        ).forEach(function (message) {

            setTimeout(function () {

                message.classList.add(
                    "notification-hide"
                );

                setTimeout(function () {
                    message.remove();
                }, 300);

            }, 3500);

        });


        function showValidationToast(message) {

            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".return-form-page .validation-toast"
            ).forEach(function (toast) {
                toast.remove();
            });

            const container = document.querySelector(
                ".return-form-page"
            );

            if (!container) {
                return;
            }

            const toast = document.createElement("div");

            toast.className = "validation-toast";
            toast.setAttribute("role", "alert");

            const icon = document.createElement("span");
            icon.className = "notification-icon";
            icon.textContent = "!";

            const text = document.createElement("span");
            text.textContent = message;

            toast.appendChild(icon);
            toast.appendChild(text);

            container.appendChild(toast);

            setTimeout(function () {

                toast.classList.add(
                    "notification-hide"
                );

                setTimeout(function () {
                    toast.remove();
                }, 300);

            }, 3500);
        }


        const form = document.getElementById(
            "returnExchangeForm"
        );

        if (!form) {
            return;
        }

        form.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            function (event) {

                const selectedItems = form.querySelectorAll(
                    ".item-checkbox:checked"
                );

                if (selectedItems.length === 0) {

                    event.preventDefault();

                    showValidationToast(
                        "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một sản phẩm muốn trả."
                    );

                    return;
                }

                for (const checkbox of selectedItems) {

                    const orderItemId = checkbox.value;

                    const quantityInput =
                        document.getElementById(
                            "quantity_" + orderItemId
                        );

                    if (!quantityInput) {

                        event.preventDefault();

                        showValidationToast(
                            "Không tìm thấy số lượng của sản phẩm được chọn."
                        );

                        return;
                    }

                    const quantity =
                        Number(quantityInput.value);

                    const maxQuantity =
                        Number(quantityInput.max);

                    if (!Number.isInteger(quantity)
                            || quantity < 1
                            || quantity > maxQuantity) {

                        event.preventDefault();

                        showValidationToast(
                            "Số lượng muốn trả phải từ 1 đến "
                            + maxQuantity + "."
                        );

                        quantityInput.focus();

                        return;
                    }
                }

                const reasonInput =
                    document.getElementById("reason");

                const reason = reasonInput
                        ? reasonInput.value.trim()
                        : "";

                if (reason.length === 0) {

                    event.preventDefault();

                    showValidationToast(
                        "Vui lòng nhập lý do trả hàng."
                    );

                    if (reasonInput) {
                        reasonInput.focus();
                    }

                    return;
                }

                if (reason.length > 1000) {

                    event.preventDefault();

                    showValidationToast(
                        "Lý do trả hàng không được vượt quá 1000 ký tự."
                    );

                    return;
                }

            }
        );

    })();
</script>

        <script>
            function escapeHTML(str) {
                if (!str)
                    return '';
                return String(str).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, function (tag) {
                    const charsToReplace = {
                        '&': '&amp;',
                        '<': '&lt;',
                        '>': '&gt;',
                        "'": '&#39;',
                        '"': '&quot;'
                    };
                    return charsToReplace[tag] || tag;
                });
            }

            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
                const searchInput = document.getElementById('headerSearchInput');
                const searchSuggestions = document.getElementById('searchSuggestions');
                let timeoutId = null;

                searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
                    const keyword = this.value.trim();
                    clearTimeout(timeoutId);

                    if (keyword.length < 2) {
                        searchSuggestions.classList.add('d-none');
                        return;
                    }

                    timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                        fetch(`${pageContext.request.contextPath}/api/search?q=` + encodeURIComponent(keyword))
                                .then(response => response.json())
                                .then(data => {
                                    searchSuggestions.innerHTML = '';

                                    if (data.length === 0) {
                                        searchSuggestions.innerHTML = '<div class="suggestion-empty">Không tìm thấy sản phẩm nào!</div>';
                                    } else {
                                        data.forEach(item => {
                                            const priceStr = item.price > 0
                                                    ? new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(item.price) + ' ₫'
                                                    : 'Liên hệ';

                                            const safeName = escapeHTML(item.name);

                                            let imageHtml = '';
                                            if (item.imageUrl && item.imageUrl.trim() !== '') {
                                                const safeImgUrl = escapeHTML(item.imageUrl);
                                                imageHtml = `<img src="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/\${safeImgUrl}" alt="\${safeName}" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 4px;">`;
                                            } else {
                                                imageHtml = `<i class="bi bi-box-seam fs-5 text-secondary"></i>`;
                                            }

                                            const html = `
                                <a href="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/shop?action=detail&id=\${item.id}" class="suggestion-item">
                                    <div class="suggestion-img d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center bg-light border p-1">
                                        \${imageHtml}
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="suggestion-info">
                                        <span class="suggestion-name">\${safeName}</span>
                                        <span class="suggestion-price">\${priceStr}</span>
                                    </div>
                                </a>
                                `;
                                            searchSuggestions.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
                                        });
                                    }
                                    searchSuggestions.classList.remove('d-none');
                                })
                                .catch(err => console.error("Lỗi search API:", err));
                    }, 300);
                });

                document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                    if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !searchSuggestions.contains(e.target)) {
                        searchSuggestions.classList.add('d-none');
                    }
                });

                document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'k') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        searchInput.focus();
                    }
                });
            });
        </script>
        <c:if test="${not empty sessionScope.loggedInUser
                      and sessionScope.loggedInUser.customer}">
              <script>
                  (() => {
                      const contextPath = '${pageContext.request.contextPath}';
                      const bell = document.getElementById('notificationBell');
                      const panel = document.getElementById('notificationPanel');
                      const badge = document.getElementById('notificationBadge');
                      const list = document.getElementById('notificationList');
                      const total = document.getElementById('notificationTotal');

                      if (!bell || !panel || !badge || !list)
                          return;

                      async function loadCount() {
                          try {
                              const response = await fetch(
                                      contextPath + '/notification?action=count',
                                      {credentials: 'same-origin'}
                              );

                              if (!response.ok)
                                  return;

                              const data = await response.json();
                              const count = Number(data.count) || 0;

                              badge.textContent = count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
                              badge.hidden = count === 0;
                              total.textContent = count > 0 ? count + ' chưa đọc' : '';
                          } catch (error) {
                              console.error('Cannot load notification count.', error);
                          }
                      }

                      async function loadList() {
                          list.replaceChildren();

                          const loading = document.createElement('p');
                          loading.className = 'notification-empty';
                          loading.textContent = 'Đang tải thông báo...';
                          list.appendChild(loading);

                          try {
                              const response = await fetch(
                                      contextPath + '/notification?action=list',
                                      {credentials: 'same-origin'}
                              );

                              if (!response.ok) {
                                  throw new Error('Không thể tải thông báo.');
                              }

                              const notifications = await response.json();
                              list.replaceChildren();

                              if (notifications.length === 0) {
                                  const empty = document.createElement('p');
                                  empty.className = 'notification-empty';
                                  empty.textContent = 'Bạn chưa có thông báo nào.';
                                  list.appendChild(empty);
                                  total.textContent = '';
                                  return;
                              }

                              await loadCount();

                              notifications.forEach(n => {
                                  const item = document.createElement('button');
                                  item.type = 'button';
                                  item.className = 'notification-item'
                                          + (n.read ? '' : ' unread');

                                  const title = document.createElement('span');
                                  title.className = 'notification-item-title';
                                  title.textContent = n.title || 'Thông báo';

                                  const message = document.createElement('span');
                                  message.className = 'notification-item-message';
                                  message.textContent = n.message || '';

                                  const time = document.createElement('span');
                                  time.className = 'notification-item-time';
                                  time.textContent = n.createdAt || '';

                                  item.append(title, message, time);

                                  item.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                                      try {
                                          const body = new URLSearchParams({
                                              action: 'read',
                                              id: String(n.id)
                                          });

                                          const readResponse = await fetch(
                                                  contextPath + '/notification',
                                                  {
                                                      method: 'POST',
                                                      credentials: 'same-origin',
                                                      headers: {
                                                          'Content-Type':
                                                                  'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                                                      },
                                                      body: body.toString()
                                                  }
                                          );

                                          if (!readResponse.ok) {
                                              throw new Error(
                                                      'Không thể cập nhật trạng thái đã đọc.'
                                                      );
                                          }

                                          await loadCount();

                                          if (n.orderId != null) {
                                              window.location.href =
                                                      contextPath + '/my-orders/detail?id='
                                                      + encodeURIComponent(n.orderId);
                                          } else {
                                              await loadList();
                                          }
                                      } catch (error) {
                                          console.error(error);
                                      }
                                  });

                                  list.appendChild(item);
                              });
                          } catch (error) {
                              list.replaceChildren();

                              const failed = document.createElement('p');
                              failed.className = 'notification-empty';
                              failed.textContent = 'Không tải được thông báo. Vui lòng thử lại.';
                              list.appendChild(failed);

                              console.error(error);
                          }
                      }

                      bell.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                          const isOpening = panel.hidden;
                          panel.hidden = !isOpening;
                          bell.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isOpening));

                          if (isOpening) {
                              await loadList();
                              await loadCount();
                          }
                      });

                      document.addEventListener('click', event => {
                          if (!event.target.closest('.notification-wrapper')) {
                              panel.hidden = true;
                              bell.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                          }
                      });

                      loadCount();
                  })();
              </script>
        </c:if>

                                                        <input name="quantity" type="number" class="form-control form-control-sm"
                                                               min="0" max="2147483647" step="1" required value="1"
                                                               aria-label="Số lượng hoặc số tồn mục tiêu">
                                                        <input name="note" type="text" class="form-control form-control-sm"
                                                               maxlength="500" required placeholder="Lý do (bắt buộc)"
                                                               aria-label="Lý do thay đổi tồn kho">
                                                        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" type="submit">Lưu</button>
                                                    </form>
                                                    <small class="text-muted">Kiểm kê = đặt số tồn đúng bằng số nhập.</small>
                                                </c:when>
                                                <c:otherwise>
                                                    <span class="text-muted small">Không thể chỉnh khi ngừng bán.</span>
                                                </c:otherwise>
                                            </c:choose>
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                </c:forEach>
                            </c:when>
                            <c:otherwise>
                                <tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-muted py-5">
                                        Không tìm thấy SKU phù hợp.
                                    </td></tr>
                                </c:otherwise>
                            </c:choose>
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>

            <div class="d-flex justify-content-end align-items-center gap-2 px-3 px-md-4 py-3 border-top">
                <c:if test="${pageNumber gt 1}">
                    <a class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm"
                       href="${fn:escapeXml(prevPageUrl)}">Trang trước</a>
                </c:if>
                <span class="small text-muted"><c:out value="${pageNumber}"/> / <c:out value="${totalPages}"/></span>
                <c:if test="${pageNumber lt totalPages}">
                    <a class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm"
                       href="${fn:escapeXml(nextPageUrl)}">Trang sau</a>
                </c:if>
            </div>
        </section>

            <div class="inventory-panel-header">
                <h2 id="movementTitle" class="h5 fw-bold mb-1">Lịch sử biến động kho gần đây</h2>

                        </tr>

                                            <fmt:formatDate value="${m.createdAt}" pattern="dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss"/>
                                        </td>

                                        </td>
                                        <td>
                                            <c:choose>
                                                <c:when test="${m.movementType eq 'IN'}">Nhập kho</c:when>
                                                <c:when test="${m.movementType eq 'OUT'}">Xuất kho</c:when>
                                                <c:when test="${m.movementType eq 'SET'}">Kiểm kê</c:when>
                                                <c:when test="${m.movementType eq 'OPENING'}">Số dư đầu</c:when>
                                                <c:otherwise>Hệ thống</c:otherwise>
                                            </c:choose>
                                        </td>
                                        <td>
                                            <span class="${m.quantityDelta ge 0 ? 'inventory-positive' : 'inventory-negative'}">
                                                <c:if test="${m.quantityDelta gt 0}">+</c:if><c:out value="${m.quantityDelta}"/>
                                                </span>
                                            </td>
                                            <td><c:out value="${m.quantityBefore}"/> → <c:out value="${m.quantityAfter}"/></td>
                                        <td style="max-width:280px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;">
                                            <c:out value="${m.note}"/>
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                </c:forEach>
                            </c:when>
                            <c:otherwise>
                                <tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center text-muted py-4">
                                        Chưa có lịch sử biến động tồn kho.
                                    </td></tr>
                                </c:otherwise>
                            </c:choose>
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </section>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

        const categorySelect =
                document.getElementById("categoryId");

        const productForm =
                document.getElementById("createProductForm");

        const imageInput =
                document.getElementById("imageFile");

        const galleryInput =
                document.getElementById("galleryFiles");

        const imagePreview =
                document.getElementById("imagePreview");

        const previewImage =
                document.getElementById("previewImage");

        const galleryPreview =
                document.getElementById("galleryPreview");

     

        let lastCategoryId = categorySelect.value;

        categorySelect.addEventListener("change", function () {

            const categoryId = this.value;

            const nameInput = document.getElementById("productName");
            const descriptionInput = document.getElementById("description");
            const modelInput = document.getElementById("modelCode");
            const brandInput = document.getElementById("brandId");

            const hasEnteredData =
                    nameInput.value.trim() !== ""
                    || descriptionInput.value.trim() !== ""
                    || modelInput.value.trim() !== ""
                    || brandInput.value !== ""
                    || imageInput.files.length > 0
                    || galleryInput.files.length > 0;

            if (hasEnteredData) {

                const confirmed = confirm(
                        "Thay đổi danh mục sẽ tải lại trang " +
                        "và làm mất dữ liệu chưa lưu. Tiếp tục?"
                        );

                if (!confirmed) {
                    categorySelect.value = lastCategoryId;
                    return;
                }
            }

            const baseUrl =
                    "${pageContext.request.contextPath}/product?view=create";

            if (categoryId) {
                window.location.href =
                        baseUrl + "&categoryId=" +
                        encodeURIComponent(categoryId);
            } else {
                window.location.href = baseUrl;
            }
        });

      

        let imagePreviewUrl = null;

        imageInput.addEventListener("change", function () {

            if (imagePreviewUrl) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(imagePreviewUrl);
                imagePreviewUrl = null;
            }

            const file = this.files[0];

            if (!file) {
                imagePreview.classList.add("d-none");
                previewImage.removeAttribute("src");
                return;
            }

            imagePreviewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);

            previewImage.src = imagePreviewUrl;
            imagePreview.classList.remove("d-none");
        });


        let galleryPreviewUrls = [];

        galleryInput.addEventListener("change", function () {

            galleryPreviewUrls.forEach(function (url) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            });

            galleryPreviewUrls = [];
            galleryPreview.replaceChildren();

            Array.from(this.files).forEach(function (file) {

                const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
                galleryPreviewUrls.push(url);

                const img = document.createElement("img");

                img.src = url;
                img.alt = "Ảnh gallery";
                img.className = "img-thumbnail";

                img.style.width = "90px";
                img.style.height = "90px";
                img.style.objectFit = "cover";

                galleryPreview.appendChild(img);
            });
        });

       

        productForm.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {

            const categoryId = categorySelect.value;

            const selectedCategoryId =
                    "${selectedCategoryId}";

            if (!categoryId
                    || categoryId !== selectedCategoryId) {

                event.preventDefault();

                alert(
                        "Vui lòng chọn danh mục và tải " +
                        "thông số kỹ thuật trước khi lưu."
                        );

                return;
            }

            const saveButton =
                    document.getElementById("saveProductBtn");

            if (productForm.checkValidity()) {

                saveButton.disabled = true;
                saveButton.innerHTML =
                        "Đang lưu sản phẩm...";
            }
        });

        window.addEventListener("pagehide", function () {

            if (imagePreviewUrl) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(imagePreviewUrl);
            }

            galleryPreviewUrls.forEach(function (url) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            });
        });
    });
</script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/quill@2.0.3/dist/quill.js"></script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    const editorElement =
        document.getElementById("descriptionEditor");

    const description =
        document.getElementById("description");

    if (!editorElement || !description) {
        return;
    }

    if (typeof Quill === "undefined") {
        console.error("Khong tai duoc Quill Editor.");
        return;
    }

    editorElement.style.display = "block";

    try {
        const quill = new Quill("#descriptionEditor", {
            theme: "snow",
            placeholder: "Nhập mô tả sản phẩm...",
            modules: {
                toolbar: [
                    [{ header: [2, 3, false] }],
                    ["bold", "italic", "underline"],
                    [
                        { list: "ordered" },
                        { list: "bullet" }
                    ],
                    ["link"],
                    ["clean"]
                ]
            },
            formats: [
                "header",
                "bold",
                "italic",
                "underline",
                "list",
                "link"
            ]
        });

        if (description.value.trim()) {
            const delta = quill.clipboard.convert({
                html: description.value
            });

            quill.setContents(delta, "silent");
        }

        description.classList.add("d-none");

        function syncDescription() {
            const text = quill.getText().trim();

            description.value = text
                ? quill.getSemanticHTML()
                : "";
        }

        quill.on("text-change", syncDescription);

        const form = description.closest("form");

        if (form) {
            form.addEventListener(
                "submit",
                syncDescription,
                true
            );
        }

        syncDescription();

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Loi khoi tao Quill:", error);

        editorElement.style.display = "none";
        description.classList.remove("d-none");
    }
});
</script>
