package controller;

import dao.InventoryDAO;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "InventoryServlet", urlPatterns = {"/inventory"})
public class InventoryServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(InventoryServlet.class.getName());
    private static final int PAGE_SIZE = 25;
    private static final String JSP = "/WEB-INF/inventory/list.jsp";

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        User user = authorize(request, response);
        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        String keyword = trim(request.getParameter("keyword"));
        if (keyword.length() > 100) {
            keyword = keyword.substring(0, 100);
        }
        String status = normalizeStatus(request.getParameter("status"));
        int page = positiveInt(request.getParameter("page"), 1);
        page = Math.min(page, 100000);
        InventoryDAO dao = new InventoryDAO();
        try {
            int total = dao.countItems(keyword, status);
            int pages = Math.max(1, (total + PAGE_SIZE - 1) / PAGE_SIZE);
            page = Math.min(page, pages);

            request.setAttribute("items",
                    dao.findItems(keyword, status, page, PAGE_SIZE));
            request.setAttribute("movements", dao.getRecentMovements(40));
            request.setAttribute("keyword", keyword);
            request.setAttribute("status", status);
            request.setAttribute("pageNumber", page);
            request.setAttribute("totalPages", pages);
            request.setAttribute("totalItems", total);
            request.setAttribute("csrfToken", csrfToken(request.getSession()));
            request.getRequestDispatcher(JSP).forward(request, response);
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot load inventory", ex);
            throw new ServletException("Không thể tải dữ liệu tồn kho.", ex);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        User user = authorize(request, response);
        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
        String actual = request.getParameter("csrfToken");
        String expected = (String) session.getAttribute("inventoryCsrfToken");
        if (!constantTimeEquals(expected, actual)) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN, "CSRF token không hợp lệ.");
            return;
        }

        String action = trim(request.getParameter("action"));
        String note = trim(request.getParameter("note"));
        int skuId = positiveInt(request.getParameter("skuId"), -1);
        int quantity = nonnegativeInt(request.getParameter("quantity"));
        try {
            if (skuId <= 0 || quantity < 0) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("SKU hoặc số lượng không hợp lệ.");
            }
            int newStock = new InventoryDAO().changeStock(
                    skuId, action, quantity, note, user.getUserId());
            session.setAttribute("inventorySuccess",
                    "Cập nhật tồn kho thành công. Số tồn mới: " + newStock + ".");
            session.removeAttribute("inventoryError");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | IllegalStateException ex) {
            session.setAttribute("inventoryError", ex.getMessage());
            session.removeAttribute("inventorySuccess");
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Stock update failed", ex);
            session.setAttribute("inventoryError",
                    "Không thể cập nhật tồn kho. Vui lòng kiểm tra log và thử lại.");
            session.removeAttribute("inventorySuccess");
        }
        response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/inventory");
    }

    /**
     * Checks both login and actual database role; do not rely on a URL filter
     * alone.
     */
    private User authorize(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException, ServletException {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
        Object logged = session == null ? null : session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");
        if (!(logged instanceof User)) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return null;
        }
        User user = (User) logged;
        try {
            if (!new InventoryDAO().isAuthorizedStaff(user.getUserId())) {
                response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN,
                        "Chỉ Staff/Admin có thể quản lý tồn kho.");
                return null;
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot check inventory access", ex);
            throw new ServletException("Không thể kiểm tra quyền truy cập kho.", ex);
        }
        return user;
    }

    private static String csrfToken(HttpSession session) {
        String token = (String) session.getAttribute("inventoryCsrfToken");
        if (token == null) {
            token = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
            session.setAttribute("inventoryCsrfToken", token);
        }
        return token;
    }

    private static boolean constantTimeEquals(String first, String second) {
        if (first == null || second == null) {
            return false;
        }
        return MessageDigest.isEqual(
                first.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
                second.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    private static String normalizeStatus(String status) {
        return "LOW".equals(status) || "OUT".equals(status) ? status : "ALL";
    }

    private static String trim(String value) {
        return value == null ? "" : value.trim();
    }

    private static int positiveInt(String value, int fallback) {
        try {
            int number = Integer.parseInt(trim(value));
            return number > 0 ? number : fallback;
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private static int nonnegativeInt(String value) {
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(trim(value));
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.UserDAO;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import service.AuditLogService;

@WebServlet(name = "LoginServlet", urlPatterns = {"/login"})
public class LoginServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(LoginServlet.class.getName());
    private final AuditLogService auditLogService = new AuditLogService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        try {
            
            HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
            if (session != null
                    && session.getAttribute("loggedInUser") != null) {

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/home"
                );

                return;
            }

           
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp").forward(request, response);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi tải trang đăng nhập!", e);
            request.setAttribute("errorMessage", "Có lỗi hệ thống xảy ra. Vui lòng thử lại sau!");
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp").forward(request, response);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        String username = request.getParameter("username");
        String password = request.getParameter("password");

        try {
            
            UserDAO dao = new UserDAO();
            User user = dao.login(username, password);

            if (user == null) {

                auditLogService.log(
                        username,
                        "LOGIN_FAILED",
                        "USER",
                        null,
                        "Invalid username/email or password",
                        request
                );

                request.setAttribute("errorMessage", "Sai tài khoản hoặc mật khẩu.");
                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);
                return;
            }

            if (!user.isActive()) {

                auditLogService.log(
                        user,
                        "LOGIN_FAILED",
                        "USER",
                        (long) user.getUserId(),
                        "Login attempt on locked account",
                        request
                );

                request.setAttribute("errorMessage", "Tài khoản đã bị khóa.");
                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);
                return;
            }

          
            HttpSession session = request.getSession();
            session.setAttribute("loggedInUser", user);
            auditLogService.log(
                    user,
                    "LOGIN_SUCCESS",
                    "USER",
                    (long) user.getUserId(),
                    "User logged in successfully",
                    request
            );

            String redirectUrl = (String) session.getAttribute("redirectUrl");
            if (redirectUrl != null) {
                session.removeAttribute("redirectUrl"); // Xóa sau khi dùng xong
                response.sendRedirect(redirectUrl);
            } else {
                response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/home");
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi trong quá trình xử lý đăng nhập!", e);
            request.setAttribute("errorMessage", "Hệ thống gặp sự cố trong quá trình đăng nhập!");
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp").forward(request, response);
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "LogoutServlet", urlPatterns = {"/logout"})
public class LogoutServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(LogoutServlet.class.getName());

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        processLogout(request, response);
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        processLogout(request, response);
    }

  
    private void processLogout(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {
        try {
            
            HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
            if (session != null) {
                session.invalidate();
            }

           
            HttpSession newSession = request.getSession(true);
            newSession.setAttribute("logoutMessage", "Bạn đã đăng xuất thành công!");

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi xử lý đăng xuất người dùng!", e);
        } finally {
          
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
        }
    }
}package controller;

import dao.NotificationDAO;
import model.Notification;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;

@WebServlet(name = "NotificationServlet", urlPatterns = "/notification")
public class NotificationServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final NotificationDAO notificationDAO =
            new NotificationDAO();

    private User getLoggedInUser(HttpServletRequest request) {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            return null;
        }

        Object user = session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (user instanceof User) {
            return (User) user;
        }

        return null;
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
                         HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED);
            return;
        }

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        int userId = user.getUserId();
        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        response.setContentType("application/json");
        response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        try {
            if ("count".equals(action)) {
                int count = notificationDAO.countUnread(userId);
                response.getWriter().write(
                        "{\"count\":" + count + "}");
            } else if ("list".equals(action)) {
                List<Notification> list =
                        notificationDAO.findLatest(userId);

                StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("[");
                boolean first = true;

                for (Notification n : list) {
                    if (!first) {
                        json.append(",");
                    }
                    first = false;

                    json.append("{")
                        .append("\"id\":").append(n.getNotificationId())
                        .append(",\"orderId\":")
                        .append(n.getOrderId() == null
                                ? "null" : n.getOrderId())
                        .append(",\"title\":\"")
                        .append(escapeJson(n.getTitle()))
                        .append("\",\"message\":\"")
                        .append(escapeJson(n.getMessage()))
                        .append("\",\"read\":")
                        .append(n.isRead())
                        .append(",\"createdAt\":\"")
                        .append(escapeJson(
                                n.getCreatedAt() == null
                                ? "" : n.getFormattedCreatedAt()))
                        .append("\"}");
                }

                json.append("]");
                response.getWriter().write(json.toString());
            } else {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
            }
                } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Cannot load notifications.", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
                          HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED);
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        if (!"read".equals(action)) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
            return;
        }

        try {
            int id = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("id"));

            boolean updated = notificationDAO.markAsRead(
                    id, user.getUserId());

            response.setContentType("application/json");
            response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
            response.getWriter().write(
                    "{\"success\":" + updated + "}");

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
                } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Cannot update notification.", e);
        }
    }

    private String escapeJson(String value) {
        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        return value.replace("\\", "\\\\")
                    .replace("\"", "\\\"")
                    .replace("\n", "\\n")
                    .replace("\r", "\\r")
                    .replace("\t", "\\t");
    }

import dao.OrderDAO;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;

@WebServlet(
        name = "OrderSuccessServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/order-success"}
)
public class OrderSuccessServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(OrderSuccessServlet.class.getName());

    private final OrderDAO orderDAO = new OrderDAO();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        Object loggedInUser = session == null
                ? null
                : session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (!(loggedInUser instanceof User)) {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/login"
            );
            return;
        }

        User user = (User) loggedInUser;

        int orderId;

        try {
            orderId = Integer.parseInt(
                    request.getParameter("id")
            );

            if (orderId <= 0) {
                throw new NumberFormatException();
            }

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        try {
            Order order = orderDAO.findByIdAndUser(
                    orderId,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            if (order == null) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND,
                        "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                );
                return;
            }

            request.setAttribute("order", order);

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/checkout/order-success.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Loi tai thong tin don hang!",
                    e
            );

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                    "Chưa tải được thông tin đơn hàng. Vui lòng thử lại."
            );
        }
    }

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import dao.PaymentDAO;
import payment.PaymentGateway;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "PaymentCallbackServlet",
        urlPatterns = {
            "/payment/vnpay/ipn",
            "/payment/vnpay/return"
        }
)
public class PaymentCallbackServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(
                    PaymentCallbackServlet.class.getName()
            );

    private final PaymentDAO payments = new PaymentDAO();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        String path = request.getServletPath();

        if ("/payment/vnpay/return".equals(path)) {
            showReturnResult(request, response);
            return;
        }

        if (!"/payment/vnpay/ipn".equals(path)) {
            response.setHeader("Allow", "GET");
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED
            );
            return;
        }

        response.setContentType(
                "application/json;charset=UTF-8"
        );

        try {
            Map<String, String> params = new HashMap<>();

            for (Map.Entry<String, String[]> entry
                    : request.getParameterMap().entrySet()) {

                if (entry.getValue().length != 1) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Tham số callback bị trùng."
                    );
                }

                params.put(
                        entry.getKey(),
                        entry.getValue()[0]
                );
            }

            if (!PaymentGateway.verifyVnp(params)) {
                sendVnpResponse(response, "97");
                return;
            }

            String providerCode =
                    params.get("vnp_ResponseCode");

            boolean success =
                    "00".equals(providerCode)
                    && "00".equals(
                            params.get("vnp_TransactionStatus")
                    );

            BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal(
                    params.get("vnp_Amount")
            ).movePointLeft(2);

            String result = payments.settle(
                    "VNPAY",
                    params.get("vnp_TxnRef"),
                    amount,
                    params.get("vnp_TransactionNo"),
                    providerCode,
                    success
            );

            sendVnpResponse(response, result);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "Không xử lý được VNPay IPN.",
                    e
            );

            sendVnpResponse(response, "99");
        }
    }

    private void showReturnResult(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {
        boolean success = false;
        String message = "Chưa xác minh được kết quả thanh toán. "
                + "Vui lòng kiểm tra trạng thái trong Đơn mua trước khi thử lại.";

        try {
            Map<String, String> params = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<String, String[]> entry
                    : request.getParameterMap().entrySet()) {
                if (entry.getValue().length != 1) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Tham số callback bị trùng.");
                }
                params.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue()[0]);
            }

            if (PaymentGateway.verifyVnp(params)) {
                success = "00".equals(params.get("vnp_ResponseCode"))
                        && "00".equals(params.get("vnp_TransactionStatus"));
                message = success
                        ? "Cổng thanh toán đã xác nhận giao dịch thành công. "
                            + "Cảm ơn bạn đã mua sắm tại OECS!"
                        : "Thanh toán chưa hoàn tất hoặc đã bị hủy. "
                            + "Bạn có thể kiểm tra đơn hàng và thanh toán lại trong Đơn mua.";
            }
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            LOGGER.warning("Không xác minh được kết quả thanh toán trả về.");
        }

        response.setHeader("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer");
        request.setAttribute("paymentSuccess", success);
        request.setAttribute("paymentResultMessage", message);
        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/checkout/payment-result.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    private void sendVnpResponse(
            HttpServletResponse response,
            String code
    ) throws IOException {

        String message;

        switch (code) {
            case "00":
                message = "Confirm Success";
                break;

            case "02":
                message = "Already confirmed";
                break;

            case "01":
                message = "Order not found";
                break;

            case "04":
                message = "Invalid amount";
                break;

            case "97":
                message = "Invalid signature";
                break;

            default:
                message = "Unknown error";
                break;
        }

        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.addProperty("RspCode", code);
        body.addProperty("Message", message);

        response.getWriter().write(body.toString());
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.OrderDAO;
import dao.PaymentDAO;

import model.Order;
import model.User;

import payment.PaymentGateway;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "PaymentServlet",
        urlPatterns = {
            "/payment",
            "/payment/action"
        }
)
public class PaymentServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(PaymentServlet.class.getName());

    private final PaymentDAO payments = new PaymentDAO();
    private final OrderDAO orders = new OrderDAO();

    // Kiem tra dang nhap va quyen Customer
    private User customer(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        Object value = session == null
                ? null
                : session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (!(value instanceof User)) {
            request.getSession().setAttribute(
                    "redirectUrl",
                    request.getContextPath() + "/my-orders"
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/login"
            );

            return null;
        }

        User user = (User) value;

        if (!user.isCustomer()) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN
            );

            return null;
        }

        return user;
    }

    private int getOrderId(HttpServletRequest request) {
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(
                    request.getParameter("id")
            );
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        User user = customer(request, response);

        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (!"/payment".equals(request.getServletPath())) {
            response.setHeader("Allow", "POST");
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED
            );
            return;
        }

        try {
            int orderId = getOrderId(request);

            Order order = orders.findByIdAndUser(
                    orderId,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            if (order == null) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND,
                        "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                );
                return;
            }

            payments.expireOrder(
                    user.getUserId(),
                    orderId
            );

            order = orders.findByIdAndUser(
                    orderId,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            if (order == null) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND
                );
                return;
            }

            if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(
                    order.getOrderStatus()
            )) {
                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/my-orders/detail?id="
                        + orderId
                );
                return;
            }

            HttpSession session = request.getSession();

            synchronized (session) {
                if (session.getAttribute("paymentCsrf") == null) {
                    session.setAttribute(
                            "paymentCsrf",
                            UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                    );
                }
            }

            request.setAttribute("order", order);
            request.setAttribute("payableAmount", PaymentGateway.roundVnd(order.getTotalAmount()));
            request.setAttribute("paymentAvailable", PaymentGateway.available(order.getPaymentMethod()));

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/checkout/payment.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND,
                    "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
            );

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Không tải được trang thanh toán.",
                    e
            );

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                    "Chưa tải được thanh toán. Vui lòng thử lại."
            );
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        User user = customer(request, response);

        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (!"/payment/action".equals(
                request.getServletPath()
        )) {
            response.setHeader("Allow", "GET");
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED
            );
            return;
        }

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        String token = request.getParameter("csrfToken");

        if (token == null
                || !token.equals(
                        session.getAttribute("paymentCsrf")
                )) {

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN,
                    "Yêu cầu không hợp lệ. Vui lòng tải lại trang."
            );
            return;
        }

        int orderId = getOrderId(request);

        if (orderId <= 0) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        try {
            String action = request.getParameter("action");

            if ("pay".equals(action)) {

                PaymentDAO.Attempt attempt = payments.begin(
                        user.getUserId(),
                        orderId
                );

                String paymentUrl = attempt.url;

                if (paymentUrl == null) {
                    paymentUrl = PaymentGateway.create(
                            attempt.method,
                            attempt.ref,
                            attempt.amount,
                            attempt.seconds,
                            request.getRemoteAddr()
                    );

                    payments.saveUrl(
                            attempt.ref,
                            paymentUrl
                    );
                }

                response.setStatus(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_SEE_OTHER
                );

                response.setHeader(
                        "Location",
                        paymentUrl
                );

                return;

            } else if ("cod".equals(action)
                    || "cancel".equals(action)) {

                payments.changeOrCancel(
                        user.getUserId(),
                        orderId,
                        "cod".equals(action)
                );

                response.setStatus(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_SEE_OTHER
                );

                response.setHeader(
                        "Location",
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/my-orders/detail?id="
                        + orderId
                );

                return;

            } else {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                        "Thao tác không hợp lệ."
                );
                return;
            }

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "paymentError",
                    e.getMessage()
            );

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "Không khởi tạo được thanh toán.",
                    e
            );

            session.setAttribute(
                    "paymentError",
                    "Chưa mở được cổng thanh toán. "
                    + "Đơn vẫn chờ thanh toán đến hạn; "
                    + "thử lại sau 30 giây hoặc đổi COD."
            );
        }

        response.setStatus(
                HttpServletResponse.SC_SEE_OTHER
        );

        response.setHeader(
                "Location",
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/payment?id="
                + orderId
        );
    }
}

@WebServlet(
        name = "ProductServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/product"}
)
@MultipartConfig(
        fileSizeThreshold = 1024 * 1024 * 2,
        maxFileSize = 1024 * 1024 * 10,
        maxRequestSize = 1024 * 1024 * 50
)
public class ProductServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(ProductServlet.class.getName());

    private static final String LIST_URL
            = "/product?view=list";

    private static final String UPLOAD_FOLDER
            = "uploads/products";

    private static final long MAX_IMAGE_SIZE
            = 10L * 1024 * 1024;

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String view = request.getParameter("view");

        if (view == null || "list".equals(view)) {
            showList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        switch (view) {

            case "create":
                showCreate(request, response);
                break;

            case "edit":
                showEdit(request, response);
                break;

            case "delete":
                showDelete(request, response);
                break;

            default:
                redirectToList(request, response);
                break;
        }
    }

    private void showList(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        ProductDAO productDAO = new ProductDAO();

        String keyword = request.getParameter("search");

        List<Product> productList;

        if (keyword != null && !keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {

            productList = productDAO.searchProducts(
                    keyword.trim()
            );

        } else {

            productList = productDAO.getList();
        }

        request.setAttribute(
                "productList",
                productList
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/product/list.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    private void showCreate(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        Integer categoryId = parseOptionalPositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("categoryId")
        );

        loadFormCommonAttributes(request, true);

        if (categoryId != null
                && isCategoryListedInForm(request, categoryId)) {

            loadCategoryAttributes(
                    request,
                    categoryId
            );

        } else {

            setEmptyCategoryAttributes(request);
        }

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/product/create.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    private void showEdit(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        Integer productId = parseOptionalPositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("id")
        );

        if (productId == null) {
            redirectToList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        ProductDAO productDAO = new ProductDAO();

        Product product = productDAO.getById(productId);

        if (product == null) {
            redirectToList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        product.setGalleryImages(
                productDAO.getProductImages(productId)
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "product",
                product
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "productSpecs",
                productDAO.getProductSpecsForAdmin(productId)
        );

        loadFormCommonAttributes(request, false);

        loadCategoryAttributes(
                request,
                product.getCategoryId()
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/product/edit.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    private void showDelete(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        Integer productId = parseOptionalPositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("id")
        );

        if (productId == null) {
            redirectToList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        Product product
                = new ProductDAO().getById(productId);

        if (product == null) {
            redirectToList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        request.setAttribute(
                "product",
                product
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/product/delete.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        try {

            if ("create".equals(action)) {

                createProduct(request, response);

            } else if ("edit".equals(action)) {

                updateProduct(request, response);

            } else if ("delete".equals(action)) {

                deleteProduct(request, response);

            } else {

                setError(
                        request,
                        "Thao tác không hợp lệ."
                );

                redirectToList(request, response);
            }

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "Dữ liệu sản phẩm không hợp lệ",
                    ex
            );

            setError(
                    request,
                    ex.getMessage()
            );

            redirectToForm(
                    request,
                    response,
                    action
            );

        } catch (Exception ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi ProductServlet",
                    ex
            );

            setError(
                    request,
                    "Không thể lưu sản phẩm. "
                    + "Vui lòng kiểm tra lại dữ liệu."
            );

            redirectToForm(
                    request,
                    response,
                    action
            );
        }
    }

    private void createProduct(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws Exception {

        ProductDAO productDAO = new ProductDAO();

        Product product
                = readProductFromRequest(request);

        if (productDAO.checkProductNameExists(
                product.getProductName())) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Tên sản phẩm đã tồn tại."
            );
        }

        List<ProductSpec> specifications
                = readSpecifications(request);

        List<Path> uploadedFiles
                = new ArrayList<>();

        boolean committed = false;

        try {

            String imageUrl = saveUploadedPart(
                    request.getPart("imageFile"),
                    request,
                    uploadedFiles
            );

            if (imageUrl == null) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Vui lòng chọn ảnh đại diện."
                );
            }

            product.setImageUrl(imageUrl);

            List<String> galleryUrls
                    = uploadMultipleImages(
                            request,
                            "galleryFiles",
                            uploadedFiles
                    );

            ProductCatalogService service
                    = new ProductCatalogService();

            int productId = service.createProduct(
                    product,
                    specifications,
                    galleryUrls
            );

            if (productId <= 0) {

                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Không thể tạo sản phẩm."
                );
            }

            committed = true;

        } finally {

            if (!committed) {
                deleteUploadedFiles(uploadedFiles);
            }
        }

        setSuccess(
                request,
                "Thêm sản phẩm thành công."
        );

        redirectToList(request, response);
    }

    private void updateProduct(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws Exception {

        Integer productId = parseOptionalPositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("id")
        );

        if (productId == null) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "ID sản phẩm không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        ProductDAO productDAO = new ProductDAO();

        Product oldProduct
                = productDAO.getById(productId);

        if (oldProduct == null) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Sản phẩm không tồn tại."
            );
        }

        Product product
                = readProductFromRequest(request);

        product.setProductId(productId);

        if (product.getCategoryId()
                != oldProduct.getCategoryId()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Không thể đổi danh mục sản phẩm "
                    + "trong form chỉnh sửa."
            );
        }

        if (productDAO.checkProductNameExistsForUpdate(
                product.getProductName(),
                productId)) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Tên sản phẩm đã tồn tại."
            );
        }

        List<ProductSpec> specifications
                = readSpecifications(request);

        List<Integer> deleteImageIds
                = readDeleteImageIds(request);

        List<Path> uploadedFiles
                = new ArrayList<>();

        boolean committed = false;

        try {

            String imageUrl = saveUploadedPart(
                    request.getPart("imageFile"),
                    request,
                    uploadedFiles
            );

            product.setImageUrl(imageUrl);

            List<String> galleryUrls
                    = uploadMultipleImages(
                            request,
                            "galleryFiles",
                            uploadedFiles
                    );

            ProductCatalogService service
                    = new ProductCatalogService();

            boolean success = service.updateProduct(
                    product,
                    specifications,
                    galleryUrls,
                    deleteImageIds
            );

            if (!success) {

                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Không thể cập nhật sản phẩm."
                );
            }

            committed = true;

        } finally {

            if (!committed) {
                deleteUploadedFiles(uploadedFiles);
            }
        }

        setSuccess(
                request,
                "Cập nhật sản phẩm thành công."
        );

        redirectToList(request, response);
    }

    private void deleteProduct(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        Integer productId = parseOptionalPositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("id")
        );

        if (productId == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "ID sản phẩm không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        ProductDAO productDAO = new ProductDAO();

        int result = productDAO.delete(productId);

        if (result <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Không thể xóa sản phẩm."
            );
        }

        setSuccess(
                request,
                "Đã xóa vĩnh viễn sản phẩm."
        );

        redirectToList(request, response);
    }

    private Product readProductFromRequest(
            HttpServletRequest request) {

        String name = trimToNull(
                request.getParameter("name")
        );

        Integer categoryId = parseOptionalPositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("categoryId")
        );

        Integer brandId = parseOptionalPositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("brandId")
        );

        if (name == null || name.length() > 255) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Tên sản phẩm phải có từ 1 "
                    + "đến 255 ký tự."
            );
        }

        if (categoryId == null || brandId == null) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Vui lòng chọn danh mục "
                    + "và thương hiệu."
            );
        }

        Category selectedCategory = new CategoryDAO().getById(categoryId);
        if (selectedCategory == null
                || selectedCategory.getParentId() == null) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Vui lòng chọn danh mục con, không chọn danh mục cha."
            );
        }

        String modelCode = trimToNull(
                request.getParameter("modelCode")
        );

        if (modelCode != null
                && modelCode.length() > 100) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Mã model vượt quá 100 ký tự."
            );
        }

        String description
                = request.getParameter("description");

        Product product = new Product(
                categoryId,
                brandId,
                name,
                description,
                null
        );

        product.setModelCode(modelCode);

        return product;
    }

    private List<ProductSpec> readSpecifications(
            HttpServletRequest request) {

        List<ProductSpec> specifications
                = new ArrayList<>();

        String[] attributeIds
                = request.getParameterValues("attributeIds");

        String[] specValues
                = request.getParameterValues("specValues");

        if (attributeIds == null
                && specValues == null) {

            return specifications;
        }

        if (attributeIds == null
                || specValues == null
                || attributeIds.length != specValues.length) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Danh sách thông số không đồng bộ."
            );
        }

        Set<Integer> usedIds = new HashSet<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < attributeIds.length; i++) {

            String idText = attributeIds[i];

            String value = specValues[i] == null
                    ? ""
                    : specValues[i].trim();

            if ((idText == null || idText.trim().isEmpty())
                    && value.isEmpty()) {

                continue;
            }

            Integer attributeId
                    = parseOptionalPositiveInt(idText);

            if (attributeId == null) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Attribute ID không hợp lệ."
                );
            }

            if (!usedIds.add(attributeId)) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Thông số kỹ thuật bị trùng."
                );
            }

            if (value.length() > 255) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Giá trị thông số vượt quá 255 ký tự."
                );
            }

            ProductSpec spec = new ProductSpec(
                    attributeId,
                    null,
                    value
            );

            specifications.add(spec);
        }

        return specifications;
    }

    private List<Integer> readDeleteImageIds(
            HttpServletRequest request) {

        List<Integer> imageIds
                = new ArrayList<>();

        String[] values
                = request.getParameterValues("deleteImageIds");

        if (values == null) {
            return imageIds;
        }

        Set<Integer> uniqueIds
                = new HashSet<>();

        for (String value : values) {

            Integer imageId
                    = parseOptionalPositiveInt(value);

            if (imageId == null) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Image ID không hợp lệ."
                );
            }

            if (uniqueIds.add(imageId)) {
                imageIds.add(imageId);
            }
        }

        return imageIds;
    }

    private void loadFormCommonAttributes(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            boolean onlyActive) {

        BrandDAO brandDAO = new BrandDAO();
        CategoryDAO categoryDAO = new CategoryDAO();

        request.setAttribute(
                "brandList",
                onlyActive
                        ? brandDAO.getActiveBrands()
                        : brandDAO.getList()
        );

        List<Category> allCategories = onlyActive
                ? categoryDAO.getActiveCategories()
                : categoryDAO.getList();

        List<Category> childCategories = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Category category : allCategories) {
            if (category != null && category.getParentId() != null) {
                childCategories.add(category);
            }
        }

        request.setAttribute(
                "categoryList",
                childCategories
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "attributeList",
                new AttributeDAO().getActiveAttributes()
        );
    }

    private boolean isCategoryListedInForm(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            int categoryId) {

        Object value = request.getAttribute("categoryList");
        if (!(value instanceof List<?>)) {
            return false;
        }

        for (Object item : (List<?>) value) {
            if (item instanceof Category) {
                Category category = (Category) item;
                if (category.getCategoryId() == categoryId) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private void loadCategoryAttributes(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            int categoryId) {

        CategoryAttributeDAO dao
                = new CategoryAttributeDAO();

        List<CategoryAttribute> specificationAttributes
                = dao.getSpecificationAttributes(categoryId);

        List<CategoryAttribute> variantAttributes
                = dao.getVariantAttributes(categoryId);

        request.setAttribute(
                "specificationAttributes",
                specificationAttributes
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "variantAttributes",
                variantAttributes
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "selectedCategoryId",
                categoryId
        );
    }

    private void setEmptyCategoryAttributes(
            HttpServletRequest request) {

        request.setAttribute(
                "specificationAttributes",
                new ArrayList<CategoryAttribute>()
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "variantAttributes",
                new ArrayList<CategoryAttribute>()
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "selectedCategoryId",
                null
        );
    }

    private String saveUploadedPart(
            Part part,
            HttpServletRequest request,
            List<Path> uploadedFiles)
            throws IOException {

        if (part == null || part.getSize() == 0) {
            return null;
        }

        if (part.getSize() > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Mỗi ảnh không được vượt quá 10 MB."
            );
        }

        String contentType = part.getContentType();

        String extension;

        if ("image/jpeg".equalsIgnoreCase(contentType)) {

            extension = ".jpg";

        } else if ("image/png".equalsIgnoreCase(contentType)) {

            extension = ".png";

        } else if ("image/webp".equalsIgnoreCase(contentType)) {

            extension = ".webp";

        } else {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Chỉ hỗ trợ ảnh JPG, PNG và WEBP."
            );
        }

        String root
                = request.getServletContext().getRealPath("/");

        if (root == null) {

            throw new IOException(
                    "Không xác định được thư mục upload."
            );
        }

        Path uploadDirectory = Paths.get(
                root,
                "uploads",
                "products"
        );

        Files.createDirectories(uploadDirectory);

        String fileName
                = UUID.randomUUID().toString() + extension;

        Path destination
                = uploadDirectory.resolve(fileName);

        try (BufferedInputStream input
                = new BufferedInputStream(
                        part.getInputStream()
                )) {

            validateImageSignature(
                    input,
                    extension
            );

            uploadedFiles.add(destination);

            Files.copy(input, destination);
        }

        return UPLOAD_FOLDER + "/" + fileName;
    }

    private void validateImageSignature(
            BufferedInputStream input,
            String extension) throws IOException {

        input.mark(16);

        byte[] header = new byte[12];

        int length = 0;

        while (length < header.length) {

            int read = input.read(
                    header,
                    length,
                    header.length - length
            );

            if (read == -1) {
                break;
            }

            length += read;
        }

        input.reset();

        boolean valid = false;

        if (".jpg".equals(extension) && length >= 3) {

            valid
                    = (header[0] & 0xFF) == 0xFF
                    && (header[1] & 0xFF) == 0xD8
                    && (header[2] & 0xFF) == 0xFF;

        } else if (".png".equals(extension)
                && length >= 8) {

            int[] signature = {
                137, 80, 78, 71,
                13, 10, 26, 10
            };

            valid = true;

            for (int i = 0; i < signature.length; i++) {

                if ((header[i] & 0xFF) != signature[i]) {
                    valid = false;
                    break;
                }
            }

        } else if (".webp".equals(extension)
                && length >= 12) {

            valid
                    = header[0] == 'R'
                    && header[1] == 'I'
                    && header[2] == 'F'
                    && header[3] == 'F'
                    && header[8] == 'W'
                    && header[9] == 'E'
                    && header[10] == 'B'
                    && header[11] == 'P';
        }

        if (!valid) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Nội dung file ảnh không hợp lệ."
            );
        }
    }

    private List<String> uploadMultipleImages(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String partName,
            List<Path> uploadedFiles)
            throws IOException, ServletException {

        List<String> galleryUrls
                = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Part part : request.getParts()) {

            if (!partName.equals(part.getName())) {
                continue;
            }

            String url = saveUploadedPart(
                    part,
                    request,
                    uploadedFiles
            );

            if (url != null) {
                galleryUrls.add(url);
            }
        }

        return galleryUrls;
    }

    private void deleteUploadedFiles(
            List<Path> uploadedFiles) {

        for (Path path : uploadedFiles) {

            try {

                Files.deleteIfExists(path);

            } catch (IOException ex) {

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.WARNING,
                        "Không xóa được file upload: " + path,
                        ex
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private Integer parseOptionalPositiveInt(
            String value) {

        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        try {

            int result
                    = Integer.parseInt(value.trim());

            return result > 0 ? result : null;

        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {

            return null;
        }
    }

    private String trimToNull(String value) {

        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private void setError(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String message) {

        request.getSession().setAttribute(
                "errorMsg",
                message
        );
    }

    private void setSuccess(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String message) {

        request.getSession().setAttribute(
                "successMsg",
                message
        );
    }

    private void redirectToList(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath() + LIST_URL
        );
    }

    private void redirectToForm(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            String action)
            throws IOException {

        if ("create".equals(action)) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/product?view=create"
            );

            return;
        }

        if ("edit".equals(action)) {

            Integer productId = parseOptionalPositiveInt(
                    request.getParameter("id")
            );

            if (productId != null) {

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/product?view=edit&id="
                        + productId
                );

                return;
            }
        }

        if ("delete".equals(action)) {

            Integer productId = parseOptionalPositiveInt(
                    request.getParameter("id")
            );

            if (productId != null) {

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/product?view=delete&id="
                        + productId
                );

                return;
            }
        }

        redirectToList(request, response);
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.CategoryAttributeDAO;
import dao.ProductDAO;
import dao.ProductSkuDAO;

import model.CategoryAttribute;
import model.Product;
import model.ProductImage;
import model.ProductSku;
import model.SkuAttributeValue;
import model.User;

import dao.SkuHardDeleteDAO;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.util.UUID;

import service.AuditLogService;
import service.SkuImageService;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.sql.SQLException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "ProductSkuServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/product-sku"}
)
public class ProductSkuServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(ProductSkuServlet.class.getName());

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService
            = new AuditLogService();

    // ========================================
    // 1. HIỂN THỊ TRANG QUẢN LÝ SKU
    // ========================================
    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        Integer productId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("productId")
        );

        if (productId == null) {
            redirectToProductList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        ProductDAO productDAO = new ProductDAO();

        Product product = productDAO.getById(productId);

        if (product == null) {
            redirectToProductList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        ProductSkuDAO skuDAO = new ProductSkuDAO();

        List<ProductSku> skuList
                = skuDAO.getByProductId(productId);

        CategoryAttributeDAO categoryAttributeDAO
                = new CategoryAttributeDAO();

        List<CategoryAttribute> variantAttributes
                = categoryAttributeDAO.getVariantAttributes(
                        product.getCategoryId()
                );

        /*
         * Lấy ảnh riêng của từng SKU.
         *
         * Key   = skuId
         * Value = danh sách ProductImage
         *
         * JSP sẽ truy cập:
         * ${skuImagesBySkuId[sku.skuId]}
         */
        Map<Integer, List<ProductImage>> skuImagesBySkuId
                = new HashMap<>();

        try {

            if (!skuList.isEmpty()) {

                // Mot query lay anh cua tat ca SKU theo Product ID.
                skuImagesBySkuId
                        = new SkuImageService()
                                .getImagesByProductId(productId);

                // Giu danh sach rong cho SKU chua co anh.
                for (ProductSku sku : skuList) {

                    skuImagesBySkuId.putIfAbsent(
                            sku.getSkuId(),
                            new ArrayList<>()
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Khong tai duoc anh SKU cua Product ID "
                    + productId,
                    ex
            );

            request.getSession().setAttribute(
                    "errorMsg",
                    "Khong the tai danh sach anh SKU."
            );

            redirectToProductList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        // Giữ các attribute cũ.
        request.setAttribute("product", product);
        request.setAttribute("skuList", skuList);

        // Cấu hình thuộc tính biến thể.
        request.setAttribute(
                "variantAttributes",
                variantAttributes
        );

        // Dữ liệu ảnh SKU mới.
        request.setAttribute(
                "skuImagesBySkuId",
                skuImagesBySkuId
        );

        // Token xác nhận xóa vĩnh viễn SKU (giữ ổn định trong phiên).
        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        if (session.getAttribute("skuHardDeleteToken") == null) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "skuHardDeleteToken",
                    UUID.randomUUID().toString()
            );
        }

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/sku/list.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    // ========================================
    // 2. XỬ LÝ POST
    // ========================================
    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        Integer productId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("productId")
        );

        if (productId == null) {
            setError(request, "Product ID không hợp lệ.");
            redirectToProductList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        Product product
                = new ProductDAO().getById(productId);

        if (product == null) {
            setError(request, "Không tìm thấy sản phẩm.");
            redirectToProductList(request, response);
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        try {

            switch (action == null ? "" : action) {

                case "create":
                    createSku(request, product);
                    break;

                case "update":
                    updateSku(request, product);
                    break;

                case "delete":
                    deactivateSku(request, product);
                    break;

                case "hardDelete":
                    hardDeleteSku(request, product);
                    break;

                default:
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Thao tác SKU không hợp lệ."
                    );
            }

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "Dữ liệu SKU không hợp lệ",
                    ex
            );

            setError(request, ex.getMessage());

        } catch (Exception ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Không thể xử lý SKU",
                    ex
            );

            setError(
                    request,
                    "Không thể lưu SKU. "
                    + "Vui lòng kiểm tra dữ liệu hoặc nhật ký hệ thống."
            );
        }

        redirectToSkuList(
                request,
                response,
                productId
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 3. THÊM SKU
    // ========================================
    private void createSku(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            Product product) {

        ProductSkuDAO skuDAO = new ProductSkuDAO();

        ProductSku sku = readSkuFromRequest(
                request,
                product.getProductId(),
                null
        );

        if (skuDAO.checkSkuCodeExists(
                sku.getSkuCode())) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Mã SKU đã tồn tại: "
                    + sku.getSkuCode()
            );
        }

        List<CategoryAttribute> configs
                = new CategoryAttributeDAO()
                        .getVariantAttributes(
                                product.getCategoryId()
                        );

        int result;
        Long createdSkuId = null;

        if (hasVariantInput(request)) {

            List<SkuAttributeValue> values
                    = readVariantAttributes(
                            request,
                            configs
                    );

            /*
             * insertWithAttributes() trả về
             * ID SKU mới nếu thành công.
             *
             * DAO xử lý SKU, attribute values
             * và usp_OECS_RefreshSkuVariantKey
             * trong một transaction.
             */
            int newSkuId
                    = skuDAO.insertWithAttributes(
                            sku,
                            values
                    );

            result = newSkuId;

            if (newSkuId > 0) {
                createdSkuId = (long) newSkuId;
            }

        } else {

            /*
             * Nếu danh mục có thuộc tính biến thể,
             * không cho tạo SKU thiếu toàn bộ
             * thuộc tính bằng form cũ.
             */
            if (!configs.isEmpty()) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Danh mục này có thuộc tính biến thể. "
                        + "Vui lòng nhập các thuộc tính SKU."
                );
            }

            // Tương thích danh mục không có biến thể.
            result = skuDAO.insert(sku);
        }

        if (result <= 0) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Không thể thêm SKU."
            );
        }

        setSuccess(
                request,
                "Thêm phiên bản SKU thành công."
        );

        writeAuditLog(
                request,
                "CREATE_SKU",
                createdSkuId,
                "Created SKU: " + sku.getSkuCode()
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 4. CẬP NHẬT SKU
    // ========================================
    private void updateSku(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            Product product) {

        Integer skuId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("skuId")
        );

        if (skuId == null) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "SKU ID không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        ProductSkuDAO skuDAO = new ProductSkuDAO();

        ProductSku existing
                = skuDAO.getBySkuId(skuId);

        if (existing == null
                || existing.getProductId()
                != product.getProductId()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "SKU không thuộc sản phẩm này."
            );
        }

        ProductSku updated = readSkuFromRequest(
                request,
                product.getProductId(),
                existing
        );

        updated.setSkuId(skuId);

        if (skuDAO.checkSkuCodeExistsForUpdate(
                updated.getSkuCode(),
                skuId)) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Mã SKU bị trùng với phiên bản khác."
            );
        }

        int result;

        if (hasVariantInput(request)) {

            List<CategoryAttribute> configs
                    = new CategoryAttributeDAO()
                            .getVariantAttributes(
                                    product.getCategoryId()
                            );

            List<SkuAttributeValue> values
                    = readVariantAttributes(
                            request,
                            configs
                    );

            /*
             * Form V2 gửi đầy đủ danh sách
             * thuộc tính cần giữ lại.
             */
            result = skuDAO.updateWithAttributes(
                    updated,
                    values
            );

        } else {

            /*
             * Tương thích form cũ:
             * sửa thông tin SKU nhưng không
             * xóa các attribute values đã lưu.
             */
            result = skuDAO.update(updated);
        }

        if (result <= 0) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Không thể cập nhật SKU."
            );
        }

        setSuccess(
                request,
                "Cập nhật SKU thành công."
        );

        writeAuditLog(
                request,
                "UPDATE_SKU",
                skuId.longValue(),
                "Updated SKU: " + updated.getSkuCode()
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 5A. XÓA VĨNH VIỄN SKU CHƯA CÓ GIAO DỊCH
    // ========================================
    private void hardDeleteSku(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            Product product) throws SQLException {

        // Token kiểm tra phải được tạo từ trang GET quản lý SKU.
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
        String expectedToken = session == null
                ? null
                : (String) session.getAttribute("skuHardDeleteToken");
        String submittedToken = request.getParameter("deleteToken");

        if (expectedToken == null
                || submittedToken == null
                || !expectedToken.equals(submittedToken)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Phiên xác nhận xóa không hợp lệ. Vui lòng tải lại trang."
            );
        }

        Integer skuId = parsePositiveInt(request.getParameter("skuId"));
        if (skuId == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("SKU ID không hợp lệ.");
        }


        String deletedCode = new SkuHardDeleteDAO().deletePermanently(
                product.getProductId(), skuId
        );

        // Không xóa lịch sử audit: ghi nhận ID và mã SKU đã bị xóa.
        writeAuditLog(
                request,
                "HARD_DELETE_SKU",
                skuId.longValue(),
                "Permanently deleted SKU: " + deletedCode
        );

        setSuccess(request, "Đã xóa vĩnh viễn SKU: " + deletedCode);
    }

    // ========================================
    // 5. NGỪNG BÁN SKU
    // ========================================
    private void deactivateSku(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            Product product) {

        Integer skuId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("skuId")
        );

        if (skuId == null) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "SKU ID không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        ProductSkuDAO skuDAO = new ProductSkuDAO();

        ProductSku existing
                = skuDAO.getBySkuId(skuId);

        if (existing == null
                || existing.getProductId()
                != product.getProductId()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "SKU không thuộc sản phẩm này."
            );
        }

        if (!existing.isActive()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "SKU này đã ngừng kinh doanh."
            );
        }

        /*
         * delete() của ProductSkuDAO V2
         * thực hiện soft delete:
         * is_active = 0.
         *
         * Ảnh SKU vẫn được giữ nguyên.
         */
        int result = skuDAO.delete(skuId);

        if (result <= 0) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Không thể ngừng bán SKU."
            );
        }

        setSuccess(
                request,
                "Đã ngừng kinh doanh SKU."
        );

        writeAuditLog(
                request,
                "DEACTIVATE_SKU",
                skuId.longValue(),
                "Deactivated SKU: "
                + existing.getSkuCode()
        );
    }

    // ========================================
    // 6. ĐỌC DỮ LIỆU SKU
    // ========================================
    private ProductSku readSkuFromRequest(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            int productId,
            ProductSku existing) {

        String skuCode = trimToNull(
                request.getParameter("skuCode")
        );

        if (skuCode == null
                || skuCode.length() > 100) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Mã SKU phải có từ 1 đến 100 ký tự."
            );
        }

        double price = parseMoney(
                request.getParameter("priceStr"),
                "Giá bán"
        );

        int stock = parseNonNegativeInt(
                request.getParameter("stock"),
                "Tồn kho"
        );

        ProductSku sku = new ProductSku(
                existing == null
                        ? 0
                        : existing.getSkuId(),
                productId,
                skuCode,
                price,
                stock
        );

        // Giá niêm yết tùy chọn.
