public class StaffReturnExchangeServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(
                    StaffReturnExchangeServlet.class.getName());

    private final ReturnExchangeService returnExchangeService =
            new ReturnExchangeService();

    // =====================================================
    // 1. KIEM TRA QUYEN STAFF
    // =====================================================

    private User getLoggedInStaff(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return null;
        }

        Object loggedInUser =
                session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (!(loggedInUser instanceof User)) {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return null;
        }

        User staff = (User) loggedInUser;

        if (!staff.isStaff()) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN,
                    "Bạn không có quyền quản lý trả hàng.");
            return null;
        }

        return staff;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 2. HIEN THI DANH SACH / CHI TIET RETURN
    // =====================================================

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        User staff = getLoggedInStaff(request, response);

        if (staff == null) {
            return;
        }

        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();
        String view = request.getParameter("view");

        try {

            // Xem chi tiet mot yeu cau tra hang.
            if ("detail".equals(view)) {

                int requestId = parseRequestId(
                        request.getParameter("id"));

                List<Map<String, Object>> requests =
                        returnExchangeService.getAllRequests();

                Map<String, Object> selectedRequest = null;

                for (Map<String, Object> item : requests) {

                    Object id = item.get("requestId");

                    if (id instanceof Number
                            && ((Number) id).intValue() == requestId) {

                        selectedRequest = item;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (selectedRequest == null) {

                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath
                            + "/staff/return-exchange?error=notFound");

                    return;
                }

                request.setAttribute(
                        "selectedRequest",
                        selectedRequest
                );

                request.setAttribute(
                        "requestItems",
                        returnExchangeService.getRequestItems(requestId)
                );

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/staff/return-exchange/detail.jsp"
                ).forward(request, response);

                return;
            }

            // Xem danh sach tat ca yeu cau tra hang.
            request.setAttribute(
                    "requestList",
                    returnExchangeService.getAllRequests()
            );

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/staff/return-exchange/list.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?error=invalidId"
            );

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot load return requests",
                    ex
            );

            throw new ServletException(
                    "Không thể tải danh sách yêu cầu trả hàng.",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 3. STAFF DUYET / TU CHOI RETURN
    // =====================================================

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        User staff = getLoggedInStaff(request, response);

        if (staff == null) {
            return;
        }

        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();
        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        int requestId;

        try {

            requestId = parseRequestId(
                    request.getParameter("id"));

        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?error=invalidId"
            );

            return;
        }

        // Chi cho phep duyet hoac tu choi Return.
        String newStatus;

        if ("approve".equals(action)) {

            newStatus = "APPROVED";

        } else if ("reject".equals(action)) {

            newStatus = "REJECTED";

        } else {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?error=invalidAction"
            );

            return;
        }

        String staffNote =
                request.getParameter("staffNote");

        staffNote = staffNote == null
                ? ""
                : staffNote.trim();

        // Gioi han do dai phu hop voi DB.
        if (staffNote.length() > 1000) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    detailUrl(contextPath, requestId)
                    + "&error=invalid"
            );

            return;
        }

        // Tu choi bat buoc co ly do.
        if ("REJECTED".equals(newStatus)
                && staffNote.isEmpty()) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    detailUrl(contextPath, requestId)
                    + "&error=noteRequired"
            );

            return;
        }

        try {

            boolean updated =
                    returnExchangeService.reviewRequest(
                            requestId,
                            staff.getUserId(),
                            newStatus,
                            staffNote
                    );

            if (!updated) {

                response.sendRedirect(
                        detailUrl(contextPath, requestId)
                        + "&error=alreadyReviewed"
                );

                return;
            }

            // Giu ma thong bao cu de tuong thich JSP.
            String message =
                    "APPROVED".equals(newStatus)
                    ? "approved"
                    : "rejected";

            response.sendRedirect(
                    detailUrl(contextPath, requestId)
                    + "&message="
                    + URLEncoder.encode(
                            message,
                            StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                    )
            );

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "Invalid return review request",
                    ex
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    detailUrl(contextPath, requestId)
                    + "&error=invalid"
            );

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot review return request",
                    ex
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    detailUrl(contextPath, requestId)
                    + "&error=system"
            );
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 4. KIEM TRA MA YEU CAU
    // =====================================================

    private int parseRequestId(String value) {

        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new NumberFormatException(
                    "Thiếu mã yêu cầu trả hàng.");
        }

        int requestId = Integer.parseInt(value.trim());

        if (requestId <= 0) {
            throw new NumberFormatException(
                    "Mã yêu cầu phải lớn hơn 0.");
        }

        return requestId;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 5. TAO DUONG DAN CHI TIET RETURN
    // =====================================================

    private String detailUrl(
            String contextPath,
            int requestId) {

        return contextPath
                + "/staff/return-exchange?view=detail&id="
                + requestId;
    }
}

package controller;

import dao.ReviewReportDAO;
import dao.StaffReviewDAO;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@WebServlet(name = "StaffReviewServlet", urlPatterns = {"/staff/reviews"})
public class StaffReviewServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private User getStaff(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null
                || !(session.getAttribute("loggedInUser") instanceof User)) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return null;
        }

        User user = (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (!user.isStaff()) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN);
            return null;
        }

        return user;
    }

    private String ensureToken(HttpSession session) {
        String token = (String) session.getAttribute("reviewCsrfToken");

        if (token == null) {
            token = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
            session.setAttribute("reviewCsrfToken", token);
        }

        return token;
    }

    private boolean validToken(HttpServletRequest request) {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            return false;
        }

        String expected = (String) session.getAttribute("reviewCsrfToken");
        String actual = request.getParameter("csrfToken");

        return expected != null && expected.equals(actual);
    }

    private String reviewFilter(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) {
            return "all";
        }

        String value = raw.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        return "visible".equals(value) || "hidden".equals(value)
                ? value : "all";
    }

    private String reportFilter(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) {
            return "all";
        }

        String value = raw.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        return "pending".equals(value)
                || "resolved".equals(value)
                || "rejected".equals(value)
                ? value : "all";
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        if (getStaff(request, response) == null) {
            return;
        }

        ensureToken(request.getSession());

        String reviewStatus =
                reviewFilter(request.getParameter("reviewStatus"));

        String reportStatus =
                reportFilter(request.getParameter("reportStatus"));

        try {
            List<Map<String, Object>> allReviews =
                    new StaffReviewDAO().getAllReviewsForStaff();

            List<Map<String, Object>> allReports =
                    new ReviewReportDAO().getAllReports();

            List<Map<String, Object>> filteredReviews = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Map<String, Object>> filteredReports = new ArrayList<>();

            int visibleCount = 0;
            int hiddenCount = 0;

            for (Map<String, Object> review : allReviews) {
                boolean hidden =
                        Boolean.TRUE.equals(review.get("isHidden"));

                if (hidden) {
                    hiddenCount++;
                } else {
                    visibleCount++;
                }

                if ("all".equals(reviewStatus)
                        || (hidden && "hidden".equals(reviewStatus))
                        || (!hidden && "visible".equals(reviewStatus))) {
                    filteredReviews.add(review);
                }
            }

            int pendingCount = 0;
            int resolvedCount = 0;
            int rejectedCount = 0;

            for (Map<String, Object> report : allReports) {
                String status = String.valueOf(report.get("status"));

                if ("PENDING".equals(status)) {
                    pendingCount++;
                } else if ("RESOLVED".equals(status)) {
                    resolvedCount++;
                } else if ("REJECTED".equals(status)) {
                    rejectedCount++;
                }

                if ("all".equals(reportStatus)
                        || reportStatus.equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
                    filteredReports.add(report);
                }
            }

            request.setAttribute("reviews", filteredReviews);
            request.setAttribute("reports", filteredReports);

            request.setAttribute("allReviewCount", allReviews.size());
            request.setAttribute("visibleReviewCount", visibleCount);
            request.setAttribute("hiddenReviewCount", hiddenCount);

            request.setAttribute("allReportCount", allReports.size());
            request.setAttribute("pendingReportCount", pendingCount);
            request.setAttribute("resolvedReportCount", resolvedCount);
            request.setAttribute("rejectedReportCount", rejectedCount);

            request.setAttribute("reviewStatusFilter", reviewStatus);
            request.setAttribute("reportStatusFilter", reportStatus);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/review/staff-list.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new ServletException("Không thể tải dữ liệu đánh giá.", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user = getStaff(request, response);

        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (!validToken(request)) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN,
                    "Phiên làm việc không hợp lệ. Vui lòng tải lại trang.");
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");
        boolean success;

        try {
            if ("visibility".equals(action)) {
                int reviewId =
                        Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("reviewId"));

                String hiddenParam = request.getParameter("hidden");

                if (!"true".equals(hiddenParam)
                        && !"false".equals(hiddenParam)) {
                    response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
                    return;
                }

                success = new StaffReviewDAO().setReviewHidden(
                        reviewId,
                        Boolean.parseBoolean(hiddenParam));

            } else if ("resolveReport".equals(action)) {
                int reportId =
                        Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("reportId"));

                String decision = request.getParameter("decision");

                if (!"HIDE".equals(decision)
                        && !"DISMISS".equals(decision)) {
                    response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
                    return;
                }

                success = new ReviewReportDAO().resolveReport(
                        reportId,
                        user.getUserId(),
                        decision);

            } else {
                response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
                return;
            }

            request.getSession().setAttribute(
                    success ? "successMessage" : "errorMessage",
                    success
                            ? "Thao tác kiểm duyệt thành công."
                            : "Không thể thực hiện thao tác; dữ liệu có thể đã thay đổi.");

            String url = request.getContextPath()
                    + "/staff/reviews?reviewStatus="
                    + reviewFilter(request.getParameter("reviewStatus"))
                    + "&reportStatus="
                    + reportFilter(request.getParameter("reportStatus"));

            response.sendRedirect(url);

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "ID không hợp lệ.");

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Không thể cập nhật đánh giá hoặc báo cáo.", e);
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.VoucherDAO;
import service.AuditLogService;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import model.User;
import model.Voucher;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;

@WebServlet(
        name = "VoucherServlet", urlPatterns = {"/staff/voucher"}
)
public class VoucherServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService
            = new AuditLogService();

    private VoucherDAO voucherDAO;

    private final DateTimeFormatter formatter
            = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(
                    "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm"
            );

    @Override
    public void init()
            throws ServletException {

        voucherDAO
                = new VoucherDAO();
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding(
                "UTF-8"
        );

        if (!checkStaff(
                request,
                response
        )) {

            return;
        }

        String view
                = request.getParameter(
                        "view"
                );

        if (view == null
                || view.trim().isEmpty()) {

            view = "list";
        }

        switch (view) {

            case "create":

                showCreate(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "edit":

                showEdit(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "delete":

                showDelete(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;
            case "usage":

                showUsage(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "list":

            default:

                showList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding(
                "UTF-8"
        );

        if (!checkStaff(
                request,
                response
        )) {

            return;
        }

        String action
                = request.getParameter(
                        "action"
                );

        if (action == null
                || action.trim().isEmpty()) {

            redirectList(
                    request,
                    response
            );

            return;
        }

        switch (action) {

            case "create":

                createVoucher(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "update":

                updateVoucher(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "delete":

                deleteVoucher(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            default:

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;
        }
    }

    private boolean checkStaff(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/login"
            );

            return false;
        }

        Object value
                = session.getAttribute(
                        "loggedInUser"
                );

        if (!(value instanceof User)) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/login"
            );

            return false;
        }

        User loggedInUser
                = (User) value;

        if (!loggedInUser.isStaff()) {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "toastMessage",
                    "Chỉ Staff mới có quyền quản lý Voucher!"
            );

            session.setAttribute(
                    "toastType",
                    "error"
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/home"
            );

            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private void showList(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String status = request.getParameter("status");

        if (status == null) {
            status = "all";
        }

        status = status.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (!"available".equals(status)
                && !"exhausted".equals(status)
                && !"upcoming".equals(status)
                && !"expired".equals(status)) {

            status = "all";
        }

        // Lấy danh sách voucher và trạng thái từ DAO
        List<Voucher> allVouchers = voucherDAO.getAllVouchers();
        List<Voucher> filteredVouchers = new ArrayList<>();

        int availableCount = 0;
        int exhaustedCount = 0;
        int upcomingCount = 0;
        int expiredCount = 0;

        for (Voucher voucher : allVouchers) {

            String voucherStatus
                    = voucher.getAvailabilityStatus();

            if ("AVAILABLE".equals(voucherStatus)) {
                availableCount++;
            }

            if ("EXHAUSTED".equals(voucherStatus)) {
                exhaustedCount++;
            }

            if ("UPCOMING".equals(voucherStatus)) {
                upcomingCount++;
            }

            if ("EXPIRED".equals(voucherStatus)) {
                expiredCount++;
            }

            // Chỉ đưa voucher đúng trạng thái vào danh sách
            if ("all".equals(status)
                    || status.equalsIgnoreCase(voucherStatus)) {

                filteredVouchers.add(voucher);
            }
        }

        request.setAttribute(
                "vouchers",
                filteredVouchers
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "totalVoucherCount",
                allVouchers.size()
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "voucherStatusFilter",
                status
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "availableVoucherCount",
                availableCount
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "exhaustedVoucherCount",
                exhaustedCount
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "upcomingVoucherCount",
                upcomingCount
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "expiredVoucherCount",
                expiredCount
        );

        // Giữ nguyên thống kê và lịch sử voucher
        request.setAttribute(
                "usedVoucherCount",
                voucherDAO.countUsedVouchers()
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "recentVoucherUsages",
                voucherDAO.getRecentVoucherUsages()
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/voucher/list.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    private void showUsage(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setAttribute(
                "voucherUsages",
                voucherDAO.getAllVoucherUsages()
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/voucher/usage.jsp"
        ).forward(
                request,
                response
        );
    }

    private void showCreate(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/voucher/create.jsp"
        ).forward(
                request,
                response
        );
    }

    private void createVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        try {

            Voucher voucher
                    = getVoucherFromRequest(
                            request
                    );

            String error
                    = validateVoucher(
                            voucher,
                            false
                    );

            if (error != null) {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        error
                );

                redirectCreate(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                return;
            }

            boolean success
                    = voucherDAO
                            .insertVoucher(
                                    voucher
                            );

            if (success) {

                setSuccessMessage(
                        request,
                        "Tạo Voucher thành công."
                );

                User loggedInUser
                        = (User) request.getSession()
                                .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                auditLogService.log(
                        loggedInUser,
                        "CREATE_VOUCHER",
                        "VOUCHER",
                        null,
                        "Created voucher: " + voucher.getCode(),
                        request
                );

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

            } else {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Không thể tạo Voucher."
                );

                redirectCreate(
                        request,
                        response
                );
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {

            e.printStackTrace();

            setErrorMessage(
                    request,
                    "Dữ liệu Voucher không hợp lệ."
            );

            redirectCreate(
                    request,
                    response
            );
        }
    }

    private void showEdit(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        try {

            int voucherId
                    = Integer.parseInt(
                            request.getParameter(
                                    "id"
                            )
                    );

            Voucher voucher
                    = voucherDAO
                            .getVoucherById(
                                    voucherId
                            );

            if (voucher == null) {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Không tìm thấy Voucher."
                );

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                return;
            }

            request.setAttribute(
                    "voucher",
                    voucher
            );

            if (voucher.getValidFrom()
                    != null) {

                request.setAttribute(
                        "validFromValue",
                        voucher
                                .getValidFrom()
                                .toLocalDateTime()
                                .format(
                                        formatter
                                )
                );
            }

            if (voucher.getValidTo()
                    != null) {

                request.setAttribute(
                        "validToValue",
                        voucher
                                .getValidTo()
                                .toLocalDateTime()
                                .format(
                                        formatter
                                )
                );
            }

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/voucher/edit.jsp"
            ).forward(
                    request,
                    response
            );

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {

            setErrorMessage(
                    request,
                    "ID Voucher không hợp lệ."
            );

            redirectList(
                    request,
                    response
            );
        }
    }

    private void updateVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        int voucherId = -1;

        try {

            voucherId
                    = Integer.parseInt(
                            request.getParameter(
                                    "voucherId"
                            )
                    );

            Voucher oldVoucher
                    = voucherDAO
                            .getVoucherById(
                                    voucherId
                            );

            if (oldVoucher == null) {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Voucher không tồn tại."
                );

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                return;
            }

            Voucher voucher
                    = getVoucherFromRequest(
                            request
                    );

            voucher.setVoucherId(
                    voucherId
            );

            String error
                    = validateVoucher(
                            voucher,
                            true
                    );

            if (error != null) {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        error
                );

                redirectEdit(
                        request,
                        response,
                        voucherId
                );

                return;
            }

            boolean success
                    = voucherDAO
                            .updateVoucher(
                                    voucher
                            );

            if (success) {

                setSuccessMessage(
                        request,
                        "Cập nhật Voucher thành công."
                );

                User loggedInUser
                        = (User) request.getSession()
                                .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                auditLogService.log(
                        loggedInUser,
                        "UPDATE_VOUCHER",
                        "VOUCHER",
                        null,
                        "Updated voucher: " + voucher.getCode(),
                        request
                );

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

            } else {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Cập nhật Voucher thất bại."
                );

                redirectEdit(
                        request,
                        response,
                        voucherId
                );
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {

            e.printStackTrace();

            setErrorMessage(
                    request,
                    "Dữ liệu Voucher không hợp lệ."
            );

            if (voucherId > 0) {

                redirectEdit(
                        request,
                        response,
                        voucherId
                );

            } else {

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private void showDelete(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        try {

            int voucherId
                    = Integer.parseInt(
                            request.getParameter(
                                    "id"
                            )
                    );

            Voucher voucher
                    = voucherDAO
                            .getVoucherById(
                                    voucherId
                            );

            if (voucher == null) {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Không tìm thấy Voucher."
                );

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                return;
            }

            request.setAttribute(
                    "voucher",
                    voucher
            );

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/voucher/delete.jsp"
            ).forward(
                    request,
                    response
            );

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {

            setErrorMessage(
                    request,
                    "ID Voucher không hợp lệ."
            );

            redirectList(
                    request,
                    response
            );
        }
    }

    private void deleteVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        try {

            int voucherId
                    = Integer.parseInt(
                            request.getParameter(
                                    "voucherId"
                            )
                    );

            Voucher voucher
                    = voucherDAO
                            .getVoucherById(
                                    voucherId
                            );

            if (voucher == null) {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Voucher không tồn tại."
                );

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                return;
            }

            boolean success
                    = voucherDAO
                            .deleteVoucher(
                                    voucherId
                            );

            if (success) {

                setSuccessMessage(
                        request,
                        "Xóa Voucher thành công."
                );

                User loggedInUser
                        = (User) request.getSession()
                                .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                auditLogService.log(
                        loggedInUser,
                        "DELETE_VOUCHER",
                        "VOUCHER",
                        null,
                        "Deleted voucher: " + voucher.getCode(),
                        request
                );

            } else {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        "Không thể xóa Voucher."
                );
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {

            e.printStackTrace();

            setErrorMessage(
                    request,
                    "Không thể xóa Voucher. "
                    + "Voucher có thể đã được sử dụng trong đơn hàng."
            );
        }

        redirectList(
                request,
                response
        );
    }

    private Voucher getVoucherFromRequest(
            HttpServletRequest request) {

        Voucher voucher
                = new Voucher();

        String code
                = request.getParameter(
                        "code"
                );

        if (code != null) {

            code
                    = code.trim()
                            .toUpperCase();
        }

        voucher.setCode(
                code
        );

        String discountType
                = request.getParameter(
                        "discountType"
                );

        if (discountType != null) {

            discountType
                    = discountType
                            .trim()
                            .toUpperCase();
        }

        voucher.setDiscountType(
                discountType
        );

        double discountValue
                = Double.parseDouble(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "discountValue"
                        )
                );

        voucher.setDiscountValue(
                discountValue
        );

        double minOrderValue
                = Double.parseDouble(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "minOrderValue"
                        )
                );

        voucher.setMinOrderValue(
                minOrderValue
        );

        Timestamp validFrom
                = parseTimestamp(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "validFrom"
                        )
                );

        voucher.setValidFrom(
                validFrom
        );

        Timestamp validTo
                = parseTimestamp(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "validTo"
                        )
                );

        voucher.setValidTo(
                validTo
        );
        ;

        Double maxDiscount
                = parseNullableDouble(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "maxDiscount"
                        )
                );

        if ("AMOUNT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                discountType
        )) {

            voucher.setMaxDiscount(
                    null
            );

        } else {

            voucher.setMaxDiscount(
                    maxDiscount
            );
        }

        Integer usageLimit
                = parseNullableInteger(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "usageLimit"
                        )
                );

        voucher.setUsageLimit(
                usageLimit
        );

        Integer perUserLimit
                = parseNullableInteger(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "perUserLimit"
                        )
                );

        voucher.setPerUserLimit(
                perUserLimit
        );

        return voucher;
    }

    private String validateVoucher(
            Voucher voucher,
            boolean isUpdate) {

        if (voucher.getCode() == null
                || voucher.getCode()
                        .trim()
                        .isEmpty()) {

            return "Mã Voucher không được để trống.";
        }

        boolean duplicate;

        if (isUpdate) {

            duplicate
                    = voucherDAO
                            .existsCodeExceptId(
                                    voucher.getCode(),
                                    voucher.getVoucherId()
                            );

        } else {

            duplicate
                    = voucherDAO
                            .existsCode(
                                    voucher.getCode()
                            );
        }

        if (duplicate) {

            return "Mã Voucher đã tồn tại.";
        }

        if (!"AMOUNT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                voucher.getDiscountType()
        )
                && !"PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                        voucher.getDiscountType()
                )) {

            return "Loại giảm giá không hợp lệ.";
        }

        if (voucher.getDiscountValue()
                <= 0) {

            return "Giá trị giảm phải lớn hơn 0.";
        }

        if ("PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                voucher.getDiscountType()
        )
                && voucher.getDiscountValue()
                > 100) {

            return "Phần trăm giảm không được vượt quá 100%.";
        }

        if ("PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                voucher.getDiscountType()
        )
                && voucher.getMaxDiscount()
                != null
                && voucher.getMaxDiscount()
                <= 0) {

            return "Giảm tối đa phải lớn hơn 0.";
        }

        if (voucher.getMinOrderValue()
                < 0) {

            return "Giá trị đơn tối thiểu không hợp lệ.";
        }

        if (voucher.getValidFrom()
                == null
                || voucher.getValidTo()
                == null) {

            return "Thời gian Voucher không hợp lệ.";
        }

        if (!voucher
                .getValidTo()
                .after(
                        voucher.getValidFrom()
                )) {

            return "Thời gian kết thúc phải sau thời gian bắt đầu.";
        }

        if (voucher.getUsageLimit()
                != null
                && voucher.getUsageLimit()
                <= 0) {

            return "Tổng lượt sử dụng phải lớn hơn 0.";
        }

        if (voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                != null
                && voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                <= 0) {

            return "Giới hạn mỗi User phải lớn hơn 0.";
        }

        if (voucher.getUsageLimit()
                != null
                && voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                != null
                && voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                > voucher.getUsageLimit()) {

            return "Giới hạn mỗi User không được lớn hơn tổng lượt sử dụng.";
        }

        return null;
    }

    private Timestamp parseTimestamp(
            String value) {

        if (value == null
                || value.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        LocalDateTime dateTime
                = LocalDateTime.parse(
                        value,
                        formatter
                );

        return Timestamp.valueOf(
                dateTime
        );
    }

    private Double parseNullableDouble(
            String value) {

        if (value == null
                || value.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        return Double.parseDouble(
                value.trim()
        );
    }

    private Integer parseNullableInteger(
            String value) {

        if (value == null
                || value.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        return Integer.parseInt(
                value.trim()
        );
    }

    private void setSuccessMessage(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String message) {

        request.getSession()
                .setAttribute(
                        "successMessage",
                        message
                );
    }

    private void setErrorMessage(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String message) {

        request.getSession()
                .setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        message
                );
    }

    private void redirectList(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/staff/voucher"
        );
    }

    private void redirectCreate(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/staff/voucher?view=create"
        );
    }

    private void redirectEdit(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            int voucherId)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/staff/voucher?view=edit&id="
                + voucherId
        );
    }
}
package controller.admin;

import dao.DashboardDAO;
import model.OrderStatistics;
import service.ReportService;
import service.ReportService.Range;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Map;

@WebServlet(name = "DashboardServlet", urlPatterns = "/admin/dashboard")
public class AdminDashboardServlet extends HttpServlet {

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        Range range;
        String dateError = null;
        try {
            range = ReportService.parseRange(request.getParameter("startDate"),
                    request.getParameter("endDate"));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            dateError = e.getMessage();
            range = ReportService.parseRange(null, null);
        }

        try {
            boolean byMonth = "month".equals(request.getParameter("groupBy"));
            DashboardDAO dashboardDAO = new DashboardDAO();
            OrderStatistics data = dashboardDAO.getOrderStatistics(range.start, range.end, byMonth);
            Map<String, Integer> stock = dashboardDAO.getCurrentStockStatistics();
            Map<String, Integer> processing = dashboardDAO.getProcessingOrderStatistics();

            request.setAttribute("totalRevenue", data.getRevenue());
            request.setAttribute("totalOrders", data.getTotalOrders());
            request.setAttribute("completedOrders", data.getCompletedOrders());
            request.setAttribute("cancelledOrders", data.getCancelledOrders());
            request.setAttribute("groupBy", byMonth ? "month" : "day");
            request.setAttribute("revenueByDate", data.getRevenueByPeriod());
            processing.forEach(request::setAttribute);
            stock.forEach(request::setAttribute);
            request.setAttribute("topSellingProducts", data.getTopProducts());
            request.setAttribute("lowStockProducts", dashboardDAO.getLowStockProducts());
            request.setAttribute("startDate", range.start.toString());
            request.setAttribute("endDate", range.end.toString());
            request.setAttribute("dateError", dateError);
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/admin/dashboard.jsp").forward(request, response);
        } catch (IllegalStateException e) {
            throw new ServletException("Không thể tải thống kê Dashboard từ SQL Server.", e);
        }
    }
}
package controller.admin;

import dao.AdminOrderDAO;
import model.Order;
import model.User;
import service.AuditLogService;
import service.OrderWorkflowService;
import service.OrderService;
import service.OrderStatusPolicy;
import java.util.UUID;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "AdminOrderServlet", urlPatterns = "/admin/orders/*")
public class AdminOrderServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final OrderWorkflowService orderWorkflow = new OrderWorkflowService();
    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(AdminOrderServlet.class.getName());

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService = new AuditLogService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        AdminOrderDAO orderDAO = new AdminOrderDAO();
        request.setAttribute("statusLabels", OrderService.statusLabels());
        String path = request.getPathInfo();
        if (request.getSession().getAttribute("staffOrderToken") == null) {
            request.getSession().setAttribute("staffOrderToken", UUID.randomUUID().toString());
        }

        if ("/detail".equals(path)) {
            try {
                int orderId = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                Order order = orderDAO.getById(orderId);
                if (order == null) { response.sendError(404, "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."); return; }
                String status = OrderService.normalizeStatus(order.getOrderStatus());
                boolean pendingCancel = "PENDING".equals(order.getCancelRequestStatus());
                request.setAttribute("pendingCancel", pendingCancel);
                request.setAttribute("canAdvanceOrder",
                        !pendingCancel && OrderStatusPolicy.nextStatus(status) != null);
                request.setAttribute("canStaffCancel",
                        !pendingCancel && OrderWorkflowService.canCancel(status));
                boolean closed = "CANCELLED".equals(status) || "EXPIRED".equals(status);
                if (closed && "PAID".equals(order.getPaymentStatus()) && order.getTotalAmount().signum() > 0) {
                    request.setAttribute("needsManualRefund", true);
                    request.setAttribute("successfulPayments", orderDAO.getSuccessfulPayments(orderId));
                }

                request.setAttribute("order", order);
                request.setAttribute("history", orderDAO.getHistory(orderId));
                request.setAttribute("items", orderDAO.getItemsByOrderId(orderId));
                request.setAttribute("status", status);

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/admin/order-detail.jsp").forward(request, response);
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "Order ID không hợp lệ khi xem chi tiết!", e);

                response.sendError(400,"Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ.");
            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi tải thông tin chi tiết đơn hàng!", e);

                throw new ServletException("Không tải được chi tiết đơn hàng.",e);
            }
        } else {
            try {
                List<Order> orders = orderDAO.getList();

                request.setAttribute("orders", orders);

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/admin/orders.jsp").forward(request, response);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi lấy danh sách đơn hàng!", e);

                throw new ServletException("Không tải được danh sách đơn hàng.",e);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        int orderId;

        try {
            orderId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("orderId"));
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/admin/orders");
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");
        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        Object expected = session.getAttribute("staffOrderToken");
        if (!(expected instanceof String) || !expected.equals(request.getParameter("csrfToken"))) {
            response.sendError(403, "Yêu cầu không hợp lệ. Vui lòng tải lại trang.");
            return;
        }

        User staff = (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");
        boolean cancellation = "cancel".equals(action) || "approveCancel".equals(action)
                || "rejectCancel".equals(action);
        try {
            String message;
            if (cancellation) {
                message = cancelOrder(request, staff, orderId, action);
            } else {
                String nextStatus = orderWorkflow.advanceOrder(
                        staff.getUserId(), orderId, action, request.getParameter("expectedStatus"));
                message = statusSuccessMessage(nextStatus);
                auditStaffAction(staff, orderId, "UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS", "Changed order status to " + nextStatus, request);
            }
            session.setAttribute("successMessage", message);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            session.setAttribute("errorMessage", e.getMessage());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi xử lý đơn hàng #" + orderId, e);
            session.setAttribute("errorMessage", cancellation
                    ? "Chưa xử lý được yêu cầu. Vui lòng tải lại đơn và thử lại."
                    : "Thao tác thất bại! Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.");
        }

        response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/admin/orders/detail?id=" + orderId);
    }

    private void auditStaffAction(User staff, int orderId, String action, String details, HttpServletRequest request) {
        try {
            if (!auditLogService.log(staff, action, "ORDER", (long) orderId, details, request)) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "Không ghi được audit log cho đơn hàng #{0}", orderId);
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "Lỗi ghi audit log cho đơn hàng #" + orderId, e);
        }
    }

    private String statusSuccessMessage(String status) {
        switch (status) {
            case "CONFIRMED":
                return "Xác nhận đơn hàng thành công!";
            case "PACKING":
                return "Đơn hàng đã chuyển sang đóng gói!";
            case "SHIPPING":
                return "Đơn hàng đã chuyển sang giao hàng!";
            case "COMPLETED":
                return "Đơn hàng đã hoàn thành!";
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported order status: " + status);
        }
    }

    private String cancelOrder(HttpServletRequest request, User staff, int orderId, String action)
            throws SQLException {
        String reason = request.getParameter("reason");
        String result = "cancel".equals(action)
                ? orderWorkflow.staffCancel(staff.getUserId(), orderId, reason)
                : orderWorkflow.review(staff.getUserId(), orderId, "approveCancel".equals(action),
                        reason, request.getParameter("cancelRequestVersion"));
        auditStaffAction(staff, orderId, "CANCEL_ORDER", "Staff cancellation: " + result, request);

        switch (result) {
            case "REJECTED":
                return "Đã từ chối yêu cầu hủy.";
            case "UNCHANGED":
                return "Đơn hàng đã được hủy trước đó.";
            default:
                return "Đã hủy đơn hàng thành công.";
        }
    }
}

import dao.AuditLogDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
