package controller.admin;

import model.SalesReport;
import model.User;
import service.AuditLogService;
import service.ReportService;
import service.ReportService.Range;
import service.ExcelReportExporter;
import service.PdfReportExporter;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "ReportExportServlet",
        urlPatterns = "/admin/report/export"
)
public class ReportExportServlet extends HttpServlet {
    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(ReportExportServlet.class.getName());

    private static final String FONT_REGULAR = "/WEB-INF/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf";
    private static final String FONT_BOLD = "/WEB-INF/fonts/NotoSans-Bold.ttf";

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService = new AuditLogService();
    private final ReportService reportService = new ReportService();
    private final ExcelReportExporter excelExporter = new ExcelReportExporter();
    private final PdfReportExporter pdfExporter = new PdfReportExporter();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        String format = request.getParameter("format");
        format = format == null || format.trim().isEmpty()
                ? "excel"
                : format.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (!"excel".equals(format) && !"pdf".equals(format)) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST, "Định dạng xuất không hợp lệ.");
            return;
        }

        Range range;
        try {
            range = ReportService.parseRange(
                    request.getParameter("startDate"), request.getParameter("endDate"));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST, e.getMessage());
            return;
        }

        try {
            SalesReport report = reportService.loadFullReport(range.start, range.end);
            BigDecimal averageOrderValue = ReportService.calculateAverageOrderValue(
                    report.getRevenue(), report.getRevenueOrders());

            boolean pdf = "pdf".equals(format);
            response.setContentType(pdf ? "application/pdf"
                    : "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet");
            response.setHeader("Content-Disposition",
                    "attachment; filename=\"OECS_BaoCaoKinhDoanh." + (pdf ? "pdf" : "xlsx") + "\"");

            if (pdf) {
                try (InputStream regular = getServletContext().getResourceAsStream(FONT_REGULAR);
                        InputStream bold = getServletContext().getResourceAsStream(FONT_BOLD)) {
                    pdfExporter.write(response.getOutputStream(), range, report, averageOrderValue, regular, bold);
                }
            } else {
                excelExporter.write(response.getOutputStream(), range, report, averageOrderValue);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi xuất báo cáo OECS", e);

            if (!response.isCommitted()) {
                response.reset();
                throw new ServletException("Không thể xuất báo cáo.", e);
            }

            throw new IOException("Lỗi khi xuất báo cáo.", e);
        }
        auditExport(request, format, range);
    }

    private void auditExport(HttpServletRequest request, String format, Range range) {
        try {
            User user = (User) request.getSession().getAttribute("loggedInUser");
            String description = "Exported revenue report as " + format.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)
                    + " from " + range.start + " to " + range.end;
            if (!auditLogService.log(user, "EXPORT_REPORT", "REPORT", null, description, request)) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "Không ghi được nhật ký xuất báo cáo.");
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "Không ghi được nhật ký xuất báo cáo.", e);
        }
    }
}
package controller.admin;

import model.SalesReport;
import service.ReportService;
import service.ReportService.Range;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "ReportServlet", urlPatterns = "/admin/report")
public class ReportServlet extends HttpServlet {
    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(ReportServlet.class.getName());
    private final ReportService reportService = new ReportService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        String start = request.getParameter("startDate");
        String end = request.getParameter("endDate");
        String filterError = null;
        Range range = null;
        try {
            range = ReportService.parseRange(start, end);
            start = range.start.toString();
            end = range.end.toString();
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            filterError = e.getMessage();
        }

        try {
            SalesReport data = range == null ? new SalesReport()
                    : reportService.loadFullReport(range.start, range.end);
            request.setAttribute("totalRevenue", data.getRevenue());
            request.setAttribute("totalOrders", data.getTotalOrders());
            request.setAttribute("revenueOrders", data.getRevenueOrders());
            request.setAttribute("totalProductsSold", data.getProductsSold());
            request.setAttribute("averageOrderValue",
                    ReportService.calculateAverageOrderValue(data.getRevenue(), data.getRevenueOrders()));
            request.setAttribute("revenueByDate", data.getRevenueByDate());
            request.setAttribute("orderStatusStats", data.getStatuses());
            request.setAttribute("topSellingProducts", data.getTopProducts());
            request.setAttribute("inventory", data.getInventory());
            request.setAttribute("payments", data.getPayments());
            request.setAttribute("startDate", start);
            request.setAttribute("endDate", end);
            request.setAttribute("filterError", filterError);
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/admin/report.jsp").forward(request, response);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Error loading Report page", e);
            throw new ServletException("Cannot load Report page.", e);
        }
    }
}
package controller.admin;

import dao.UserDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import model.User;
import service.AuditLogService;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.UUID;

import service.EmailService;
import service.PasswordResetService;

@WebServlet(name = "UserServlet", urlPatterns = {"/user"})
public class UserServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(UserServlet.class.getName());

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService = new AuditLogService();
    private final PasswordResetService passwordResetService = new PasswordResetService();
    private final EmailService emailService = new EmailService();

    private boolean checkPermission(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return false;
        }

        User loggedInUser = (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (loggedInUser == null) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return false;
        }

        if (!loggedInUser.isAdmin()) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/home");
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        if (!checkPermission(request, response)) {
            return;
        }

        String view = request.getParameter("view");

        UserDAO dao = new UserDAO();
        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        if (view == null || "list".equals(view)) {

            String keyword = request.getParameter("keyword");
            String roleIdParam = request.getParameter("roleId");
            String status = request.getParameter("status");
            String sort = request.getParameter("sort");

            keyword = keyword != null ? keyword.trim() : "";
            status = status != null ? status.trim() : "";
            sort = sort != null ? sort.trim() : "newest";

// Chuyen roleId tu String sang Integer.
            Integer roleId = null;

            if (roleIdParam != null
                    && !roleIdParam.trim().isEmpty()) {

                try {

                    roleId = Integer.valueOf(roleIdParam.trim());

                    if (roleId <= 0) {
                        response.sendError(
                                HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                                "Role ID khong hop le."
                        );
                        return;
                    }

                } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {

                    response.sendError(
                            HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                            "Role ID khong hop le."
                    );
                    return;
                }
            }

// Loc nguoi dung theo role_id.
            List<User> userList = dao.getAllUsers(
                    keyword,
                    roleId,
                    status,
                    sort
            );

// Lay danh sach Role cho dropdown tren JSP.
            request.setAttribute(
                    "roleList",
                    dao.getAllRoles()
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "userList",
                    userList
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "keyword",
                    keyword
            );

            request.setAttribute("roleId", roleId);

            request.setAttribute(
                    "status",
                    status
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "sort",
                    sort
            );
            request.setAttribute("keyword", keyword);
            request.setAttribute("message", session.getAttribute("message"));
            request.setAttribute("error", session.getAttribute("error"));

            session.removeAttribute("message");
            session.removeAttribute("error");

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/user/list.jsp").forward(request, response);

        } else if ("create".equals(view)) {

            request.setAttribute("roleList", dao.getAllRoles());

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/user/create.jsp").forward(request, response);

        } else {

            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        if (!checkPermission(request, response)) {
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        UserDAO dao = new UserDAO();
        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        if ("create".equals(action)) {

            String username = request.getParameter("username");
            String email = request.getParameter("email");
            String phone = request.getParameter("phone");
            String roleIdParam = request.getParameter("roleId");

            username = username != null ? username.trim() : "";
            email = email != null ? email.trim() : "";
            phone = phone != null ? phone.trim() : "";

            try {

                if (username.isEmpty()
                        || email.isEmpty()
                        || roleIdParam == null
                        || roleIdParam.isEmpty()) {

                    session.setAttribute("error", "Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ thông tin!");

                    response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=create");
                    return;
                }

                int roleId = Integer.parseInt(roleIdParam);

                if (dao.checkUserExist(username, email)) {

                    session.setAttribute("error", "Username hoặc Email đã tồn tại!");

                    response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=create");
                    return;
                }

                User newUser = new User();

                newUser.setUsername(username);
                newUser.setEmail(email);
                newUser.setPhone(phone);
                newUser.setRoleId(roleId);

                String temporaryPassword = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                        + UUID.randomUUID().toString();

                boolean success = dao.createUser(newUser, temporaryPassword);

                if (!success) {

                    session.setAttribute("error", "Tạo tài khoản thất bại!");

                    response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=create");
                    return;
                }

                User createdUser = dao.findByEmail(email);

                String token = passwordResetService.createResetToken(email, 24 * 60);

                boolean emailSent = false;

                if (token != null) {

                    String setupLink = buildResetLink(request, token);

                    emailSent = emailService.sendAccountSetupEmail(email, setupLink);
                }

                if (emailSent) {

                    session.setAttribute(
                            "message",
                            "Tạo tài khoản thành công! "
                            + "Liên kết thiết lập mật khẩu "
                            + "đã được gửi đến email người dùng."
                    );

                } else {

                    session.setAttribute(
                            "message",
                            "Tài khoản đã được tạo, "
                            + "nhưng không thể gửi email "
                            + "thiết lập mật khẩu."
                    );
                }

                User loggedInUser = (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                Long createdUserId = createdUser != null
                        ? (long) createdUser.getUserId()
                        : null;

                auditLogService.log(
                        loggedInUser,
                        "CREATE_USER",
                        "USER",
                        createdUserId,
                        "Created new user account: " + username,
                        request
                );

                response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");
                return;

            } catch (Exception e) {

                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi tạo User!", e);

                session.setAttribute("error", "Lỗi khi tạo tài khoản!");

                response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=create");
                return;
            }

        } else if ("toggleStatus".equals(action)) {

            try {

                int id = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("id"));

                boolean active = Boolean.parseBoolean(request.getParameter("active"));

                User loggedInUser = (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                if (loggedInUser != null && loggedInUser.getUserId() == id) {

                    session.setAttribute("error", "Không thể khóa tài khoản "
                            + "đang đăng nhập!");

                    response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");
                    return;
                }

                User selectedUser = dao.getUserById(id);

                if (selectedUser == null) {

                    session.setAttribute("error", "Không tìm thấy tài khoản!");

                    response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");
                    return;
                }

                boolean success = dao.updateUserStatus(id, active);

                if (success) {

                    if (active) {

                        session.setAttribute("message", "Mở khóa tài khoản thành công!");

                        auditLogService.log(
                                loggedInUser,
                                "UNLOCK_USER",
                                "USER",
                                (long) id,
                                "Unlocked user account: " + selectedUser.getUsername(),
                                request
                        );

                    } else {

                        session.setAttribute("message", "Khóa tài khoản thành công!");

                        auditLogService.log(
                                loggedInUser,
                                "LOCK_USER",
                                "USER",
                                (long) id,
                                "Locked user account: " + selectedUser.getUsername(),
                                request
                        );
                    }

                } else {

                    session.setAttribute("error", "Cập nhật trạng thái tài khoản thất bại!");
                }

                response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");

            } catch (Exception e) {

                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi cập nhật trạng thái User!", e);

                session.setAttribute("error", "Lỗi khi cập nhật trạng thái tài khoản!");

                response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");
            }

        } else {

            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/user?view=list");
        }
    }

    private String buildResetLink(HttpServletRequest request, String token) {

        StringBuilder url = new StringBuilder();

        url.append(request.getScheme())
                .append("://")
                .append(request.getServerName());

        int port = request.getServerPort();

        boolean defaultHttpPort = request.getScheme().equals("http")
                && port == 80;

        boolean defaultHttpsPort = request.getScheme().equals("https")
                && port == 443;

        if (!defaultHttpPort && !defaultHttpsPort) {
            url.append(":").append(port);
        }

        url.append(request.getContextPath())
                .append("/reset-password?token=")
                .append(
                        URLEncoder.encode(
                                token,
                                StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                        )
                );

        return url.toString();
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import model.Address;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class AddressDAO {
    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public AddressDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public AddressDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    private Connection getConnection() throws SQLException {
        Connection conn = connections.open();
        if (conn == null) throw new SQLException("Khong ket noi duoc database.");
        return conn;
    }

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(AddressDAO.class.getName());

    public List<Address> getAddressesByUser(int userId) {
        List<Address> addresses = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT address_id, user_id, recipient_name, "
                + "phone_number, address_line, is_default "
                + "FROM dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 "
                + "ORDER BY is_default DESC, address_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    addresses.add(mapAddress(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Loi lay danh sach dia chi!", e);
        }

        return addresses;
    }

    public Address getAddressById(int addressId, int userId) {
        String sql = "SELECT address_id, user_id, recipient_name, "
                + "phone_number, address_line, is_default "
                + "FROM dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "WHERE address_id = ? AND user_id = ? "
                + "AND is_deleted = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, addressId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapAddress(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Loi lay dia chi theo ID!", e);
        }

        return null;
    }

    public int insertAddress(
            int userId,
            String recipientName,
            String phoneNumber,
            String addressLine
    ) {
        if (userId <= 0
                || recipientName == null
                || phoneNumber == null
                || addressLine == null
                || recipientName.trim().isEmpty()
                || recipientName.trim().length() > 100
                || !phoneNumber.trim().matches("[0-9]{9,11}")
                || addressLine.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return -1;
        }

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "(user_id, recipient_name, phone_number, "
                + "address_line, is_default, is_deleted) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0, 0)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                sql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setString(2, recipientName.trim());
            ps.setString(3, phoneNumber.trim());
            ps.setString(4, addressLine.trim());

            int rows = ps.executeUpdate();

            if (rows == 1) {
                try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                    if (rs.next()) {
                        return rs.getInt(1);
                    }
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Loi them dia chi!", e);
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public boolean updateAddress(
            int addressId,
            int userId,
            String recipientName,
            String phoneNumber,
            String addressLine
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (addressId <= 0
                || userId <= 0
                || recipientName == null
                || recipientName.trim().isEmpty()
                || recipientName.trim().length() > 100
                || phoneNumber == null
                || !phoneNumber.trim().matches("[0-9]{9,11}")
                || addressLine == null
                || addressLine.trim().isEmpty()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Thông tin địa chỉ không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "SET recipient_name = ?, phone_number = ?, address_line = ? "
                + "WHERE address_id = ? AND user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException("Khong the ket noi database.");
            }

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                ps.setString(1, recipientName.trim());
                ps.setString(2, phoneNumber.trim());
                ps.setString(3, addressLine.trim());
                ps.setInt(4, addressId);
                ps.setInt(5, userId);

                return ps.executeUpdate() == 1;
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean deleteAddress(int addressId, int userId) {
        if (addressId <= 0 || userId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "SET is_deleted = 1, is_default = 0 "
                + "WHERE address_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ? "
                + "AND is_deleted = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, addressId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() == 1;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Loi xoa dia chi!", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean setDefaultAddress(int addressId, int userId)
            throws SQLException {
        String checkSql = "SELECT address_id FROM dbo.ADDRESSBOOK WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE address_id = ? AND user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0";
        String updateSql = "UPDATE dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "SET is_default = CASE WHEN address_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException("Khong the ket noi database.");
            }
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);
            try (PreparedStatement check = conn.prepareStatement(checkSql);
                    PreparedStatement update = conn.prepareStatement(updateSql)) {
                try (PreparedStatement owner = conn.prepareStatement(
                        "SELECT user_id FROM dbo.[USER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE user_id = ?")) {
                    owner.setInt(1, userId);
                    try (ResultSet rs = owner.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) { conn.rollback(); return false; }
                    }
                }
                check.setInt(1, addressId);
                check.setInt(2, userId);
                try (ResultSet rs = check.executeQuery()) {
                    if (!rs.next()) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                update.setInt(1, addressId);
                update.setInt(2, userId);
                update.executeUpdate();
                conn.commit();
                return true;
            } catch (SQLException e) {
                conn.rollback();
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    private Address mapAddress(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
        Address address = new Address();

        address.setAddressId(rs.getInt("address_id"));
        address.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
        address.setRecipientName(rs.getString("recipient_name"));
        address.setPhoneNumber(rs.getString("phone_number"));
        address.setAddressLine(rs.getString("address_line"));
        address.setDefaultAddress(rs.getBoolean("is_default"));

        return address;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Order;
import model.OrderItem;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class AdminOrderDAO extends DBContext {

    public List<Order> getList() {
        List<Order> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, o.recipient_name, "
                + "o.total_amount, o.shipping_fee, o.created_at, o.order_status, o.payment_status, "
                + "o.cancel_request_status "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.order_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapOrderSummary(rs));
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Không tải được dữ liệu đơn hàng.", ex);
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Order getById(int id) {
        String sql = "SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, o.recipient_name, "
                + "o.total_amount, o.shipping_fee, o.created_at, o.order_status, o.payment_status, "
                + "o.cancel_request_status, o.cancel_request_reason, o.cancel_review_note, "
                + "o.address_id, o.discount_amount, o.recipient_phone, o.shipping_address, "
                + "CONVERT(VARCHAR(33), o.cancel_requested_at, 126) AS cancel_request_version, "
                + "o.payment_method "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    Order order = mapOrderSummary(rs);
                    order.setAddressId(rs.getInt("address_id"));
                    order.setDiscountAmount(rs.getBigDecimal("discount_amount"));
                    order.setRecipientPhone(rs.getString("recipient_phone"));
                    order.setShippingAddress(rs.getString("shipping_address"));
                    order.setPaymentMethod(rs.getString("payment_method"));
                    order.setCancelRequestReason(rs.getString("cancel_request_reason"));
                    order.setCancelReviewNote(rs.getString("cancel_review_note"));
                    order.setCancelRequestVersion(rs.getString("cancel_request_version"));
                    return order;
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Không tải được dữ liệu đơn hàng.", ex);
        }

        return null;
    }

    public List<OrderItem> getItemsByOrderId(int orderId) {
        List<OrderItem> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.order_id, oi.sku_id, oi.price, oi.quantity, "
                + "COALESCE(oi.product_name_snapshot,p.product_name) AS product_name, "
                + "COALESCE(oi.sku_code_snapshot,s.sku_code) AS sku_code, "
                + "s.stock_quantity "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON oi.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON s.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "WHERE oi.order_id = ? ORDER BY oi.order_item_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, orderId);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    OrderItem item = new OrderItem();

                    item.setOrderItemId(
                            rs.getInt("order_item_id")
                    );

                    item.setOrderId(
                            rs.getInt("order_id")
                    );

                    item.setSkuId(
                            rs.getInt("sku_id")
                    );

                    item.setPrice(
                            rs.getBigDecimal("price")
                    );

                    item.setQuantity(
                            rs.getInt("quantity")
                    );
                    item.setProductName(rs.getString("product_name"));
                    item.setSkuCode(rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    item.setStockQuantity(rs.getInt("stock_quantity"));

                    list.add(item);
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Không tải được dữ liệu đơn hàng.", ex);
        }

        return list;
    }

    private Order mapOrderSummary(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
        Order order = new Order();
        order.setOrderId(rs.getInt("order_id"));
        order.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
        order.setRecipientName(rs.getString("recipient_name"));
        order.setTotalAmount(rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount"));
        order.setShippingFee(rs.getBigDecimal("shipping_fee"));
        order.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
        order.setOrderStatus(rs.getString("order_status"));
        order.setPaymentStatus(rs.getString("payment_status"));
        order.setCancelRequestStatus(rs.getString("cancel_request_status"));
        return order;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getSuccessfulPayments(int orderId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT payment_method, amount, transaction_code, provider_transaction_id "
                + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION WHERE order_id = ? AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND amount > 0 "
                + "ORDER BY transaction_id";
        List<Map<String, Object>> payments = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection connection = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, orderId);
            try (ResultSet rows = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rows.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> payment = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    payment.put("method", rows.getString("payment_method"));
                    payment.put("amount", rows.getBigDecimal("amount"));
                    payment.put("reference", rows.getString("transaction_code"));
                    payment.put("providerReference", rows.getString("provider_transaction_id"));
                    payments.add(payment);
                }
            }
        }
        return payments;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getHistory(int orderId) {
        String sql = "SELECT status, old_status, reason, actor_type, changed_by, updated_at "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? ORDER BY updated_at DESC, status_id DESC";
        List<Map<String, Object>> history = new ArrayList<>();

        try (Connection connection = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, orderId);
            try (ResultSet rows = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rows.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> entry = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    entry.put("status", rows.getString("status"));
                    entry.put("oldStatus", rows.getString("old_status"));
                    entry.put("reason", rows.getString("reason"));
                    entry.put("actor", rows.getString("actor_type"));
                    entry.put("changedBy", rows.getObject("changed_by"));
                    entry.put("updatedAt", rows.getTimestamp("updated_at"));
                    history.add(entry);
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Không tải được lịch sử đơn hàng.", e);
        }

        return history;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Attribute;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class AttributeDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(AttributeDAO.class.getName());

    private static final String ATTRIBUTE_COLUMNS
            = "attribute_id, attribute_name, "
            + "data_type, unit, is_active ";

    private Attribute mapAttribute(ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        return new Attribute(
                rs.getInt("attribute_id"),
                rs.getString("attribute_name"),
                rs.getString("data_type"),
                rs.getString("unit"),
                rs.getBoolean("is_active")
        );
    }

    public List<Attribute> getList() {

        List<Attribute> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + ATTRIBUTE_COLUMNS
                + "FROM ATTRIBUTE "
                + "ORDER BY attribute_name, attribute_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapAttribute(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get attribute list",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get attribute list", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Attribute> getActiveAttributes() {

        List<Attribute> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + ATTRIBUTE_COLUMNS
                + "FROM ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY attribute_name, attribute_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapAttribute(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get active attributes",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get active attributes", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Attribute getById(int attributeId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + ATTRIBUTE_COLUMNS
                + "FROM ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE attribute_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, attributeId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapAttribute(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get attribute by ID",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get attribute by ID", ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    public List<Attribute> searchByName(String keyword) {

        List<Attribute> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + ATTRIBUTE_COLUMNS
                + "FROM ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE attribute_name LIKE ? "
                + "ORDER BY attribute_name, attribute_id";

        String pattern = "%"
                + (keyword == null ? "" : keyword.trim())
                + "%";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, pattern);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapAttribute(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot search attributes",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot search attributes", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public boolean isNameExists(String attributeName) {

        return isNameExists(attributeName, 0);
    }

    public boolean isNameExists(
            String attributeName,
            int excludeAttributeId) {

        if (attributeName == null
                || attributeName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(attribute_name))) "
                + "= LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(?))) "
                + "AND attribute_id <> ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, attributeName.trim());
            ps.setInt(2, excludeAttributeId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot check duplicate attribute name",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot check attribute name", ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int insert(Attribute attribute) {

        if (!isValidAttribute(attribute)) {
            return 0;
        }

        if (isNameExists(attribute.getAttributeName())) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO ATTRIBUTE "
                + "(attribute_name, data_type, unit, is_active) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(
                    1,
                    attribute.getAttributeName().trim()
            );

            ps.setString(
                    2,
                    attribute.getDataType()
            );

            ps.setNString(
                    3,
                    normalizeUnit(attribute.getUnit())
            );

            ps.setBoolean(
                    4,
                    attribute.isActive()
            );

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot insert attribute",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int update(Attribute attribute) {

        if (!isValidAttribute(attribute)
                || attribute.getAttributeId() <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        if (isNameExists(
                attribute.getAttributeName(),
                attribute.getAttributeId())) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE ATTRIBUTE "
                + "SET attribute_name = ?, "
                + "data_type = ?, "
                + "unit = ? "
                + "WHERE attribute_id = ? "
                + "AND ("
                + "data_type = ? "
                + "OR NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE ca "
                + "WHERE ca.attribute_id = ATTRIBUTE.attribute_id"
                + ") "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps "
                + "WHERE ps.attribute_id = ATTRIBUTE.attribute_id"
                + ") "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE sav "
                + "WHERE sav.attribute_id = ATTRIBUTE.attribute_id"
                + ")"
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(
                    1,
                    attribute.getAttributeName().trim()
            );

            ps.setString(
                    2,
                    attribute.getDataType()
            );

            ps.setNString(
                    3,
                    normalizeUnit(attribute.getUnit())
            );

            ps.setInt(
                    4,
                    attribute.getAttributeId()
            );

            ps.setString(
                    5,
                    attribute.getDataType()
            );

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot update attribute",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public boolean isAttributeInUse(int attributeId) {

        if (attributeId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT CASE WHEN "
                + "EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE attribute_id = ?"
                + ") "
                + "OR EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION "
                + "WHERE attribute_id = ?"
                + ") "
                + "OR EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 FROM SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE "
                + "WHERE attribute_id = ?"
                + ") "
                + "THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_used";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, attributeId);
            ps.setInt(2, attributeId);
            ps.setInt(3, attributeId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                return rs.next()
                        && rs.getBoolean("is_used");
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot check attribute usage",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot check attribute usage", ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int delete(int attributeId) {

        return setAttributeActive(attributeId, false);
    }

    public int setAttributeActive(
            int attributeId,
            boolean active) {

        if (attributeId <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE ATTRIBUTE "
                + "SET is_active = ? "
                + "WHERE attribute_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, attributeId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot change attribute status",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int countAttributes() {

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTRIBUTE";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            return rs.next()
                    ? rs.getInt(1)
                    : 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count attributes",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count attributes", ex
            );
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidAttribute(Attribute attribute) {

        if (attribute == null
                || attribute.getAttributeName() == null
                || attribute.getDataType() == null) {
            return false;
        }

        String name = attribute.getAttributeName().trim();

        if (name.isEmpty() || name.length() > 100) {
            return false;
        }

        String dataType = attribute.getDataType();

        if (!"TEXT".equals(dataType)
                && !"NUMBER".equals(dataType)
                && !"BOOLEAN".equals(dataType)) {
            return false;
        }

        String unit = normalizeUnit(attribute.getUnit());

        return unit == null || unit.length() <= 30;
    }

    private String normalizeUnit(String unit) {

        if (unit == null || unit.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        return unit.trim();
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.AuditLog;

import java.sql.*;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class AuditLogDAO extends DBContext {

    public boolean insert(AuditLog log) {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG"
                + "(actor_user_id, "
                + "actor_identifier,"
                + "action,"
                + "entity_type, "
                + "entity_id,"
                + "description,"
                + "ip_address)"
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            if (log.getActorUserId() != null) {
                ps.setInt(1, log.getActorUserId());
            } else {
                ps.setNull(1, Types.INTEGER);
            }

            ps.setString(2, log.getActorIdentifier());
            ps.setString(3, log.getAction());
            ps.setString(4, log.getEntityType());

            if (log.getEntityId() != null) {
                ps.setLong(5, log.getEntityId());
            } else {
                ps.setNull(5, Types.BIGINT);
            }

            ps.setString(6, log.getDescription());
            ps.setString(7, log.getIpAddress());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    public List<AuditLog> getAll() {

        List<AuditLog> logs = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT "
                + "log_id, "
                + "actor_user_id, "
                + "actor_identifier, "
                + "action, "
                + "entity_type, "
                + "entity_id, "
                + "description, "
                + "ip_address, "
                + "created_at "
                + "FROM AUDIT_LOG "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                AuditLog log = new AuditLog();

                log.setLogId(rs.getLong("log_id"));

                int actorUserId = rs.getInt("actor_user_id");
                if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                    log.setActorUserId(actorUserId);
                }

                log.setActorIdentifier(
                        rs.getString("actor_identifier"));

                log.setAction(
                        rs.getString("action"));

                log.setEntityType(
                        rs.getString("entity_type"));

                long entityId = rs.getLong("entity_id");
                if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                    log.setEntityId(entityId);
                }

                log.setDescription(
                        rs.getString("description"));

                log.setIpAddress(
                        rs.getString("ip_address"));

                log.setCreatedAt(
                        rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                logs.add(log);
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return logs;
    }

    public List<AuditLog> search(
            String keyword,
            String action,
            String entityType) {

        List<AuditLog> logs = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT log_id, actor_user_id, actor_identifier, action, "
                + "entity_type, entity_id, description, ip_address, created_at "
                + "FROM AUDIT_LOG "
                + "WHERE (? IS NULL OR actor_identifier LIKE ? "
                + "OR description LIKE ?) "
                + "AND (? IS NULL OR action = ?) "
                + "AND (? IS NULL OR entity_type = ?) "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            String searchKeyword = null;

            if (keyword != null && !keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {
                searchKeyword = "%" + keyword.trim() + "%";
            }

            String actionValue
                    = action == null || action.trim().isEmpty()
                    ? null
                    : action.trim();

            String entityValue
                    = entityType == null || entityType.trim().isEmpty()
                    ? null
                    : entityType.trim();

            ps.setString(1, searchKeyword);
            ps.setString(2, searchKeyword);
            ps.setString(3, searchKeyword);

            ps.setString(4, actionValue);
            ps.setString(5, actionValue);

            ps.setString(6, entityValue);
            ps.setString(7, entityValue);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    AuditLog log = new AuditLog();

                    log.setLogId(rs.getLong("log_id"));

                    int actorUserId
                            = rs.getInt("actor_user_id");

                    if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                        log.setActorUserId(actorUserId);
                    }

                    log.setActorIdentifier(
                            rs.getString("actor_identifier"));

                    log.setAction(
                            rs.getString("action"));

                    log.setEntityType(
                            rs.getString("entity_type"));

                    long entityId
                            = rs.getLong("entity_id");

                    if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                        log.setEntityId(entityId);
                    }

                    log.setDescription(
                            rs.getString("description"));

                    log.setIpAddress(
                            rs.getString("ip_address"));

                    log.setCreatedAt(
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                    logs.add(log);
                }

            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return logs;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Banner;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class BannerDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(BannerDAO.class.getName());

    public List<Banner> getAll() {
        List<Banner> banners = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT banner_id, image_url, alt_text, target_url, "
                + "is_active, display_order, created_at "
                + "FROM BANNER "
                + "ORDER BY display_order, banner_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
             ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Banner banner = new Banner();
                banner.setBannerId(rs.getInt("banner_id"));
                banner.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url"));
                banner.setAltText(rs.getString("alt_text"));
                banner.setTargetUrl(rs.getString("target_url"));
                banner.setActive(rs.getBoolean("is_active"));
                banner.setDisplayOrder(rs.getInt("display_order"));
                banner.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                banners.add(banner);
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get banners", e);
        }

        return banners;
    }

    public Banner getById(int bannerId) {
        String sql = "SELECT banner_id, image_url, alt_text, target_url, "
                + "is_active, display_order, created_at "
                + "FROM BANNER WHERE banner_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, bannerId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    Banner banner = new Banner();
                    banner.setBannerId(rs.getInt("banner_id"));
                    banner.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url"));
                    banner.setAltText(rs.getString("alt_text"));
                    banner.setTargetUrl(rs.getString("target_url"));
                    banner.setActive(rs.getBoolean("is_active"));
                    banner.setDisplayOrder(rs.getInt("display_order"));
                    banner.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                    return banner;
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get banner by ID", e);
        }

        return null;
    }

    public List<Banner> getActive() {
        List<Banner> banners = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT banner_id, image_url, alt_text, target_url, "
                + "is_active, display_order, created_at "
                + "FROM BANNER "
                + "WHERE is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY display_order, banner_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
             ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Banner banner = new Banner();
                banner.setBannerId(rs.getInt("banner_id"));
                banner.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url"));
                banner.setAltText(rs.getString("alt_text"));
                banner.setTargetUrl(rs.getString("target_url"));
                banner.setActive(rs.getBoolean("is_active"));
                banner.setDisplayOrder(rs.getInt("display_order"));
                banner.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                banners.add(banner);
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get active banners", e);
        }

        return banners;
    }

    public boolean insert(Banner banner) {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO BANNER "
                + "(image_url, alt_text, target_url, is_active, display_order) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, banner.getImageUrl());
            ps.setString(2, banner.getAltText());
            ps.setString(3, banner.getTargetUrl());
            ps.setBoolean(4, banner.isActive());
            ps.setInt(5, banner.getDisplayOrder());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot insert banner", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean update(Banner banner) {
        String sql = "UPDATE BANNER "
                + "SET image_url = ?, alt_text = ?, target_url = ?, "
                + "is_active = ?, display_order = ? "
                + "WHERE banner_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, banner.getImageUrl());
            ps.setString(2, banner.getAltText());
            ps.setString(3, banner.getTargetUrl());
            ps.setBoolean(4, banner.isActive());
            ps.setInt(5, banner.getDisplayOrder());
            ps.setInt(6, banner.getBannerId());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot update banner", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean updateActive(int bannerId, boolean active) {
        String sql = "UPDATE BANNER SET is_active = ? WHERE banner_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, bannerId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot change banner status", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean delete(int bannerId) {
        String sql = "DELETE FROM BANNER WHERE banner_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, bannerId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot delete banner", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

import db.DBContext;

public class BrandDAO extends DBContext {

            = Logger.getLogger(BrandDAO.class.getName());

            throws SQLException {

        return new Brand(

                rs.getString("brand_name"),
                rs.getString("logo_url"),
                rs.getBoolean("is_active")
        );

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapBrand(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot load active brands",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Brand getById(int id) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + BRAND_COLUMNS
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE brand_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapBrand(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
