    public boolean isNameExists(
            String name,
            int excludeId) {

        if (name == null || name.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(brand_name))) "
                + "= LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(?))) "
                + "AND brand_id <> ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, name.trim());
            ps.setInt(2, excludeId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot check duplicate brand name",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot check brand name",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int countProductsByBrandId(int brandId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM PRODUCT "
                + "WHERE brand_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, brandId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next() ? rs.getInt(1) : 0;
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count products by brand",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count products",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    public Map<Integer, Integer> getProductCounts(
            List<Brand> brandList) {

        Map<Integer, Integer> productCounts
                = new HashMap<>();

        if (brandList == null || brandList.isEmpty()) {
            return productCounts;
        }

        for (Brand brand : brandList) {
            productCounts.put(brand.getBrandId(), 0);
        }

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "SELECT brand_id, COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM PRODUCT "
                + "WHERE brand_id IN ("
        );

        appendPlaceholders(sql, brandList.size());

        sql.append(") GROUP BY brand_id");

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            for (int i = 0; i < brandList.size(); i++) {

                ps.setInt(
                        i + 1,
                        brandList.get(i).getBrandId()
                );
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    productCounts.put(
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getInt("total")
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count products by brands",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count products by brands",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return productCounts;
    }

    public int insert(Brand brand) {

        if (!isValidBrand(brand)) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO BRAND "
                + "(brand_name, logo_url, is_active) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(
                    1,
                    brand.getBrandName().trim()
            );

            ps.setString(
                    2,
                    brand.getLogoUrl()
            );

            ps.setBoolean(
                    3,
                    brand.isActive()
            );

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot insert brand",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot insert brand",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int edit(Brand brand) {

        if (!isValidBrand(brand)
                || brand.getBrandId() <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE BRAND "
                + "SET brand_name = ?, "
                + "logo_url = ? "
                + "WHERE brand_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(
                    1,
                    brand.getBrandName().trim()
            );

            ps.setString(
                    2,
                    brand.getLogoUrl()
            );

            ps.setInt(
                    3,
                    brand.getBrandId()
            );

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot update brand",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot update brand",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int delete(Brand brand) {

        if (brand == null || brand.getBrandId() <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        return setBrandActive(
                brand.getBrandId(),
                false
        );
    }

    public int setBrandActive(
            int brandId,
            boolean active) {

        if (brandId <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE BRAND "
                + "SET is_active = ? "
                + "WHERE brand_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, brandId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot change brand status",
                    ex
            );

            return 0;
        }
    }

    public List<Brand> searchByName(String keyword) {

        List<Brand> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + BRAND_COLUMNS
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE LOWER(brand_name) LIKE LOWER(?) "
                + "ORDER BY brand_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern(keyword));

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapBrand(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot search brands",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot search brands",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Brand> getListByPage(
            int page,
            int pageSize) {

        List<Brand> list = new ArrayList<>();

        validatePage(page, pageSize);

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + BRAND_COLUMNS
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "ORDER BY brand_id "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, calculateOffset(page, pageSize));
            ps.setInt(2, pageSize);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapBrand(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot load brands by page",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot load brands by page",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Brand> searchByNameAndPage(
            String keyword,
            int page,
            int pageSize) {

        List<Brand> list = new ArrayList<>();

        validatePage(page, pageSize);

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + BRAND_COLUMNS
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE LOWER(brand_name) LIKE LOWER(?) "
                + "ORDER BY brand_id "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern(keyword));
            ps.setInt(2, calculateOffset(page, pageSize));
            ps.setInt(3, pageSize);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapBrand(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot search brands by page",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot search brands by page",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public int countSearchResults(String keyword) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE LOWER(brand_name) LIKE LOWER(?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern(keyword));

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                return rs.next()
                        ? rs.getInt(1)
                        : 0;
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count searched brands",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count searched brands",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    public int countBrands() {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BRAND";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            return rs.next()
                    ? rs.getInt(1)
                    : 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count brands",
                    ex
            );

            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count brands",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidBrand(Brand brand) {

        if (brand == null
                || brand.getBrandName() == null) {
            return false;
        }

        String name = brand.getBrandName().trim();

        if (name.isEmpty() || name.length() > 100) {
            return false;
        }

        return brand.getLogoUrl() == null
                || brand.getLogoUrl().length() <= 2048;
    }

    private void appendPlaceholders(
            StringBuilder sql,
            int count) {

        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {

            if (i > 0) {
                sql.append(", ");
            }

            sql.append("?");
        }
    }

    private String searchPattern(String keyword) {

        String value
                = keyword == null
                        ? ""
                        : keyword.trim();

        return "%" + value + "%";
    }

    private void validatePage(
            int page,
            int pageSize) {

        if (page <= 0 || pageSize <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Page và pageSize phải lớn hơn 0."
            );
        }
    }

    private int calculateOffset(
            int page,
            int pageSize) {

        long offset
                = ((long) page - 1) * pageSize;

        if (offset > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Giá trị phân trang quá lớn."
            );
        }

        return (int) offset;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.CartItem;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class CartDAO extends DBContext {

    public int getCartIdByUserId(int userId) {

        if (userId <= 0) {
            return -1;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT cart_id "
                + "FROM CART "
                + "WHERE user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("cart_id");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return -1;
    }


   
    public int createCart(int userId) {

        if (userId <= 0) {
            return -1;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO CART "
                + "(user_id, created_at) "
                + "VALUES (?, GETDATE())";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(
                             sql,
                             Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            int affected = ps.executeUpdate();

            if (affected <= 0) {
                return -1;
            }

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();

            int existing
                    = getCartIdByUserId(userId);

            if (existing > 0) {
                return existing;
            }
        }

        return -1;
    }


    public int getOrCreateCart(int userId) {

        int cartId
                = getCartIdByUserId(userId);

        if (cartId > 0) {
            return cartId;
        }

        return createCart(userId);
    }


    public List<CartItem> getCartItems(int cartId) {

        List<CartItem> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            return list;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "ci.cart_item_id, "
                + "ci.cart_id, "
                + "ci.sku_id, "
                + "ci.quantity, "
                + "ps.sku_code, "
                + "ps.price, "
                + "ps.stock_quantity, "
                + "p.product_name "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS ci "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON ps.sku_id = ci.sku_id "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = ps.product_id "
                + "WHERE ci.cart_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY ci.cart_item_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    list.add(
                            mapCartItem(rs)
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return list;
    }


   
    public List<CartItem> getCartItemsByIds(
            int cartId,
            List<Integer> cartItemIds) {

        List<CartItem> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        if (cartId <= 0
                || cartItemIds == null
                || cartItemIds.isEmpty()) {

            return list;
        }

        List<Integer> validIds
                = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Integer id : cartItemIds) {

            if (id != null
                    && id > 0
                    && !validIds.contains(id)) {

                validIds.add(id);
            }
        }

        if (validIds.isEmpty()) {
            return list;
        }

        StringBuilder placeholders
                = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0;
             i < validIds.size();
             i++) {

            if (i > 0) {
                placeholders.append(",");
            }

            placeholders.append("?");
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "ci.cart_item_id, "
                + "ci.cart_id, "
                + "ci.sku_id, "
                + "ci.quantity, "
                + "ps.sku_code, "
                + "ps.price, "
                + "ps.stock_quantity, "
                + "p.product_name "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS ci "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON ps.sku_id = ci.sku_id "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = ps.product_id "
                + "WHERE ci.cart_id = ? "
                + "AND ci.cart_item_id IN ("
                + placeholders
                + ") "
                + "ORDER BY ci.cart_item_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            int index = 1;

            ps.setInt(
                    index++,
                    cartId
            );

            for (Integer id : validIds) {

                ps.setInt(
                        index++,
                        id
                );
            }

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    list.add(
                            mapCartItem(rs)
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return list;
    }


    public boolean exists(
            int cartId,
            int skuId) {

        if (cartId <= 0 || skuId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    public int getStockQuantity(int skuId) {

        if (skuId <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT stock_quantity "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return rs.getInt(
                            "stock_quantity"
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }


    public int getCurrentQuantity(
            int cartId,
            int skuId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT quantity "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return rs.getInt(
                            "quantity"
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }


    public boolean addToCart(
            int cartId,
            int skuId,
            int quantity) {

        if (cartId <= 0
                || skuId <= 0
                || quantity <= 0) {

            return false;
        }

        int stock
                = getStockQuantity(skuId);

        if (stock <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int current
                = getCurrentQuantity(
                        cartId,
                        skuId
                );

        if (current + quantity > stock) {

            return false;
        }

        if (current > 0) {

            String sql
                    = "UPDATE CART_ITEMS "
                    + "SET quantity = quantity + ? "
                    + "WHERE cart_id = ? "
                    + "AND sku_id = ?";

            try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                 PreparedStatement ps
                         = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                ps.setInt(1, quantity);
                ps.setInt(2, cartId);
                ps.setInt(3, skuId);

                return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

            } catch (SQLException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }

            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO CART_ITEMS "
                + "(cart_id, sku_id, quantity) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);
            ps.setInt(3, quantity);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    public int getSkuIdByCartItemId(
            int cartItemId,
            int cartId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT sku_id "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_item_id = ? "
                + "AND cart_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartItemId);
            ps.setInt(2, cartId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return rs.getInt(
                            "sku_id"
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return -1;
    }


    public boolean updateQuantity(
            int cartItemId,
            int cartId,
            int quantity) {

        if (quantity <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int skuId
                = getSkuIdByCartItemId(
                        cartItemId,
                        cartId
                );

        if (skuId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int stock
                = getStockQuantity(skuId);

        if (quantity > stock) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE CART_ITEMS "
                + "SET quantity = ? "
                + "WHERE cart_item_id = ? "
                + "AND cart_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, quantity);
            ps.setInt(2, cartItemId);
            ps.setInt(3, cartId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    public boolean updateQuantity(
            int cartItemId,
            int quantity) {

        if (quantity <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT ci.cart_id "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS ci "
                + "WHERE ci.cart_item_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartItemId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return updateQuantity(
                            cartItemId,
                            rs.getInt("cart_id"),
                            quantity
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean clearCart(int cartId) {

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

                + "WHERE cart_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            return true;

            e.printStackTrace();
        }

    }


    public double getCartTotal(int cartId) {

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT COALESCE("
                + "SUM(ps.price * ci.quantity), 0"
                + ") AS total "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS ci "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON ps.sku_id = ci.sku_id "
                + "WHERE ci.cart_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return rs.getDouble(
                            "total"
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }


    public double getCartTotalByIds(
            int cartId,
            List<Integer> cartItemIds) {

        List<CartItem> items
                = getCartItemsByIds(
                        cartId,
                        cartItemIds
                );

        double total = 0;

        for (CartItem item : items) {

            total += item.getPrice()
                    * item.getQuantity();
        }

        return total;
    }


    public boolean deleteCartItemsByIds(
            int cartId,
            List<Integer> cartItemIds) {

        if (cartId <= 0
                || cartItemIds == null
                || cartItemIds.isEmpty()) {

            return false;
        }

        StringBuilder placeholders
                = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0;
             i < cartItemIds.size();
             i++) {

            if (i > 0) {
                placeholders.append(",");
            }

            placeholders.append("?");
        }

        String sql
                = "DELETE FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_id = ? "
                + "AND cart_item_id IN ("
                + placeholders
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            int index = 1;

            ps.setInt(
                    index++,
                    cartId
            );

            for (Integer id : cartItemIds) {

                ps.setInt(
                        index++,
                        id
                );
            }

            int deleted
                    = ps.executeUpdate();

            return deleted
                    == cartItemIds.size();

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    private CartItem mapCartItem(
            ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        CartItem item
                = new CartItem();

        item.setCartItemId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "cart_item_id"
                )
        );

        item.setCartId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "cart_id"
                )
        );

        item.setSkuId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "sku_id"
                )
        );

        item.setQuantity(
                rs.getInt(
                        "quantity"
                )
        );

        item.setSkuCode(
                rs.getString(
                        "sku_code"
                )
        );

        item.setPrice(
                rs.getDouble(
                        "price"
                )
        );

        item.setStockQuantity(
                rs.getInt(
                        "stock_quantity"
                )
        );

        item.setProductName(
                rs.getString(
                        "product_name"
                )
        );

        return item;
    }
}package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.CategoryAttribute;

public class CategoryAttributeDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(CategoryAttributeDAO.class.getName());

    private static final String BASE_SELECT
            = "SELECT "
            + "ca.category_id, "
            + "ca.attribute_id, "
            + "ca.group_name, "
            + "ca.attribute_type, "
            + "ca.is_required, "
            + "ca.is_filterable, "
            + "ca.display_order, "
            + "a.attribute_name, "
            + "a.data_type, "
            + "a.unit "
            + "FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE ca "
            + "INNER JOIN ATTRIBUTE a "
            + "ON ca.attribute_id = a.attribute_id ";

    private CategoryAttribute mapCategoryAttribute(
            ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {

        return new CategoryAttribute(
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getInt("attribute_id"),
                rs.getString("group_name"),
                rs.getString("attribute_type"),
                rs.getBoolean("is_required"),
                rs.getBoolean("is_filterable"),
                rs.getInt("display_order"),
                rs.getString("attribute_name"),
                rs.getString("data_type"),
                rs.getString("unit")
        );
    }

    public List<CategoryAttribute> getByCategoryId(
            int categoryId) {

        List<CategoryAttribute> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = BASE_SELECT
                + "WHERE ca.category_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY ca.display_order, "
                + "ca.attribute_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapCategoryAttribute(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Loi lay thuoc tinh theo danh muc!",
                    ex
            );

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Khong the tai cau hinh thuoc tinh danh muc.",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

                    "Khong the tai thuoc tinh thong so ky thuat.",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public CategoryAttribute getByCategoryAndAttribute(
            int categoryId,
            int attributeId) {

        String sql = BASE_SELECT
                + "WHERE ca.category_id = ? "
                + "AND ca.attribute_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(2, attributeId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapCategoryAttribute(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i láº¥y cáº¥u hÃ¬nh CategoryAttribute!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    public boolean save(CategoryAttribute config) {

        if (config == null
                || config.getCategoryId() <= 0
                || config.getAttributeId() <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String attributeType
                = config.getAttributeType();

        if (!isValidAttributeType(attributeType)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (config.getDisplayOrder() < 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String groupName = config.getGroupName();

        if (groupName == null
                || groupName.trim().isEmpty()
                || groupName.trim().length() > 100) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WITH (UPDLOCK, SERIALIZABLE) "
                + "SET group_name = ?, "
                + "attribute_type = ?, "
                + "is_required = ?, "
                + "is_filterable = ?, "
                + "display_order = ? "
                + "WHERE category_id = ? "
                + "AND attribute_id = ?; "
                + "IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 "
                + "BEGIN "
                + "INSERT INTO CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE "
                + "(category_id, attribute_id, "
                + "group_name, attribute_type, "
                + "is_required, is_filterable, "
                + "display_order) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?); "
                + "END";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection()) {

            boolean oldAutoCommit
                    = conn.getAutoCommit();

            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setNString(1, groupName.trim());
                    ps.setString(2, attributeType);
                    ps.setBoolean(3, config.isRequired());
                    ps.setBoolean(4, config.isFilterable());
                    ps.setInt(5, config.getDisplayOrder());
                    ps.setInt(6, config.getCategoryId());
                    ps.setInt(7, config.getAttributeId());

                    ps.setInt(8, config.getCategoryId());
                    ps.setInt(9, config.getAttributeId());
                    ps.setNString(10, groupName.trim());
                    ps.setString(11, attributeType);
                    ps.setBoolean(12, config.isRequired());
                    ps.setBoolean(13, config.isFilterable());
                    ps.setInt(14, config.getDisplayOrder());

                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException ex) {

                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackEx) {
                    ex.addSuppressed(rollbackEx);
                }

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Lá»—i lÆ°u CategoryAttribute!",
                        ex
                );

                return false;

            } finally {
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(oldAutoCommit);
                } catch (SQLException ex) {
                    LOGGER.log(
                            Level.WARNING,
                            "Lá»—i khÃ´i phá»¥c autoCommit!",
                            ex
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i CategoryAttribute!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean delete(
            int categoryId,
            int attributeId) {

        if (categoryId <= 0 || attributeId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "DELETE FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE category_id = ? "
                + "AND attribute_id = ? "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps "
                + "ON ps.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "WHERE p.category_id = ? "
                + "AND ps.attribute_id = ?"
                + ") "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "ON s.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "JOIN SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE sav "
                + "ON sav.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "WHERE p.category_id = ? "
                + "AND sav.attribute_id = ?"
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(2, attributeId);

            ps.setInt(3, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(4, attributeId);

            ps.setInt(5, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(6, attributeId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i xÃ³a cáº¥u hÃ¬nh CategoryAttribute!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return false;
    }

    // ======================================================
    // QUáº¢N LÃ THÃ”NG Sá» THEO DANH Má»¤C (FORM EDIT CATEGORY)
    // - Chá»‰ quáº£n lÃ½ pháº§n SPECIFICATION.
    // - KhÃ´ng lÃ m máº¥t VARIANT cá»§a SKU hoáº·c cáº¥u hÃ¬nh inactive.
    // - ToÃ n bá»™ thay Ä‘á»•i Ä‘Æ°á»£c commit/rollback trong má»™t transaction.
    // ======================================================
    public static final class SpecificationSelection {

        private final int attributeId;
        private final String groupName;
        private final boolean required;
        private final boolean filterable;
        private final int displayOrder;

        public SpecificationSelection(int attributeId, String groupName,
                boolean required, boolean filterable, int displayOrder) {
            this.attributeId = attributeId;
            this.groupName = groupName;
            this.required = required;
            this.filterable = filterable;
            this.displayOrder = displayOrder;
        }
    }

    private static final class ExistingConfig {

        private final String type;
        private final boolean required;

        private ExistingConfig(String type, boolean required) {
            this.type = type;
            this.required = required;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Ãp dá»¥ng danh sÃ¡ch thÃ´ng sá»‘ Ä‘Æ°á»£c chá»n trÃªn form Edit
     * Category. CÃ¡c liÃªn káº¿t VARIANT/BOTH Ä‘ang dÃ¹ng cho SKU Ä‘Æ°á»£c
     * báº£o toÃ n. KhÃ´ng gá»i save()/delete() láº·p láº¡i vÃ¬ chÃºng má»Ÿ
     * connection riÃªng.
     */
    public void saveSpecificationSelections(int categoryId,
            java.util.Set<Integer> visibleAttributeIds,
            List<SpecificationSelection> selections) throws SQLException {

        if (categoryId <= 0 || visibleAttributeIds == null
                || selections == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Danh má»¥c hoáº·c cáº¥u hÃ¬nh khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.");
        }

        java.util.Map<Integer, SpecificationSelection> chosen
                = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (SpecificationSelection item : selections) {
            if (item == null || item.attributeId <= 0
                    || chosen.putIfAbsent(item.attributeId, item) != null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Danh sÃ¡ch thuá»™c tÃ­nh cÃ³ ID khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡ hoáº·c bá»‹ trÃ¹ng.");
            }
        }

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            boolean oldAutoCommit = conn.getAutoCommit();
            int oldIsolation = conn.getTransactionIsolation();
            try {
                conn.setTransactionIsolation(Connection.TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE);
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                assertChildCategory(conn, categoryId);

                java.util.Set<Integer> activeIds = loadActiveAttributeIds(conn);
                if (!activeIds.containsAll(visibleAttributeIds)
                        || !visibleAttributeIds.containsAll(chosen.keySet())) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Thuá»™c tÃ­nh khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ ngá»«ng sá»­ dá»¥ng. Táº£i láº¡i trang.");
                }

                java.util.Map<Integer, ExistingConfig> existing
                        = loadExistingConfigurations(conn, categoryId);

                // Chá»‰ xá»­ lÃ½ thuá»™c tÃ­nh Ä‘ang hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng. LiÃªn káº¿t cá»§a thuá»™c tÃ­nh
                // inactive Ä‘Æ°á»£c giá»¯ nguyÃªn, trÃ¡nh xÃ³a dá»¯ liá»‡u ngoÃ i Ã½ muá»‘n.
                for (Integer attrId : new java.util.TreeSet<>(visibleAttributeIds)) {
                    ExistingConfig old = existing.get(attrId);
                    SpecificationSelection item = chosen.get(attrId);

                    if (item == null) {
                        if (old == null || "VARIANT".equals(old.type)) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (hasProductSpecValue(conn, categoryId, attrId)) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException(
                                    "KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ bá» thuá»™c tÃ­nh #" + attrId
                                    + " vÃ¬ Ä‘Ã£ cÃ³ sáº£n pháº©m dÃ¹ng thÃ´ng sá»‘ nÃ y.");
                        }

                        if ("BOTH".equals(old.type)) {
                            // Chá»‰ táº¯t SPECIFICATION; giá»¯ VARIANT vÃ  metadata SKU.
                            changeAttributeType(conn, categoryId, attrId, "VARIANT");
                        } else {
                            if (hasSkuAttributeValue(conn, categoryId, attrId)) {
                                throw new IllegalStateException(
                                        "Thuá»™c tÃ­nh #" + attrId
                                        + " Ä‘Ã£ cÃ³ SKU sá»­ dá»¥ng, khÃ´ng thá»ƒ bá» cáº¥u hÃ¬nh.");
                            }
                            deleteConfiguration(conn, categoryId, attrId);
                        }
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (old != null && "BOTH".equals(old.type)) {
                        // ÄÃ£ lÃ  SPEC + VARIANT. KhÃ´ng sá»­a thuá»™c tÃ­nh dÃ¹ng chung
                        // (required/group/order/filterable) trÃ¡nh tÃ¡c Ä‘á»™ng SKU.
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (old != null && "VARIANT".equals(old.type)) {
                        // is_required dÃ¹ng chung giá»¯a SKU vÃ  Product.
                        // KhÃ´ng thay Ä‘á»•i flag, chá»‰ thÃªm vai trÃ² SPECIFICATION.
                        if (old.required && hasProductMissingSpec(conn, categoryId, attrId)) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException(
                                    "Thuá»™c tÃ­nh #" + attrId
                                    + " báº¯t buá»™c vá»›i SKU. HÃ£y bá»• sung thÃ´ng sá»‘"
                                    + " cho sáº£n pháº©m hiá»‡n cÃ³ trÆ°á»›c khi báº­t BOTH.");
                        }
                        changeAttributeType(conn, categoryId, attrId, "BOTH");
                        continue;
                    }

                    validateSpecItem(item);
                    if (item.required && hasProductMissingSpec(conn, categoryId, attrId)) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "ChÆ°a thá»ƒ Ä‘áº·t thuá»™c tÃ­nh #" + attrId
                                + " lÃ  báº¯t buá»™c: cÃ³ sáº£n pháº©m trong danh má»¥c chÆ°a nháº­p giÃ¡ trá»‹.");
                    }

                    if (old == null) {
                        insertSpecConfiguration(conn, categoryId, item);
                    } else {
                        updateSpecConfiguration(conn, categoryId, item);
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackEx) {
                    ex.addSuppressed(rollbackEx);
                }
                throw ex;
            } finally {
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(oldAutoCommit);
                    conn.setTransactionIsolation(oldIsolation);
                } catch (SQLException ex) {
                    LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING,
                            "KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ khÃ´i phá»¥c cáº¥u hÃ¬nh Connection.", ex);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void assertChildCategory(Connection conn, int categoryId)
            throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT parent_id FROM CATEGORY WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE category_id = ?";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Danh má»¥c khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.");
                }
                if (rs.getObject("parent_id") == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Chá»‰ cáº¥u hÃ¬nh thÃ´ng sá»‘ cho danh má»¥c con.");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private java.util.Set<Integer> loadActiveAttributeIds(Connection conn)
            throws SQLException {
        java.util.Set<Integer> ids = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>();
        String sql = "SELECT attribute_id FROM ATTRIBUTE WITH (HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY attribute_id";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
            while (rs.next()) {
                ids.add(rs.getInt(1));
            }
        }
        return ids;
    }

    private java.util.Map<Integer, ExistingConfig> loadExistingConfigurations(
            Connection conn, int categoryId) throws SQLException {
        java.util.Map<Integer, ExistingConfig> map = new java.util.HashMap<>();
        String sql = "SELECT attribute_id, attribute_type, is_required "
                + "FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE category_id = ?";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    map.put(rs.getInt("attribute_id"),
                            new ExistingConfig(rs.getString("attribute_type"),
                                    rs.getBoolean("is_required")));
                }
            }
        }
        return map;
    }

    private void validateSpecItem(SpecificationSelection item) {
        if (item.groupName == null || item.groupName.trim().isEmpty()
                || item.groupName.trim().length() > 100
                || item.displayOrder < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "NhÃ³m thÃ´ng sá»‘ hoáº·c thá»© tá»± hiá»ƒn thá»‹ khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡."
                    + " NhÃ³m tá»‘i Ä‘a 100 kÃ½ tá»±, thá»© tá»± khÃ´ng Ã¢m.");
        }
    }

    private boolean hasProductSpecValue(Connection conn, int categoryId,
            int attributeId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps WITH (HOLDLOCK) "
                + "ON ps.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "WHERE p.category_id = ? AND ps.attribute_id = ?";
        return existsForCategoryAttribute(conn, sql, categoryId, attributeId);
    }

    private boolean hasSkuAttributeValue(Connection conn, int categoryId,
            int attributeId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "JOIN SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE sav WITH (HOLDLOCK) "
                + "ON sav.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "WHERE p.category_id = ? AND sav.attribute_id = ?";
        return existsForCategoryAttribute(conn, sql, categoryId, attributeId);
    }

    private boolean hasProductMissingSpec(Connection conn, int categoryId,
            int attributeId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM PRODUCT p WHERE p.category_id = ? "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps "
                + "WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE ps.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "AND ps.attribute_id = ?)";
        return existsForCategoryAttribute(conn, sql, categoryId, attributeId);
    }

    private boolean existsForCategoryAttribute(Connection conn, String sql,
            int categoryId, int attributeId) throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(2, attributeId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        }
    }

    private void changeAttributeType(Connection conn, int categoryId,
            int attributeId, String type) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "UPDATE CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE SET attribute_type = ? "
                + "WHERE category_id = ? AND attribute_id = ?";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setString(1, type);
            ps.setInt(2, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(3, attributeId);
            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new SQLException("KhÃ´ng cáº­p nháº­t Ä‘Æ°á»£c loáº¡i thuá»™c tÃ­nh.");
            }
        }
    }

    private void deleteConfiguration(Connection conn, int categoryId,
            int attributeId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "DELETE FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE "
                + "WHERE category_id = ? AND attribute_id = ?";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(2, attributeId);
            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new SQLException("KhÃ´ng xÃ³a Ä‘Æ°á»£c cáº¥u hÃ¬nh thÃ´ng sá»‘.");
            }
        }
    }

    private void insertSpecConfiguration(Connection conn, int categoryId,
            SpecificationSelection item) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE "
                + "(category_id, attribute_id, group_name, attribute_type, "
                + "is_required, is_filterable, display_order) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'SPECIFICATION', ?, ?, ?)";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(2, item.attributeId);
            ps.setNString(3, item.groupName.trim());
            ps.setBoolean(4, item.required);
            ps.setBoolean(5, item.filterable);
            ps.setInt(6, item.displayOrder);
            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new SQLException("KhÃ´ng thÃªm Ä‘Æ°á»£c cáº¥u hÃ¬nh thÃ´ng sá»‘.");
            }
        }
    }

    private void updateSpecConfiguration(Connection conn, int categoryId,
            SpecificationSelection item) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "UPDATE CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE SET group_name = ?, "
                + "is_required = ?, is_filterable = ?, display_order = ? "
                + "WHERE category_id = ? AND attribute_id = ? "
                + "AND attribute_type = 'SPECIFICATION'";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setNString(1, item.groupName.trim());
            ps.setBoolean(2, item.required);
            ps.setBoolean(3, item.filterable);
            ps.setInt(4, item.displayOrder);
            ps.setInt(5, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(6, item.attributeId);
            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new SQLException("KhÃ´ng cáº­p nháº­t Ä‘Æ°á»£c cáº¥u hÃ¬nh thÃ´ng sá»‘.");
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidAttributeType(String type) {

        return "SPECIFICATION".equals(type)
                || "VARIANT".equals(type)
                || "BOTH".equals(type);
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Category;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Types;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class CategoryDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(CategoryDAO.class.getName());

    private static final String CATEGORY_COLUMNS
            = "category_id, category_name, parent_id, "
            + "description, is_active ";

    private Category mapCategory(ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        Object parentValue = rs.getObject("parent_id");

        Integer parentId = parentValue == null
                ? null
                : ((Number) parentValue).intValue();

        return new Category(
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getString("category_name"),
                parentId,
                rs.getString("description"),
                rs.getBoolean("is_active")
        );
    }

    public List<Category> getList() {

        List<Category> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + CATEGORY_COLUMNS
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "ORDER BY parent_id ASC, "
                + "category_name ASC, category_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapCategory(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get category list",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get category list", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Category> getActiveCategories() {

        List<Category> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + CATEGORY_COLUMNS
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY parent_id ASC, "
                + "category_name ASC, category_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapCategory(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get active categories",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get active categories", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Category getById(int id) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + CATEGORY_COLUMNS
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE category_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapCategory(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get category by ID",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get category by ID", ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    public boolean isCategoryNameExists(String categoryName)
            throws SQLException {

        return isCategoryNameExists(categoryName, 0);
    }

    public boolean isCategoryNameExists(
            String categoryName,
            int excludeCategoryId) throws SQLException {

        if (categoryName == null
                || categoryName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(category_name))) "
                + "= LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(?))) "
                + "AND category_id <> ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, categoryName.trim());
            ps.setInt(2, excludeCategoryId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        }
    }

    public int insert(Category category) {

        if (!isValidCategory(category)) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO CATEGORY "
                + "(category_name, parent_id, "
                + "description, is_active) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            if (!isValidParent(
                    conn, category.getParentId(), null)) {
                return 0;
            }

            try (PreparedStatement ps
                    = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                ps.setNString(
                        1, category.getCategoryName().trim()
                );

                setParentId(ps, 2, category.getParentId());

                ps.setNString(
                        3, category.getDescription()
                );

                ps.setBoolean(4, category.isActive());

                return ps.executeUpdate();
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot insert category",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int edit(Category category) {

        if (!isValidCategory(category)
                || category.getCategoryId() <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE CATEGORY "
                + "SET category_name = ?, "
                + "parent_id = ?, "
                + "description = ?, "
                + "is_active = ? "
                + "WHERE category_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            boolean oldAutoCommit = conn.getAutoCommit();

            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                if (!isValidParent(
                        conn,
                        category.getParentId(),
                        category.getCategoryId())) {

                    conn.rollback();
                    return 0;
                }

                int result;

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setNString(
                            1, category.getCategoryName().trim()
                    );

                    setParentId(
                            ps, 2, category.getParentId()
                    );

                    ps.setNString(
                            3, category.getDescription()
                    );

                    ps.setBoolean(4, category.isActive());

                    ps.setInt(
                            5, category.getCategoryId()
                    );

                    result = ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                conn.commit();
                return result;

            } catch (SQLException ex) {

                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackEx) {
                    ex.addSuppressed(rollbackEx);
                }

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Cannot update category",
                        ex
                );
                return 0;

            } finally {
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(oldAutoCommit);
                } catch (SQLException ex) {
                    LOGGER.log(
                            Level.WARNING,
                            "Cannot restore autoCommit",
                            ex
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot connect to update category",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidCategory(Category category) {

        if (category == null
                || category.getCategoryName() == null) {
            return false;
        }

        String name = category.getCategoryName().trim();

        if (name.isEmpty() || name.length() > 100) {
            return false;
        }

        return category.getDescription() == null
                || category.getDescription().length() <= 500;
    }

    private boolean isValidParent(
            Connection conn,
            Integer parentId,
            Integer categoryId) throws SQLException {

        if (parentId == null) {
            return true;
        }

        if (parentId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        if (categoryId != null
                && parentId.equals(categoryId)) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT parent_id "
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE category_id = ?";

        Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();

        Integer currentId = parentId;

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            while (currentId != null) {

                if (!visited.add(currentId)) {
                    return false;
                }

                if (categoryId != null
                        && currentId.equals(categoryId)) {
                    return false;
                }

                ps.setInt(1, currentId);

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                    if (!rs.next()) {
                        return false;
                    }

                    Object value = rs.getObject("parent_id");

                    currentId = value == null
                            ? null
                            : ((Number) value).intValue();
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private void setParentId(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            int index,
            Integer parentId) throws SQLException {

        if (parentId == null) {
            ps.setNull(index, Types.INTEGER);
        } else {
            ps.setInt(index, parentId);
        }
    }

    public int countCategories() {

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CATEGORY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            return rs.next() ? rs.getInt(1) : 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot count categories",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count categories", ex
            );
        }
    }

    public List<Category> searchByName(String keyword) {

        List<Category> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + CATEGORY_COLUMNS
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE category_name LIKE ? "
                + "ORDER BY parent_id ASC, "
                + "category_name ASC, category_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern(keyword));

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapCategory(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot search categories",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot search categories", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Category> getListByPage(
            int page,
            int pageSize) {

        List<Category> list = new ArrayList<>();

        validatePage(page, pageSize);

        String sql
                = "SELECT " + CATEGORY_COLUMNS
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "ORDER BY parent_id ASC, "
                + "category_name ASC, category_id ASC "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, offset(page, pageSize));
            ps.setInt(2, pageSize);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapCategory(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get categories by page",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get categories by page", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

                + "category_name ASC, category_id ASC "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern(keyword));
            ps.setInt(2, offset(page, pageSize));
            ps.setInt(3, pageSize);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapCategory(rs));

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot search categories by page",

            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot search categories by page", ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }


    public Map<Integer, Integer> getProductCounts(
            List<Category> categories) {

        Map<Integer, Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();

        if (categories == null || categories.isEmpty()) {
            return counts;
        }

        for (Category category : categories) {
            counts.put(category.getCategoryId(), 0);
        }

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "WITH CategoryTree AS ( "
                + "SELECT c.category_id AS root_id, "
                + "c.category_id AS descendant_id, "
                + "CAST('/' + CAST(c.category_id AS VARCHAR(20)) "
                + "+ '/' AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS category_path "
                + "FROM CATEGORY c "
                + "WHERE c.category_id IN ("
        );

        appendPlaceholders(sql, categories.size());

        sql.append(
                ") "
                + "UNION ALL "
                + "SELECT ct.root_id, child.category_id, "
                + "CAST(ct.category_path "
                + "+ CAST(child.category_id AS VARCHAR(20)) "
                + "+ '/' AS VARCHAR(MAX)) "
                + "FROM CATEGORY child "
                + "JOIN CategoryTree ct "
                + "ON child.parent_id = ct.descendant_id "
                + "WHERE CHARINDEX( "
                + "'/' + CAST(child.category_id AS VARCHAR(20)) "
                + "+ '/', ct.category_path) = 0 "
                + ") "
                + "SELECT ct.root_id, "
                + "COUNT(p.product_id) AS total "
                + "FROM CategoryTree ct "
                + "LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.category_id = ct.descendant_id "
                + "GROUP BY ct.root_id "
                + "OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767)"
        );

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            for (int i = 0; i < categories.size(); i++) {
                ps.setInt(
                        i + 1,
                        categories.get(i).getCategoryId()
                );
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    counts.put(
                            rs.getInt("root_id"),
                            rs.getInt("total")
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get product counts",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get product counts", ex
            );
        }

        return counts;
    }

    public Map<Integer, Integer> getChildCounts(
            List<Category> categories) {

        Map<Integer, Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();

        if (categories == null || categories.isEmpty()) {
            return counts;
        }

        for (Category category : categories) {
            counts.put(category.getCategoryId(), 0);
        }

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "SELECT parent_id, COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE parent_id IN ("
        );

        appendPlaceholders(sql, categories.size());

        sql.append(") GROUP BY parent_id");

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            for (int i = 0; i < categories.size(); i++) {
                ps.setInt(
                        i + 1,
                        categories.get(i).getCategoryId()
                );
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    counts.put(
                            rs.getInt("parent_id"),
                            rs.getInt("total")
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot get child counts",
                    ex
            );
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot get child counts", ex
            );
        }

        return counts;
    }

    public int delete(Category category) {

        if (category == null
                || category.getCategoryId() <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        return setCategoryActive(
                category.getCategoryId(),
                false
        );
    }

    public int setCategoryActive(
            int categoryId,
            boolean active) {

        if (categoryId <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE CATEGORY "
                + "SET is_active = ? "
                + "WHERE category_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, categoryId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot change category status",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    private void appendPlaceholders(
            StringBuilder sql,
            int count) {

        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {

            if (i > 0) {
                sql.append(", ");
            }

            sql.append("?");
        }
    }

    private String searchPattern(String keyword) {

        return "%" + (keyword == null
                ? ""
                : keyword.trim()) + "%";
    }

    private void validatePage(int page, int pageSize) {

        if (page <= 0 || pageSize <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Page và pageSize phải lớn hơn 0."
            );
        }
    }

    private int offset(int page, int pageSize) {

        long value = ((long) page - 1) * pageSize;

        if (value > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Giá trị phân trang quá lớn."
            );
        }

        return (int) value;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.Base64;
import model.CategoryAttribute;

public class CategoryRoleConfigDAO extends DBContext {

    public static final String SPECIFICATION = "SPECIFICATION";
    public static final String VARIANT = "VARIANT";

    public static final class ConfigInput {

        public int categoryId;
        public int attributeId; 
        public String role;
        public String attributeName;
        public String dataType;
        public String unit;
        public String groupName;
        public boolean required;
        public boolean filterable;
        public int displayOrder;
        public String expectedSignature;
    }

    private static final class Mapping {

        String type;
        String group;
        boolean required;
        boolean filterable;
        int order;
    }

    private interface Transaction<T> {

        T work(Connection connection) throws SQLException;
    }

    private <T> T inTransaction(Transaction<T> task) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            int oldIsolation = conn.getTransactionIsolation();
            boolean oldAutoCommit = conn.getAutoCommit();
            try {
                conn.setTransactionIsolation(Connection.TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE);
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);
                T result = task.work(conn);
                conn.commit();
                return result;
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackEx) {
                    ex.addSuppressed(rollbackEx);
                }
                throw ex;
            } finally {
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(oldAutoCommit);
                    conn.setTransactionIsolation(oldIsolation);
                } catch (SQLException ignored) {
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static boolean validRole(String role) {
        return SPECIFICATION.equals(role) || VARIANT.equals(role);
    }

    public static boolean includesRole(String type, String role) {
        return "BOTH".equals(type) || role != null && role.equals(type);
    }

    public static String signature(CategoryAttribute config) {
        if (config == null) {
            return "NONE";
        }
        return signature(config.getAttributeType(), config.getGroupName(),
                config.isRequired(), config.isFilterable(), config.getDisplayOrder());
    }

    private static String signature(Mapping config) {
        if (config == null) {
            return "NONE";
        }
        return signature(config.type, config.group, config.required,
                config.filterable, config.order);
    }

    private static String signature(String type, String group, boolean required,
            boolean filterable, int order) {
        String source = type.length() + ":" + type + ":"
                + group.length() + ":" + group + ":"
                + required + ":" + filterable + ":" + order;
        try {
            byte[] digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
                    .digest(source.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(digest);
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Không hỗ trợ SHA-256", ex);
        }
    }

    public int createDefinitionOnly(final String name, final String dataType,
            final String unit) throws SQLException {
        validateDefinition(name, dataType, unit);
        return inTransaction(conn -> {
            checkUniqueName(conn, name.trim(), 0);
            String sql = "INSERT INTO ATTRIBUTE "
                    + "(attribute_name, data_type, unit, is_active) "
                    + "OUTPUT INSERTED.attribute_id VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)";
            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                ps.setNString(1, name.trim());
                ps.setString(2, dataType);
                ps.setNString(3, normalizeUnit(unit));
                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                    if (!rs.next()) {
                        throw new SQLException("Không lấy được ID thuộc tính vừa tạo.");
                    }
                    return rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }
        });
    }

  
    public int save(final ConfigInput input) throws SQLException {
        if (input == null || input.categoryId <= 0 || input.attributeId < 0
                || !validRole(input.role)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Danh mục, thuộc tính hoặc vai trò không hợp lệ.");
        }
        if (input.groupName == null || input.groupName.trim().isEmpty()
                || input.groupName.trim().length() > 100 || input.displayOrder < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Nhóm tối đa 100 ký tự; thứ tự phải >= 0.");
        }
        if (input.attributeId == 0) {
