            validateDefinition(input.attributeName, input.dataType, input.unit);
        }
        return inTransaction(conn -> {
            checkChildCategory(conn, input.categoryId);
            int attributeId = input.attributeId;
            if (attributeId == 0) {
                checkUniqueName(conn, input.attributeName.trim(), 0);
                String sql = "INSERT INTO ATTRIBUTE "
                        + "(attribute_name, data_type, unit, is_active) "
                        + "OUTPUT INSERTED.attribute_id VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)";
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setNString(1, input.attributeName.trim());
                    ps.setString(2, input.dataType);
                    ps.setNString(3, normalizeUnit(input.unit));
                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new SQLException("Không lấy được ID thuộc tính mới.");
                        }
                        attributeId = rs.getInt(1);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                assertActiveAttribute(conn, attributeId);
            }

            Mapping previous = readMapping(conn, input.categoryId, attributeId);
            if (input.attributeId > 0) {
                checkSignature(previous, input.expectedSignature);
            }
            if (previous == null) {
               
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                        "INSERT INTO CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE "
                        + "(category_id, attribute_id, group_name, attribute_type, "
                        + "is_required, is_filterable, display_order) "
                        + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)")) {
                    ps.setInt(1, input.categoryId);
                    ps.setInt(2, attributeId);
                    ps.setNString(3, input.groupName.trim());
                    ps.setString(4, input.role);
                    ps.setBoolean(5, input.required);
                    ps.setBoolean(6, input.filterable);
                    ps.setInt(7, input.displayOrder);
                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }
            } else if (!includesRole(previous.type, input.role)) {
                
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                        "UPDATE CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE SET attribute_type = 'BOTH' "
                        + "WHERE category_id = ? AND attribute_id = ?")) {
                    ps.setInt(1, input.categoryId);
                    ps.setInt(2, attributeId);
                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }
            } else if ("BOTH".equals(previous.type)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Thuộc tính đang dùng chung SKU và thông số. "
                        + "Không thể sửa nhóm/thứ tự/bắt buộc vì đây là cấu hình chung của DB6.");
            } else {
               
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                        "UPDATE CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE SET group_name=?, is_required=?, "
                        + "is_filterable=?, display_order=? "
                        + "WHERE category_id=? AND attribute_id=?")) {
                    ps.setNString(1, input.groupName.trim());
                    ps.setBoolean(2, input.required);
                    ps.setBoolean(3, input.filterable);
                    ps.setInt(4, input.displayOrder);
                    ps.setInt(5, input.categoryId);
                    ps.setInt(6, attributeId);
                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }
            }
            return attributeId;
        });
    }

   
    public void removeRole(final int categoryId, final int attributeId,
            final String role, final String expectedSignature) throws SQLException {
        if (categoryId <= 0 || attributeId <= 0 || !validRole(role)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Dữ liệu gỡ thuộc tính không hợp lệ.");
        }
        inTransaction(conn -> {
            checkChildCategory(conn, categoryId);
            Mapping old = readMapping(conn, categoryId, attributeId);
            checkSignature(old, expectedSignature);
            if (old == null || !includesRole(old.type, role)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Thuộc tính chưa được gán cho vai trò này.");
            }
            if (hasValueForRole(conn, categoryId, attributeId, role)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Không thể bỏ gán vì sản phẩm/SKU trong danh mục đã có giá trị. "
                        + "Cần xử lý dữ liệu liên quan trước.");
            }
            if ("BOTH".equals(old.type)) {
                String remaining = SPECIFICATION.equals(role) ? VARIANT : SPECIFICATION;
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                        "UPDATE CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE SET attribute_type = ? "
                        + "WHERE category_id=? AND attribute_id=?")) {
                    ps.setString(1, remaining);
                    ps.setInt(2, categoryId);
                    ps.setInt(3, attributeId);
                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }
            } else {
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                        "DELETE FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE WHERE category_id=? AND attribute_id=?")) {
                    ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
                    ps.setInt(2, attributeId);
                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }
            }
            return null;
        });
    }

  
    public void updateDefinition(final int categoryId, final int attributeId,
            final String role, final String name, final String dataType,
            final String unit) throws SQLException {
        validateDefinition(name, dataType, unit);
        if (categoryId <= 0 || attributeId <= 0 || !validRole(role)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Thuộc tính không hợp lệ.");
        }
        inTransaction(conn -> {
            checkChildCategory(conn, categoryId);
            Mapping mapping = readMapping(conn, categoryId, attributeId);
            if (mapping == null || !includesRole(mapping.type, role)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Thuộc tính chưa thuộc danh mục/vai trò này.");
            }
            String opposite = SPECIFICATION.equals(role) ? VARIANT : SPECIFICATION;
            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                    "SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE WITH (HOLDLOCK) "
                    + "WHERE attribute_id=? AND attribute_type IN ('BOTH', ?)")) {
                ps.setInt(1, attributeId);
                ps.setString(2, opposite);
                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                    if (rs.next()) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Thuộc tính có dùng chung với phía "
                                + (SPECIFICATION.equals(role) ? "SKU" : "thông số")
                                + ". Chỉ được chỉnh cấu hình theo danh mục, "
                                + "không đổi tên/kiểu/đơn vị dùng chung.");
                    }
                }
            }
            if (hasAnyOtherRoleValue(conn, attributeId, role)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Thuộc tính còn dữ liệu ở phía khác, không thể sửa định nghĩa chung.");
            }
            String oldType;
            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                    "SELECT data_type FROM ATTRIBUTE WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                    + "WHERE attribute_id=? AND is_active=1")) {
                ps.setInt(1, attributeId);
                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                    if (!rs.next()) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Thuộc tính đã ngừng dùng.");
                    }
                    oldType = rs.getString(1);
                }
            }
            if (!oldType.equals(dataType) && hasAnyValue(conn, attributeId)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Đã có giá trị Product/SKU. Không đổi được kiểu dữ liệu; "
                        + "vẫn có thể đổi tên hoặc đơn vị nếu không dùng chung vai trò.");
            }
            checkUniqueName(conn, name.trim(), attributeId);
            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                    "UPDATE ATTRIBUTE SET attribute_name=?, data_type=?, unit=? WHERE attribute_id=?")) {
                ps.setNString(1, name.trim());
                ps.setString(2, dataType);
                ps.setNString(3, normalizeUnit(unit));
                ps.setInt(4, attributeId);
                ps.executeUpdate();
            }
            return null;
        });
    }


    public int hardDeleteAttribute(final int attributeId,
            final String confirmedAttributeName) throws SQLException {
        if (attributeId <= 0 || confirmedAttributeName == null
                || confirmedAttributeName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mã hoặc tên xác nhận xóa không hợp lệ.");
        }
        return inTransaction(conn -> {
            String actualName;
            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                    "SELECT attribute_name FROM ATTRIBUTE WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                    + "WHERE attribute_id=?")) {
                ps.setInt(1, attributeId);
                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                    if (!rs.next()) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Thuộc tính không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa.");
                    }
                    actualName = rs.getString(1);
                }
            }
            if (!actualName.equals(confirmedAttributeName)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Tên thuộc tính đã thay đổi hoặc xác nhận chưa chính xác. "
                        + "Tải lại trang và thử lại.");
            }

            if (hasAny(conn,
                    "SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                    + "WHERE attribute_id=?", attributeId)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Không thể xóa cứng: thuộc tính đã có giá trị trong "
                        + "PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION. Hãy xử lý dữ liệu sản phẩm trước.");
            }
            if (hasAny(conn,
                    "SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                    + "WHERE attribute_id=?", attributeId)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Không thể xóa cứng: thuộc tính đã có giá trị trong "
                        + "SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE. Không được xóa thuộc tính SKU đang dùng.");
            }

            int linksRemoved;
            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                    "DELETE FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE WHERE attribute_id=?")) {
                ps.setInt(1, attributeId);
                linksRemoved = ps.executeUpdate();
            }
            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                    "DELETE FROM ATTRIBUTE WHERE attribute_id=?")) {
                ps.setInt(1, attributeId);
                if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                    throw new SQLException("Không xóa được bản ghi ATTRIBUTE.");
                }
            }
            return linksRemoved;
        });
    }

    private static void validateDefinition(String name, String type, String unit) {
        if (name == null || name.trim().isEmpty() || name.trim().length() > 100
                || !("TEXT".equals(type) || "NUMBER".equals(type)
                || "BOOLEAN".equals(type))
                || (unit != null && unit.trim().length() > 30)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Tên tối đa 100 ký tự; kiểu TEXT/NUMBER/BOOLEAN; đơn vị tối đa 30 ký tự.");
        }
    }

    private static String normalizeUnit(String unit) {
        return unit == null || unit.trim().isEmpty() ? null : unit.trim();
    }

    private void checkSignature(Mapping actual, String expected) {
        if (expected == null || !expected.equals(signature(actual))) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Cấu hình đã thay đổi ở phiên khác. Tải lại trang và thử lại.");
        }
    }

    private void checkChildCategory(Connection conn, int id) throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                "SELECT parent_id FROM CATEGORY WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE category_id=?")) {
            ps.setInt(1, id);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next() || rs.getObject(1) == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Chỉ cấu hình cho danh mục con tồn tại.");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void assertActiveAttribute(Connection conn, int id) throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                "SELECT 1 FROM ATTRIBUTE WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE attribute_id=? AND is_active=1")) {
            ps.setInt(1, id);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Thuộc tính không hoạt động hoặc không tồn tại.");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private Mapping readMapping(Connection conn, int categoryId, int attributeId)
            throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                "SELECT attribute_type, group_name, is_required, is_filterable, "
                + "display_order FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE category_id=? AND attribute_id=?")) {
            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(2, attributeId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    return null;
                }
                Mapping mapping = new Mapping();
                mapping.type = rs.getString(1);
                mapping.group = rs.getString(2);
                mapping.required = rs.getBoolean(3);
                mapping.filterable = rs.getBoolean(4);
                mapping.order = rs.getInt(5);
                return mapping;
            }
        }
    }

    private void checkUniqueName(Connection conn, String name, int excludedId)
            throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                "SELECT TOP 1 attribute_id FROM ATTRIBUTE WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(attribute_name))) = "
                + "LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(?))) AND attribute_id<>?")) {
            ps.setNString(1, name);
            ps.setInt(2, excludedId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Thuộc tính đã có trong ATTRIBUTE. Chọn từ danh sách để gán, không tạo trùng.");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean hasValueForRole(Connection conn, int categoryId, int attrId,
            String role) throws SQLException {
        String sql;
        if (VARIANT.equals(role)) {
            sql = "SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM PRODUCT p "
                    + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.product_id=p.product_id "
                    + "JOIN SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE sav WITH (HOLDLOCK) ON sav.sku_id=s.sku_id "
                    + "WHERE p.category_id=? AND sav.attribute_id=?";
        } else {
            sql = "SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM PRODUCT p "
                    + "JOIN PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps WITH (HOLDLOCK) ON ps.product_id=p.product_id "
                    + "WHERE p.category_id=? AND ps.attribute_id=?";
        }
        return exists(conn, sql, categoryId, attrId);
    }

    private boolean hasAnyOtherRoleValue(Connection conn, int attrId, String currentRole)
            throws SQLException {
        String table = SPECIFICATION.equals(currentRole)
                ? "SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE" : "PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION";
        return hasAny(conn, "SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM " + table
                + " WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE attribute_id=?", attrId);
    }

    private boolean hasAnyValue(Connection conn, int attrId) throws SQLException {
        return hasAny(conn, "SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION WITH (HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE attribute_id=?", attrId)
                || hasAny(conn, "SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE WITH (HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE attribute_id=?", attrId);
    }

    private boolean hasAny(Connection conn, String sql, int attributeId) throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, attributeId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean exists(Connection conn, String sql, int categoryId, int attributeId)
            throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(2, attributeId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.OrderStatistics;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.Date;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class DashboardDAO extends DBContext {

    public OrderStatistics getOrderStatistics(LocalDate start, LocalDate end, boolean byMonth) {
        LocalDate endExclusive = end.plusDays(1);
        OrderStatistics statistics = new OrderStatistics();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException("Không kết nối được SQL Server.");
            }
            conn.setTransactionIsolation(Connection.TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE);
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                loadOrderCounts(conn, start, endExclusive, statistics);
                loadRevenue(conn, start, endExclusive, byMonth, statistics);
                loadTopProducts(conn, start, endExclusive, statistics);
                conn.commit();
                return statistics;
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
                }
                throw e;
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Không thể tải thống kê Dashboard.", e);
        }
    }

    private void loadOrderCounts(Connection conn, LocalDate start, LocalDate endExclusive,
            OrderStatistics statistics) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, "
                + "COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completed_orders, "
                + "COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) AS cancelled_orders "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WHERE created_at >= ? AND created_at < ?";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            setDateRange(ps, start, endExclusive);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                rs.next();
                statistics.setTotalOrders(rs.getInt("total_orders"));
                statistics.setCompletedOrders(rs.getInt("completed_orders"));
                statistics.setCancelledOrders(rs.getInt("cancelled_orders"));
            }
        }
    }

    private void loadRevenue(Connection conn, LocalDate start, LocalDate endExclusive,
            boolean byMonth, OrderStatistics statistics) throws SQLException {
        String period = byMonth ? "CONVERT(CHAR(7), created_at, 126)" : "CAST(created_at AS DATE)";
        String sql = "SELECT " + period + " AS sale_period, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WHERE created_at >= ? AND created_at < ? "
                + "AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND payment_status = 'PAID' "
                + "GROUP BY " + period + " ORDER BY sale_period";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            setDateRange(ps, start, endExclusive);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    BigDecimal revenue = rs.getBigDecimal("revenue");
                    Object label = byMonth ? rs.getString("sale_period") : rs.getDate("sale_period");
                    statistics.addRevenueRow(new Object[]{label, revenue});
                    statistics.setRevenue(statistics.getRevenue().add(revenue));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void loadTopProducts(Connection conn, LocalDate start, LocalDate endExclusive,
            OrderStatistics statistics) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT TOP 5 p.product_name, p.image_url, prices.min_price, "
                + "SUM(CAST(oi.quantity AS BIGINT)) AS sold "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.sku_id = oi.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = s.product_id "
                + "JOIN (SELECT product_id, MIN(price) AS min_price "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU GROUP BY product_id) prices ON prices.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' "
                + "GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.image_url, prices.min_price "
                + "HAVING SUM(CAST(oi.quantity AS BIGINT)) > 0 "
                + "ORDER BY sold DESC, p.product_id";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            setDateRange(ps, start, endExclusive);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    statistics.addTopProduct(new Object[]{
                        rs.getString("product_name"), rs.getString("image_url"),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("min_price"), Math.toIntExact(rs.getLong("sold"))
                    });
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void setDateRange(PreparedStatement ps, LocalDate start, LocalDate endExclusive) throws SQLException {
        ps.setDate(1, Date.valueOf(start));
        ps.setDate(2, Date.valueOf(endExclusive));
        ps.setQueryTimeout(30);
    }

    // Thống kê số SKU theo tồn kho thực tế.
    // Trên 5: đủ hàng; 1-5: sắp hết; 0: hết hàng.
    public Map<String, Integer> getCurrentStockStatistics() {
        String sql = "SELECT "
                + "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stock_quantity > 5 "
                + "THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_stock, "
                + "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stock_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 5 "
                + "THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS low_stock, "
                + "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stock_quantity = 0 "
                + "THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS out_stock, "
                + "COALESCE(SUM(stock_quantity), 0) AS total_stock, "
                + "COALESCE(SUM(reserved_quantity), 0) AS total_reserved "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException("Không kết nối được SQL Server.");
            }
            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
                    ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    int totalStock = rs.getInt("total_stock");
                    int reservedStock = rs.getInt("total_reserved");
                    return Map.of(
                            "stockAvailable", rs.getInt("in_stock"),
                            "stockLow", rs.getInt("low_stock"),
                            "stockOut", rs.getInt("out_stock"),
                            "totalStock", totalStock,
                            "reservedStock", reservedStock,
                            "sellableStock", totalStock - reservedStock);
                }
                throw new SQLException("Không đọc được thống kê tồn kho.");
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Không thể tải thống kê tồn kho.", e);
        }
    }

    // Đơn đang chờ Staff xử lý hoặc đang được chuẩn bị, không giới hạn ngày.
    public Map<String, Integer> getProcessingOrderStatistics() {
        String sql = "SELECT "
                + "COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION' THEN 1 END) AS pending, "
                + "COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 END) AS confirmed, "
                + "COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status = 'PACKING' THEN 1 END) AS packing "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE order_status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION', 'CONFIRMED', 'PACKING')";
        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException("Không kết nối được SQL Server.");
            }
            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
                    ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    int pending = rs.getInt("pending");
                    int confirmed = rs.getInt("confirmed");
                    int packing = rs.getInt("packing");
                    return Map.of(
                            "pendingOrders", pending,
                            "confirmedOrders", confirmed,
                            "packingOrders", packing,
                            "processingOrders", pending + confirmed + packing);
                }
                throw new SQLException("Không đọc được số đơn đang xử lý.");
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Không thể đếm đơn đang xử lý.", e);
        }
    }

    // Danh sách SKU có tồn kho thực tế từ 0 đến 5.
    public List<Object[]> getLowStockProducts() {
        List<Object[]> products = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT s.sku_code, p.product_name, p.image_url, "
                + "s.stock_quantity, s.price "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = s.product_id "
                + "WHERE s.stock_quantity <= 5 "
                + "ORDER BY s.stock_quantity, p.product_name, s.sku_code";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException("Không kết nối được SQL Server.");
            }
            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
                    ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    products.add(new Object[]{rs.getString("sku_code"),
                        rs.getString("product_name"), rs.getString("image_url"),
                        rs.getInt("stock_quantity"), rs.getBigDecimal("price")});
                }
            }
            return products;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Không thể tải danh sách tồn kho thấp.", e);
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.InventoryItem;
import model.InventoryMovement;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Types;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class InventoryDAO extends DBContext {

    public boolean isAuthorizedStaff(int userId) throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT TOP (1) 1 "
                + "FROM dbo.[USER] u "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.ROLES r "
                + "ON u.role_id = r.role_id "
                + "WHERE u.user_id = ? "
                + "AND u.is_active = 1 "
                + "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.role_name))) "
                + "IN ('STAFF', 'ADMIN')";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        }
    }

    public int countItems(String keyword, String status) throws SQLException {
        Filter filter = makeFilter(keyword, status);
        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) " + filter.sql;
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            bindFilter(ps, filter);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next() ? rs.getInt(1) : 0;
            }
        }
    }

    public List<InventoryItem> findItems(String keyword, String status,
            int page, int pageSize) throws SQLException {
        Filter filter = makeFilter(keyword, status);
        String sql = "SELECT s.sku_id, s.product_id, s.sku_code, "
                + "p.product_name, s.stock_quantity, s.is_active AS sku_active, "
                + "p.is_active AS product_active " + filter.sql
                + " ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.is_active=1 AND p.is_active=1 "
                + "THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.stock_quantity ASC, s.sku_id DESC "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";
        List<InventoryItem> result = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            int index = bindFilter(ps, filter);
            ps.setInt(index++, (page - 1) * pageSize);
            ps.setInt(index, pageSize);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    result.add(new InventoryItem(
                            rs.getInt("sku_id"), rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("sku_code"), rs.getString("product_name"),
                            rs.getInt("stock_quantity"), rs.getBoolean("sku_active"),
                            rs.getBoolean("product_active")));
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public List<InventoryMovement> getRecentMovements(int limit)
            throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT TOP (?) m.movement_id, s.sku_code, "
                + "p.product_name, m.movement_type, m.quantity_delta, "
                + "m.quantity_before, m.quantity_after, m.note, "
                + "u.username AS actor_name, m.created_at "
                + "FROM dbo.INVENTORY_MOVEMENT m "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.sku_id=m.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id=s.product_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.[USER] u ON u.user_id=m.actor_user_id "
                + "ORDER BY m.movement_id DESC";
        List<InventoryMovement> result = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, Math.max(1, Math.min(100, limit)));
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    result.add(new InventoryMovement(
                            rs.getLong("movement_id"), rs.getString("sku_code"),
                            rs.getString("product_name"), rs.getString("movement_type"),
                            rs.getInt("quantity_delta"), rs.getInt("quantity_before"),
                            rs.getInt("quantity_after"), rs.getString("note"),
                            rs.getString("actor_name"), rs.getTimestamp("created_at")));
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

  
    public int changeStock(int skuId, String action, int quantity,
            String note, int actorUserId) throws SQLException {
        if (skuId <= 0 || actorUserId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("SKU hoặc nhân viên không hợp lệ.");
        }
        if (!"IN".equals(action) && !"OUT".equals(action)
                && !"SET".equals(action)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Loại điều chỉnh không hợp lệ.");
        }
        if (quantity < 0 || (!"SET".equals(action) && quantity == 0)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Số lượng không hợp lệ.");
        }
        if (note == null || note.trim().isEmpty() || note.trim().length() > 500) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cần nhập lý do (tối đa 500 ký tự).");
        }

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                int oldQty;
                String readSql = "SELECT s.stock_quantity FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id=s.product_id "
                        + "WHERE s.sku_id=? AND s.is_active=1 AND p.is_active=1";
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(readSql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, skuId);
                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "SKU không tồn tại hoặc đã ngừng kinh doanh.");
                        }
                        oldQty = rs.getInt(1);
                        if (rs.wasNull()) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException("SKU có tồn kho NULL.");
                        }
                    }
                }

                long newQtyLong;
                if ("IN".equals(action)) {
                    newQtyLong = (long) oldQty + quantity;
                } else if ("OUT".equals(action)) {
                    newQtyLong = (long) oldQty - quantity;
                } else {
                    newQtyLong = quantity;
                }
                if (newQtyLong < 0 || newQtyLong > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Không đủ hàng hoặc vượt giới hạn tồn kho.");
                }
                int newQty = (int) newQtyLong;
                if (newQty == oldQty) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Số tồn mới không thay đổi.");
                }

                setContext(conn, "oecs_inventory_action", action);
                setContext(conn, "oecs_inventory_note", note.trim());
                setContext(conn, "oecs_inventory_user_id", actorUserId);

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                        "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU SET stock_quantity=? "
                        + "WHERE sku_id=? AND stock_quantity=?")) {
                    ps.setInt(1, newQty);
                    ps.setInt(2, skuId);
                    ps.setInt(3, oldQty);
                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        throw new SQLException("Dữ liệu tồn kho đã thay đổi. Vui lòng tải lại.");
                    }
                }

               
                InventoryMovementHelper.record(
                        conn,
                        skuId,
                        action,
                        oldQty,
                        newQty,
                        note.trim(),
                        actorUserId
                );

                conn.commit();
                return newQty;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
                    ex.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
                }
                throw ex;
            } finally {
               
                SQLException clearError = null;
                for (String key : new String[]{
                    "oecs_inventory_action", "oecs_inventory_note",
                    "oecs_inventory_user_id"}) {
                    try {
                        setContext(conn, key, null);
                    } catch (SQLException ex) {
                        if (clearError == null) {
                            clearError = ex;
                        } else {
                            clearError.addSuppressed(ex);
                        }
                    }
                }
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(true);
                } catch (SQLException ex) {
                    if (clearError == null) {
                        clearError = ex;
                    } else {
                        clearError.addSuppressed(ex);
                    }
                }
                if (clearError != null) {
                    throw clearError;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void setContext(Connection conn, String key, Object value)
            throws SQLException {
        String sql = "EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'" + key
                + "', @value=?";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            if (value == null) {
                ps.setNull(1, Types.NVARCHAR);
            } else if (value instanceof Integer) {
                ps.setInt(1, (Integer) value);
            } else {
                ps.setString(1, (String) value);
            }
            ps.execute();
        }
    }

    private Filter makeFilter(String keyword, String status) {
        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id=s.product_id "
                + "WHERE 1=1");
        String normalized = keyword == null ? "" : keyword.trim();
        if (normalized.length() > 100) {
            normalized = normalized.substring(0, 100);
        }
        if (!normalized.isEmpty()) {
            sql.append(" AND (s.sku_code LIKE ? ESCAPE '~' "
                    + "OR p.product_name LIKE ? ESCAPE '~')");
        }
        if ("LOW".equals(status)) {
            sql.append(" AND s.stock_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 5");
        } else if ("OUT".equals(status)) {
            sql.append(" AND s.stock_quantity=0");
        }
        return new Filter(sql.toString(), normalized);
    }

    private int bindFilter(PreparedStatement ps, Filter filter)
            throws SQLException {
        int i = 1;
        if (!filter.keyword.isEmpty()) {
            String pattern = "%" + filter.keyword
                    .replace("~", "~~").replace("%", "~%")
                    .replace("_", "~_").replace("[", "~[") + "%";
            ps.setString(i++, pattern);
            ps.setString(i++, pattern);
        }
        return i;
    }

    private static class Filter {

        final String sql;
        final String keyword;

        Filter(String sql, String keyword) {
            this.sql = sql;
            this.keyword = keyword;
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Types;

public final class InventoryMovementHelper {

    private InventoryMovementHelper() {
    }

    public static void record(Connection conn, int skuId, String movementType,
            int before, int after, String note, Integer actorUserId)
            throws SQLException {
        if (conn == null || skuId <= 0 || before < 0 || after < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid stock-movement arguments.");
        }
        if (movementType == null
                || !(movementType.equals("OPENING") || movementType.equals("IN")
                || movementType.equals("OUT") || movementType.equals("SET")
                || movementType.equals("SYSTEM"))) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid movement type.");
        }
        if (note != null && note.length() > 500) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Movement note exceeds 500 characters.");
        }

        long delta = (long) after - before;
        if (delta > Integer.MAX_VALUE || delta < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Movement delta out of SQL INT range.");
        }
        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.INVENTORY_MOVEMENT "
                + "(sku_id,movement_type,quantity_delta,quantity_before,"
                + "quantity_after,note,actor_user_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, skuId);
            ps.setString(2, movementType);
            ps.setInt(3, (int) delta);
            ps.setInt(4, before);
            ps.setInt(5, after);
            if (note == null) {
                ps.setNull(6, Types.NVARCHAR);
            } else {
                ps.setNString(6, note);
            }
            if (actorUserId == null) {
                ps.setNull(7, Types.INTEGER);
            } else {
                ps.setInt(7, actorUserId);
            }
            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new SQLException("Could not write inventory movement.");
            }
        }
    }

    public static void recordAfterDelta(Connection conn, int skuId, int delta,
            String movementType, String note,
            Integer actorUserId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT stock_quantity FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE sku_id=?";
        int after;
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, skuId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new SQLException("SKU not found: " + skuId);
                }
                after = rs.getInt(1);
                if (rs.wasNull()) {
                    throw new SQLException("SKU stock is NULL.");
                }
            }
        }
        long before = (long) after - delta;
        if (before < 0 || before > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
            throw new SQLException("Invalid prior stock value for SKU " + skuId);
        }
        record(conn, skuId, movementType, (int) before, after, note, actorUserId);
    }
}

package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Notification;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class NotificationDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(NotificationDAO.class.getName());


    public boolean createOrderStatusNotification(
            int orderId,
            String status) {

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            return createOrderStatusNotification(
                    conn,
                    orderId,
                    status
            );

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error creating order status notification",
                    ex
            );

            return false;
        }
    }

    public static boolean createOrderStatusNotification(
            Connection conn,
            int orderId,
            String status) throws SQLException {

        if (conn == null || conn.isClosed()) {
            throw new SQLException(
                    "Kết nối database không hợp lệ.");
        }

        if (orderId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ.");
        }

        String normalizedStatus =
                status == null
                ? ""
                : status.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

        String title;
        String message;

        switch (normalizedStatus) {

            case "CONFIRMED":

                title = "Đơn hàng đã được xác nhận";

                message =
                        "Đơn hàng #" + orderId
                        + " của bạn đã được xác nhận "
                        + "và đang được chuẩn bị.";

                break;

            case "PACKING":

                title = "Đơn hàng đang được đóng gói";

                message =
                        "Đơn hàng #" + orderId
                        + " đang trong quá trình đóng gói.";

                break;

            case "SHIPPING":
            case "SHIPPED":

                title = "Đơn hàng đang được vận chuyển";

                message =
                        "Đơn hàng #" + orderId
                        + " đã được bàn giao cho đơn vị "
                        + "vận chuyển. Vui lòng chú ý điện "
                        + "thoại để nhận hàng.";

                break;

            case "DELIVERED":

                title = "Đơn hàng đã giao thành công";

                message =
                        "Đơn hàng #" + orderId
                        + " đã được giao thành công. "
                        + "Cảm ơn bạn đã mua sắm tại OECS!";

                break;

            case "COMPLETED":

                title = "Đơn hàng đã hoàn tất";

                message =
                        "Đơn hàng #" + orderId
                        + " đã hoàn tất. "
                        + "Hy vọng bạn hài lòng với sản phẩm!";

                break;

            case "CANCELLED":
            case "CANCELED":

                title = "Đơn hàng đã bị hủy";

                message =
                        "Đơn hàng #" + orderId
                        + " của bạn đã bị hủy. "
                        + "Nếu cần hỗ trợ, vui lòng liên hệ "
                        + "nhân viên OECS.";

                break;

            default:

                LOGGER.warning(
                        "Unsupported order status: " + status
                );

                return false;
        }

        String sql =
                "INSERT INTO dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "(user_id, order_id, title, message) "
                + "SELECT o.user_id, o.order_id, ?, ? "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps =
                conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, title);
            ps.setString(2, message);
            ps.setInt(3, orderId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        }
    }


    public void createReturnExchangeNotification(
            Connection conn,
            int userId,
            int orderId,
            String requestType,
            String status) throws SQLException {

        if (conn == null || conn.isClosed()) {
            throw new SQLException(
                    "Kết nối database không hợp lệ.");
        }

        if (userId <= 0 || orderId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Thông tin khách hàng hoặc đơn hàng "
                    + "không hợp lệ.");
        }

        if (!"RETURN".equals(requestType)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Hệ thống chỉ hỗ trợ yêu cầu trả hàng.");
        }

        String title = "Cập nhật yêu cầu trả hàng";

        String message;

        if ("APPROVED".equals(status)) {

            message =
                    "Yêu cầu trả hàng cho đơn hàng #"
                    + orderId
                    + " đã được chấp nhận. "
                    + "Nhân viên sẽ liên hệ với bạn "
                    + "để hướng dẫn các bước tiếp theo.";

        } else if ("REJECTED".equals(status)) {

            message =
                    "Yêu cầu trả hàng cho đơn hàng #"
                    + orderId
                    + " đã bị từ chối. "
                    + "Vui lòng xem ghi chú xử lý "
                    + "trong chi tiết đơn hàng.";

        } else {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Trạng thái yêu cầu trả hàng "
                    + "không hợp lệ.");
        }

        String sql =
                "INSERT INTO dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "(user_id, order_id, title, message) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps =
                conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setInt(2, orderId);
            ps.setString(3, title);
            ps.setString(4, message);

            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Không thể tạo thông báo trả hàng.");
            }
        }
    }


    public int countUnread(int userId) {

        String sql =
                "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "AND is_read = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error counting unread notifications",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }


    public List<Notification> findLatest(int userId) {

        List<Notification> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql =
                "SELECT TOP 20 "
                + "notification_id, user_id, order_id, "
                + "title, message, is_read, created_at "
                + "FROM dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC, "
                + "notification_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    Notification notification =
                            new Notification();

                    notification.setNotificationId(
                            rs.getInt("notification_id")
                    );

                    notification.setUserId(
                            rs.getInt("user_id")
                    );

                    int orderId = rs.getInt("order_id");

                    if (rs.wasNull()) {

                        notification.setOrderId(null);

                    } else {

                        notification.setOrderId(orderId);
                    }

                    notification.setTitle(
                            rs.getString("title")
                    );

                    notification.setMessage(
                            rs.getString("message")
                    );

                    notification.setRead(
                            rs.getBoolean("is_read")
                    );

                    notification.setCreatedAt(
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at")
                    );

                    list.add(notification);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting latest notifications",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }


    public boolean markAsRead(
            int notificationId,
            int userId) {

        String sql =
                "UPDATE dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "SET is_read = 1 "
                + "WHERE notification_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, notificationId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error marking notification as read",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return false;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import model.Order;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Collections;

public class OrderDAO {

    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public OrderDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public OrderDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    private Connection getConnection() throws SQLException {
        Connection conn = connections.open();
        if (conn == null) {
            throw new SQLException("Khong ket noi duoc database.");
        }
        return conn;
    }

    public List<Order> findByUser(int userId) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            return findByUser(conn, userId);
        }
    }

    private static final String PURCHASE_SEARCH = " FROM dbo.[ORDER] o WHERE o.user_id = ? "
            + "AND (? = N'' OR CONVERT(varchar(20), o.order_id) = ? OR EXISTS ("
            + "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM si JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ss ON ss.sku_id = si.sku_id "
            + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT sp ON sp.product_id = ss.product_id WHERE si.order_id = o.order_id "
            + "AND (COALESCE(si.product_name_snapshot,sp.product_name) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' OR COALESCE(si.sku_code_snapshot,ss.sku_code) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'))) ";

    private int bindPurchaseSearch(PreparedStatement ps, int userId, String query) throws SQLException {
        String text = query == null ? "" : query.trim();
        String pattern = "%" + text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%")
                .replace("_", "\\_").replace("[", "\\[") + "%";
        ps.setInt(1, userId);
        ps.setNString(2, text);
        ps.setString(3, text.startsWith("#") ? text.substring(1) : text);
        ps.setNString(4, pattern);
        ps.setNString(5, pattern);
        return 6;
    }

    public Map<String, Long> countPurchasesByStatus(int userId, String query) throws SQLException {
        Map<String, Long> counts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        String sql = "SELECT o.order_status, COUNT_BIG(*) AS total" + PURCHASE_SEARCH + "GROUP BY o.order_status";
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            bindPurchaseSearch(ps, userId, query);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    counts.put(rs.getString("order_status"), rs.getLong("total"));
                }
            }
        }
        return counts;
    }

    public List<Order> findPurchasePage(int userId, String query, List<String> statuses,
            long offset, int pageSize) throws SQLException {
        if (offset < 0 || pageSize < 1 || pageSize > 50) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid page");
        }
        String statusFilter = statuses.isEmpty() ? "" : "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.order_status))) IN ("
                + String.join(",", Collections.nCopies(statuses.size(), "?")) + ") ";
        String sql = "SELECT o.*" + PURCHASE_SEARCH + statusFilter
                + "ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.order_id DESC OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";
        List<Order> result = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            int index = bindPurchaseSearch(ps, userId, query);
            for (String status : statuses) {
                ps.setString(index++, status);
            }
            ps.setLong(index++, offset);
            ps.setInt(index, pageSize);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    result.add(mapOrder(rs));
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public Map<Integer, List<Map<String, Object>>> findItemsForOrders(int userId, List<Integer> ids) throws SQLException {
        Map<Integer, List<Map<String, Object>>> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (ids.isEmpty()) {
            return result;
        }
        if (ids.size() > 50) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Too many orders");
        }
        String sql = "SELECT i.order_id, i.sku_id, i.price, i.quantity, COALESCE(i.sku_code_snapshot,s.sku_code) AS sku_code, COALESCE(i.product_name_snapshot,p.product_name) AS product_name, p.image_url "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM i JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = i.order_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = s.product_id WHERE o.user_id = ? "
                + "AND o.order_id IN (" + String.join(",", Collections.nCopies(ids.size(), "?"))
                + ") ORDER BY i.order_id, i.order_item_id";
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            for (int i = 0; i < ids.size(); i++) {
                ps.setInt(i + 2, ids.get(i));
            }
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    item.put("skuId", rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                    item.put("imageUrl", rs.getString("image_url"));
                    item.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    item.put("productName", rs.getString("product_name"));
                    item.put("price", rs.getBigDecimal("price"));
                    item.put("quantity", rs.getInt("quantity"));
                    result.computeIfAbsent(rs.getInt("order_id"), key -> new ArrayList<>()).add(item);
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public int insert(Connection conn, Order order) throws SQLException {
        return insert(conn, order, null);
    }

    public int insert(
            Connection conn,
            Order order,
            String checkoutToken) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "(user_id, address_id, total_amount, shipping_fee, "
                + "order_status, payment_method, payment_status, "
                + "recipient_name, recipient_phone, shipping_address, "
                + "discount_amount, checkout_token) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                sql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

            ps.setInt(1, order.getUserId());
            ps.setInt(2, order.getAddressId());
            ps.setBigDecimal(3, order.getTotalAmount());
            ps.setBigDecimal(4, order.getShippingFee());
            ps.setString(5, order.getOrderStatus());
            ps.setString(6, order.getPaymentMethod());
            ps.setString(7, order.getPaymentStatus());
            ps.setString(8, order.getRecipientName());
            ps.setString(9, order.getRecipientPhone());
            ps.setString(10, order.getShippingAddress());
            ps.setBigDecimal(11, order.getDiscountAmount());
            ps.setString(12, checkoutToken);

            ps.executeUpdate();

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Khong lay duoc ma don hang."
                    );
                }

                return rs.getInt(1);
            }
        }
    }

    public void insertItem(
            Connection conn,
            int orderId,
            int skuId,
            BigDecimal price,
            int quantity
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_ITEM "
                + "(order_id, sku_id, price, quantity, product_name_snapshot, sku_code_snapshot) "
                + "SELECT ?, ?, ?, ?, p.product_name, s.sku_code "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id=s.product_id "
                + "WHERE s.sku_id=?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);
            ps.setBigDecimal(3, price);
            ps.setInt(4, quantity);
            ps.setInt(5, skuId);

            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new SQLException("Không lưu được sản phẩm trong đơn hàng.");
            }
        }
    }

    public void addHistory(
            Connection conn,
            int orderId,
            String status
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY "
                + "(order_id, status) VALUES (?, ?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setString(2, status);

            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    public Integer findIdByToken(
            Connection conn,
            int userId,
            String checkoutToken
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "SELECT order_id "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? AND checkout_token = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setString(2, checkoutToken);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("order_id");
                }

                return null;
            }
        }
    }

    public Integer findIdByToken(
            int userId,
            String checkoutToken
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Khong ket noi duoc database."
                );
            }

            return findIdByToken(conn, userId, checkoutToken);
        }
    }

    public Order findByIdAndUser(
            int orderId,
            int userId
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "SELECT * FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Khong ket noi duoc database."
                );
            }

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                ps.setInt(2, userId);

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                    if (rs.next()) {
                        return mapOrder(rs);
                    }

                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public List<Order> findByUser(
            Connection conn,
            int userId
    ) throws SQLException {

        List<Order> orders = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT * FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC, order_id DESC";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    orders.add(mapOrder(rs));
                }
            }
        }

        return orders;
    }

    private Order mapOrder(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
        Order order = new Order();

        order.setOrderId(rs.getInt("order_id"));
        order.setCancelRequestStatus(rs.getString("cancel_request_status"));
        order.setCancelRequestReason(rs.getString("cancel_request_reason"));
        order.setCancelReviewNote(rs.getString("cancel_review_note"));
        order.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
        order.setAddressId(rs.getInt("address_id"));

        order.setTotalAmount(rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount"));
        order.setShippingFee(rs.getBigDecimal("shipping_fee"));
        order.setDiscountAmount(rs.getBigDecimal("discount_amount"));

        order.setOrderStatus(rs.getString("order_status"));
        order.setPaymentMethod(rs.getString("payment_method"));
        order.setPaymentStatus(rs.getString("payment_status"));

        order.setRecipientName(rs.getString("recipient_name"));
        order.setRecipientPhone(rs.getString("recipient_phone"));
        order.setShippingAddress(rs.getString("shipping_address"));

        order.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
        order.setPaymentExpiresAt(
                rs.getTimestamp(
                        "payment_expires_at",
                        java.util.Calendar.getInstance(
                                java.util.TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC")
                        )
                )
        );

        return order;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findItems(int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT i.order_item_id, i.sku_id, i.price, i.quantity, COALESCE(i.sku_code_snapshot,s.sku_code) AS sku_code, COALESCE(i.product_name_snapshot,p.product_name) AS product_name, p.image_url "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM i JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = i.order_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = s.product_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? ORDER BY i.order_item_id";
        List<Map<String, Object>> items = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    item.put("orderItemId", rs.getInt("order_item_id"));
                    item.put("skuId", rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                    item.put("imageUrl", rs.getString("image_url"));
                    item.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    item.put("productName", rs.getString("product_name"));
                    item.put("price", rs.getBigDecimal("price"));
                    item.put("quantity", rs.getInt("quantity"));
                    items.add(item);
                }
            }
        }
        return items;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findHistory(int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT h.status, h.old_status, h.reason, h.actor_type, h.updated_at FROM dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY h "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = h.order_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? ORDER BY h.updated_at, h.status_id";
        List<Map<String, Object>> history = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> entry = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    entry.put("status", rs.getString("status"));
                    entry.put("oldStatus", rs.getString("old_status"));
                    entry.put("reason", rs.getString("reason"));
                    entry.put("actorType", rs.getString("actor_type"));
                    entry.put("updatedAt", rs.getTimestamp("updated_at"));
                    history.add(entry);
                }
            }
        }
        return history;
    }
}
package dao;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class OrderInventoryDAO {

    public void deduct(Connection connection, int orderId) throws SQLException {
        adjust(connection, orderId, true);
    }

    public void restore(Connection connection, int orderId) throws SQLException {
        adjust(connection, orderId, false);
    }

    public void reserve(Connection connection, int orderId) throws SQLException {
        changeReservation(connection, orderId, true);
    }

   
    public void releaseReservation(Connection connection, int orderId) throws SQLException {
        changeReservation(connection, orderId, false);
    }

    private void changeReservation(Connection connection, int orderId, boolean reserve)
            throws SQLException {
        String itemsSql = "SELECT sku_id, SUM(CAST(quantity AS bigint)) AS qty "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM WHERE order_id=? GROUP BY sku_id ORDER BY sku_id";
        String updateSql = reserve
                ? "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU SET reserved_quantity=reserved_quantity+? "
                + "WHERE sku_id=? AND stock_quantity-reserved_quantity>=? AND is_active=1 "
                + "AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PRODUCT p WITH (HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE p.product_id=PRODUCT_SKU.product_id AND p.is_active=1)"
                : "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU SET reserved_quantity=reserved_quantity-? "
                + "WHERE sku_id=? AND reserved_quantity>=?";
        int count = 0;
        try (PreparedStatement items = connection.prepareStatement(itemsSql);
                PreparedStatement update = connection.prepareStatement(updateSql)) {
            items.setInt(1, orderId);
            try (ResultSet rs = items.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    int skuId = rs.getInt("sku_id");
                    int quantity = Math.toIntExact(rs.getLong("qty"));
                    if (quantity <= 0) throw new SQLException("Invalid order item quantity.");
                    update.setInt(1, quantity);
                    update.setInt(2, skuId);
                    update.setInt(3, quantity);
                    if (update.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("SKU " + skuId
                                + (reserve ? " đã ngừng bán hoặc không đủ hàng khả dụng."
                                        : " không đủ hàng giữ chỗ."));
                    }
                    count++;
                }
            }
        }
        if (count == 0) throw new SQLException("Không có SKU trong đơn hàng.");
    }

    public boolean usesReservations(Connection connection) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT COL_LENGTH('dbo.PRODUCT_SKU', 'reserved_quantity')";
        try (PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(sql);
                ResultSet row = statement.executeQuery()) {
            row.next();
            return row.getObject(1) != null;
        }
    }

    private void adjust(Connection connection, int orderId, boolean deduct) throws SQLException {
        List<long[]> items = new ArrayList<>();
        String itemsSql = "SELECT sku_id, SUM(CAST(quantity AS bigint)) AS quantity "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM WHERE order_id = ? GROUP BY sku_id ORDER BY sku_id";
        try (PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(itemsSql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, orderId);
            try (ResultSet result = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (result.next()) {
                    long quantity = result.getLong("quantity");
                    if (quantity <= 0) {
                        throw new SQLException("Số lượng sản phẩm trong đơn không hợp lệ.");
                    }
                    items.add(new long[]{result.getInt("sku_id"), quantity});
                }
            }
        }
        if (items.isEmpty()) {
            throw new SQLException("Đơn hàng không có sản phẩm.");
        }
        boolean consumeReservation = deduct && usesReservations(connection);
        String updateSql;
        if (consumeReservation) {
            updateSql = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - ?, "
                    + "reserved_quantity = reserved_quantity - ? "
                    + "WHERE sku_id = ? AND reserved_quantity >= ? AND stock_quantity >= ? AND is_active = 1 "
                    + "AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PRODUCT p WITH (HOLDLOCK) "
                    + "WHERE p.product_id=PRODUCT_SKU.product_id AND p.is_active=1)";
        } else if (deduct) {
            updateSql = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - ? "
                    + "WHERE sku_id = ? AND stock_quantity >= ? AND is_active = 1 "
                    + "AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PRODUCT p WITH (HOLDLOCK) "
                    + "WHERE p.product_id=PRODUCT_SKU.product_id AND p.is_active=1)";
        } else {
            updateSql = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + ? WHERE sku_id = ?";
        }
        try (PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(updateSql)) {
            for (long[] item : items) {
                int skuId = Math.toIntExact(item[0]);
                statement.setLong(1, item[1]);
                if (consumeReservation) {
                    statement.setLong(2, item[1]);
                    statement.setInt(3, skuId);
                    statement.setLong(4, item[1]);
                    statement.setLong(5, item[1]);
                } else {
                    statement.setInt(2, skuId);
                    if (deduct) {
                        statement.setLong(3, item[1]);
                    }
                }
                if (statement.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                    if (deduct) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Không thể xác nhận đơn. "
                                + "Vui lòng kiểm tra tồn kho và trạng thái bán của SKU #" + skuId + ".");
                    }
                    throw new SQLException("Không hoàn được tồn kho SKU " + item[0] + ".");
                }

                int qty = Math.toIntExact(item[1]);

                InventoryMovementHelper.recordAfterDelta(
                        connection,
                        skuId,
                        deduct ? -qty : qty,
                        deduct ? "OUT" : "IN",
                        (deduct
                                ? "Xac nhan don hang #"
                                : "Hoan kho don hang #") + orderId,
                        null
                );
            }
        }
    }
}

package dao;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;

public class OrderPolicyDAO {

    public void lockCustomer(Connection connection, int userId)
            throws SQLException {

        try (PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(
                "SELECT user_id FROM dbo.[USER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE user_id = ?")) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy khách hàng."
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public void requireAllowed(Connection connection, int userId)
            throws SQLException {

        String message = restriction(connection, userId);

        if (message != null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(message);
        }
    }

    public String restriction(Connection connection, int userId)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql =
                "SELECT violation_count, blocked_until "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "AND (violation_count >= 3 "
                + "OR blocked_until > SYSUTCDATETIME())";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (!rs.next()) {
                    return null;
                }

                if (rs.getInt("violation_count") >= 3) {
                    return "Bạn đã bị khóa đặt hàng vĩnh viễn "
                            + "do vi phạm chính sách hủy đơn lần thứ 3.";
                }

                Timestamp until = rs.getTimestamp("blocked_until");

                String local = until.toLocalDateTime()
                        .atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC)
                        .atZoneSameInstant(
                                ZoneId.of("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")
                        )
                        .format(
                                DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(
                                        "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm"
                                )
                        );

                return "Bạn đang bị khóa đặt hàng đến " + local
                        + " (giờ Việt Nam) do hủy hơn 5 sản phẩm trong 7 ngày.";
            }
        }
    }

    public void recordCancellation(
            Connection connection,
            int userId,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        // 1. Mark this order as cancelled by the customer.
        // Only the first call is allowed to register the cancellation.
        String markCancellationSql =
                "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "SET cancellation_source = 'CUSTOMER', "
                + "cancelled_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ? "
                + "AND order_status = 'CANCELLED' "
                + "AND cancellation_source IS NULL "
                + "AND cancelled_at IS NULL";

        int affectedRows;

        try (PreparedStatement ps =
                connection.prepareStatement(markCancellationSql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            affectedRows = ps.executeUpdate();
        }

        // Already recorded or invalid order.
        if (affectedRows == 0) {
            return;
        }

        // 2. Create customer policy record if it does not exist.
        String createPolicySql =
                "IF NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY "
                + "WHERE user_id = ?"
                + ") "
                + "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY (user_id) "
                + "VALUES (?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps =
                connection.prepareStatement(createPolicySql)) {
