            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            ps.executeUpdate();
        }

        // 3. Calculate cancelled product quantity directly
        // from ORDER and ORDER_ITEM within the last 7 days.
        String updatePolicySql =
                "UPDATE p "
                + "SET violation_count = violation_count + 1, "
                + "blocked_until = CASE violation_count "
                + "WHEN 0 THEN DATEADD(DAY, 3, SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "WHEN 1 THEN DATEADD(DAY, 7, SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "ELSE NULL END "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY p "
                + "WHERE p.user_id = ? "
                + "AND p.violation_count < 3 "
                + "AND (p.blocked_until IS NULL "
                + "OR p.blocked_until <= SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "AND ("
                + "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(i.quantity AS BIGINT)), 0) "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "JOIN dbo.ORDER_ITEM i "
                + "ON i.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "WHERE o.user_id = p.user_id "
                + "AND o.cancellation_source = 'CUSTOMER' "
                + "AND o.cancelled_at > DATEADD(DAY, -7, SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "AND (p.blocked_until IS NULL "
                + "OR o.cancelled_at >= p.blocked_until)"
                + ") > 5";

        try (PreparedStatement ps =
                connection.prepareStatement(updatePolicySql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import model.OrderWorkflowState;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.Locale;

public final class OrderWorkflowDAO {

    public static final class OrderNotFoundException extends IllegalArgumentException {
        private OrderNotFoundException() {
            super("Không tìm thấy đơn hàng.");
        }
    }

    public OrderWorkflowState lockOrder(Connection connection, int orderId, Integer customerId) throws SQLException {
        String ownerSql = "SELECT user_id FROM dbo.[ORDER] WHERE order_id = ?"
                + (customerId == null ? "" : " AND user_id = ?");
        int ownerId;
        try (PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(ownerSql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, orderId);
            if (customerId != null) {
                statement.setInt(2, customerId);
            }
            try (ResultSet row = statement.executeQuery()) {
                if (!row.next()) {
                    throw new OrderNotFoundException();
                }
                ownerId = row.getInt("user_id");
            }
        }

        // Giữ cùng thứ tự khóa với checkout và thanh toán: khóa khách trước, khóa đơn sau.
        new OrderPolicyDAO().lockCustomer(connection, ownerId);
        String orderSql = "SELECT order_status, payment_status, payment_method, total_amount, "
                + "cancel_request_status, CONVERT(VARCHAR(33), cancel_requested_at, 126) AS cancel_request_version, "
                + "stock_restored_at "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE order_id = ? AND user_id = ?";
        try (PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(orderSql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, orderId);
            statement.setInt(2, ownerId);
            try (ResultSet row = statement.executeQuery()) {
                if (!row.next()) {
                    throw new OrderNotFoundException();
                }
                return new OrderWorkflowState(orderId, ownerId,
                        normalize(row.getString("order_status")),
                        normalize(row.getString("payment_status")),
                        normalize(row.getString("payment_method")),
                        row.getBigDecimal("total_amount"),
                        normalize(row.getString("cancel_request_status")),
                        row.getString("cancel_request_version"),
                        row.getTimestamp("stock_restored_at") != null);
            }
        }
    }

    public void requireStaff(Connection connection, int staffId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT u.user_id FROM dbo.[USER] u "
                + "JOIN dbo.ROLES r ON r.role_id = u.role_id "
                + "WHERE u.user_id = ? AND u.is_active = 1 AND r.role_name IN ('Admin', 'Staff')";
        try (PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, staffId);
            try (ResultSet row = statement.executeQuery()) {
                if (!row.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bạn không có quyền xử lý đơn hàng.");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public void addHistory(Connection connection, OrderWorkflowState order, String status, String actorType,
            int actorId, String reason) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY "
                + "(order_id, old_status, status, actor_type, changed_by, reason) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
        executeUpdate(connection, sql, order.getOrderId(), order.getOrderStatus(), status, actorType, actorId, reason);
    }

    public void requestCancellation(Connection connection, OrderWorkflowState order, String reason) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] SET cancel_request_status = 'PENDING', cancel_request_reason = ?, "
                + "cancel_requested_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), cancel_reviewed_by = NULL, "
                + "cancel_reviewed_at = NULL, cancel_review_note = NULL "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND user_id = ? AND order_status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PACKING') "
                + "AND COALESCE(cancel_request_status, '') <> 'PENDING'";
        requireOne(executeUpdate(connection, sql, reason, order.getOrderId(), order.getCustomerId()));
    }

    public void reviewCancellation(Connection connection, OrderWorkflowState order, int staffId, boolean approved,
            String note) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] SET cancel_request_status = ?, cancel_reviewed_by = ?, "
                + "cancel_reviewed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), cancel_review_note = ? "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND order_status = ? AND cancel_request_status = 'PENDING'";
        String reviewStatus = approved ? "APPROVED" : "REJECTED";
        requireOne(executeUpdate(connection, sql, reviewStatus, staffId, note, order.getOrderId(), order.getOrderStatus()));
    }

    public void cancel(Connection connection, OrderWorkflowState order, boolean customerSource, boolean deducted) throws SQLException {
        // OrderPolicyDAO đánh dấu đơn do khách hủy và cập nhật chính sách trong cùng transaction.
        String orderSql = "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] SET order_status = 'CANCELLED', cancellation_source = ?, "
                + "cancelled_at = CASE WHEN ? = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SYSUTCDATETIME() END, "
                + "stock_restored_at = CASE WHEN ? = 1 THEN SYSDATETIME() ELSE stock_restored_at END, "
                + "payment_expires_at = NULL WHERE order_id = ? AND order_status = ?";
        requireOne(executeUpdate(connection, orderSql, customerSource ? null : "STAFF",
                customerSource ? 1 : 0, deducted ? 1 : 0, order.getOrderId(), order.getOrderStatus()));

        String paymentSql = "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION SET status = 'CANCELLED' "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'";
        executeUpdate(connection, paymentSql, order.getOrderId());
    }

    public void advance(Connection connection, OrderWorkflowState order, String nextStatus) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] SET order_status = ?, "
                + "payment_status = CASE WHEN ? = 'COMPLETED' AND payment_method = 'COD' "
                + "THEN 'PAID' ELSE payment_status END, "
                + "delivered_at = CASE WHEN ? = 'COMPLETED' THEN COALESCE(delivered_at, SYSDATETIME()) "
                + "ELSE delivered_at END "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND order_status = ? AND COALESCE(cancel_request_status, '') <> 'PENDING'";
        requireOne(executeUpdate(connection, sql, nextStatus, nextStatus, nextStatus, order.getOrderId(), order.getOrderStatus()));
    }

    private static void requireOne(int changed) throws SQLException {
        if (changed != 1) {
            throw new SQLException("Trạng thái đơn đã thay đổi, vui lòng tải lại đơn hàng.");
        }
    }

    private static String normalize(String value) {
        return value == null ? null : value.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private static int executeUpdate(Connection connection, String sql, Object... values) throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
                statement.setObject(i + 1, values[i]);
            }
            return statement.executeUpdate();
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import model.PasswordResetToken;

public class PasswordResetDAO {

   
    public boolean resetPasswordAtomically(String tokenHash, String newPassword,
            UserDAO users) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection conn = new DBContext().getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) throw new SQLException("Không kết nối được database.");
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                Integer userId = null;
                int resetId = 0;
                String select = "SELECT reset_id,user_id FROM dbo.PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE token_hash=? "
                        + "AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at>GETDATE()";
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(select)) {
                    ps.setString(1, tokenHash);
                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (rs.next()) {
                            resetId = rs.getInt("reset_id");
                            userId = rs.getInt("user_id");
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (userId == null) {
                    conn.rollback();
                    return false;
                }
              
                if (!users.resetPassword(conn, userId, newPassword)) {
                    conn.rollback();
                    return false;
                }
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                        "UPDATE dbo.PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN SET used_at=GETDATE() "
                        + "WHERE reset_id=? AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at>GETDATE()")) {
                    ps.setInt(1, resetId);
                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                        "UPDATE dbo.PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN SET used_at=GETDATE() "
                        + "WHERE user_id=? AND used_at IS NULL")) {
                    ps.setInt(1, userId);
                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }
                conn.commit();
                return true;
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {
                try { conn.rollback(); } catch (SQLException e) { ex.addSuppressed(e); }
                throw ex;
            }
        }
    }


    public boolean createToken(PasswordResetToken token) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                + "(user_id, token_hash, expires_at) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection connection = new DBContext().getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, token.getUserId());
            ps.setString(2, token.getTokenHash());
            ps.setTimestamp(3, token.getExpiresAt());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        }
    }

   
    public PasswordResetToken findValidToken(String tokenHash)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql = "SELECT reset_id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, used_at, created_at "
                + "FROM PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                + "WHERE token_hash = ? "
                + "AND used_at IS NULL "
                + "AND expires_at > GETDATE()";

        try (Connection connection = new DBContext().getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, tokenHash);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    PasswordResetToken token = new PasswordResetToken();

                    token.setResetId(rs.getInt("reset_id"));
                    token.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
                    token.setTokenHash(rs.getString("token_hash"));
                    token.setExpiresAt(rs.getTimestamp("expires_at"));
                    token.setUsedAt(rs.getTimestamp("used_at"));
                    token.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                    return token;
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    
    public boolean markAsUsed(int resetId) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "UPDATE PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                + "SET used_at = GETDATE() "
                + "WHERE reset_id = ? "
                + "AND used_at IS NULL";

        try (Connection connection = new DBContext().getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, resetId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        }
    }

   
    public void invalidateOldTokens(int userId) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "UPDATE PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                + "SET used_at = GETDATE() "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "AND used_at IS NULL";

        try (Connection connection = new DBContext().getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }
}package dao;

import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import db.DBContext;
import payment.PaymentGateway;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

public class PaymentDAO {

    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public PaymentDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public PaymentDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    private Connection open() throws SQLException {
        Connection connection = connections.open();

        if (connection == null) {
            throw new SQLException(
                    "Không kết nối được database."
            );
        }

        return connection;
    }

    public static final class Attempt {

        public final String ref;
        public final String method;
        public final String url;
        public final BigDecimal amount;
        public final long seconds;

        public Attempt(
                String ref,
                String method,
                String url,
                BigDecimal amount,
                long seconds
        ) {
            this.ref = ref;
            this.method = method;
            this.url = url;
            this.amount = amount;
            this.seconds = seconds;
        }
    }

    private static final class LockedOrder {

        int id;
        int owner;
        String status;
        String method;
        String payment;
        BigDecimal amount;
        long seconds;
        boolean restored;
    }

    private LockedOrder lock(
            Connection connection,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT *, "
                + "DATEDIFF_BIG(SECOND, SYSUTCDATETIME(), "
                + "payment_expires_at) AS seconds_left "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                LockedOrder order = new LockedOrder();

                order.id = orderId;
                order.owner = rs.getInt("user_id");
                order.status = rs.getString("order_status");
                order.method = rs.getString("payment_method");
                order.payment = rs.getString("payment_status");
                order.amount = rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount");
                order.seconds = rs.getLong("seconds_left");
                order.restored
                        = rs.getTimestamp("stock_restored_at") != null;

                return order;
            }
        }
    }

    private static int update(
            Connection connection,
            String sql,
            Object... values
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
                ps.setObject(i + 1, values[i]);
            }

            return ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    private void history(
            Connection connection,
            int orderId,
            String status
    ) throws SQLException {
        if ("CANCELLED".equals(status)) {
            throw new SQLException("Cancellation history requires actor and reason.");
        }
        update(connection,
                "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY (order_id, status) VALUES (?, ?)",
                orderId, status);
    }

    private void cancellationHistory(Connection connection, LockedOrder order,
            boolean customerInitiated) throws SQLException {
        update(connection,
                "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY "
                + "(order_id,status,old_status,actor_type,changed_by,reason) "
                + "VALUES (?,'CANCELLED',?,?,?,?)",
                order.id, order.status, customerInitiated ? "CUSTOMER" : "SYSTEM",
                customerInitiated ? order.owner : null,
                customerInitiated ? "Khách hàng hủy đơn chờ thanh toán"
                        : "Hết hạn thanh toán online");
    }

    private static void rollback(
            Connection connection,
            Exception original
    ) {
        try {
            connection.rollback();
        } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
            original.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
        }
    }

    private boolean expire(
            Connection connection,
            LockedOrder order
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                || order.seconds > 0
                || "PAID".equals(order.payment)) {
            return false;
        }

        cancel(connection, order, false);
        return true;
    }

    private void cancel(
            Connection connection,
            LockedOrder order,
            boolean customerInitiated
    ) throws SQLException {

        // Release stock held at checkout before cancelling a pending-payment order.
        new OrderInventoryDAO().releaseReservation(connection, order.id);
        // Customer cancellation is recorded by OrderPolicyDAO afterward.
        update(
                connection,
                "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] SET "
                + "order_status = 'CANCELLED', "
                + "cancellation_source = CASE "
                + "WHEN ? = 1 THEN NULL ELSE 'SYSTEM' END, "
                + "cancelled_at = CASE "
                + "WHEN ? = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SYSUTCDATETIME() END, "
                + "payment_status = 'UNPAID', "
                + "payment_expires_at = NULL "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                customerInitiated ? 1 : 0,
                customerInitiated ? 1 : 0,
                order.id
        );

        update(
                connection,
                "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                + "SET status = ? "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'",
                customerInitiated ? "CANCELLED" : "EXPIRED",
                order.id
        );

        cancellationHistory(connection, order, customerInitiated);

        order.status = "CANCELLED";
    }

    public Attempt begin(
            int userId,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                if (order.owner != userId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                if (expire(connection, order)) {
                    connection.commit();

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Đơn đã hết 15 phút thanh toán "
                            + "và được hủy."
                    );
                }

                if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                        || "PAID".equals(order.payment)
                        || order.restored) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Đơn không còn chờ thanh toán."
                    );
                }

                PaymentGateway.requireConfigured(order.method);
                BigDecimal payable = PaymentGateway.roundVnd(order.amount);
                if (payable.signum() <= 0) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Số tiền không hợp lệ để thanh toán online. Vui lòng đổi sang COD.");
                }

                String sql
                        = "SELECT TOP 1 transaction_code, pay_url, "
                        + "DATEDIFF(SECOND, created_at, "
                        + "SYSDATETIME()) AS age "
                        + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                        + "AND payment_method = ? "
                        + "AND status = 'PENDING' AND amount = ? "
                        + "ORDER BY transaction_id DESC";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setString(2, order.method);
                    ps.setBigDecimal(3, payable);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (rs.next()) {
                            String url = rs.getString("pay_url");

                            if (url != null) {
                                Attempt attempt = new Attempt(
                                        rs.getString("transaction_code"),
                                        order.method,
                                        url,
                                        payable,
                                        order.seconds
                                );

                                connection.commit();
                                return attempt;
                            }

                            if (rs.getInt("age") < 30) {
                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Đang tạo thanh toán. "
                                        + "Chờ vài giây rồi thử lại."
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                update(
                        connection,
                        "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "SET status = 'EXPIRED' "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'",
                        orderId
                );

                String ref = "OECS"
                        + orderId
                        + UUID.randomUUID()
                                .toString()
                                .replace("-", "");

                update(
                        connection,
                        "INSERT INTO dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "(order_id, payment_method, amount, "
                        + "transaction_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        orderId,
                        order.method,
                        payable,
                        ref
                );

                connection.commit();

                return new Attempt(
                        ref,
                        order.method,
                        null,
                        payable,
                        order.seconds
                );

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public void saveUrl(
            String ref,
            String url
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            update(
                    connection,
                    "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                    + "SET pay_url = ? "
                    + "WHERE transaction_code = ? "
                    + "AND status = 'PENDING'",
                    url,
                    ref
            );
        }
    }

    public void changeOrCancel(
            int userId,
            int orderId,
            boolean toCod
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                OrderPolicyDAO policy = new OrderPolicyDAO();
                policy.lockCustomer(connection, userId);
                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                if (order.owner != userId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                if (expire(connection, order)) {
                    connection.commit();
                    return;
                }

                if (toCod
                        && "COD".equals(order.method)
                        && "PENDING_CONFIRMATION".equals(order.status)) {

                    connection.commit();
                    return;
                }

                if (!toCod && "CANCELLED".equals(order.status)) {
                    connection.commit();
                    return;
                }

                if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                        || "PAID".equals(order.payment)
                        || order.restored) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Đơn không còn chờ thanh toán. "
                            + "Hãy tải lại trang."
                    );
                }

                if (toCod) {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                            + "SET payment_method = 'COD', "
                            + "payment_expires_at = NULL, "
                            + "order_status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION', "
                            + "payment_status = 'UNPAID' "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                            orderId
                    );

                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                            + "SET status = 'CANCELLED' "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                            + "AND status = 'PENDING'",
                            orderId
                    );

                    history(
                            connection,
                            orderId,
                            "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                    );

                } else {
                    cancel(connection, order, true);
                    policy.recordCancellation(connection, userId, orderId);
                }

                connection.commit();

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public String settle(
            String method,
            String ref,
            BigDecimal amount,
            String providerId,
            String code,
            boolean success
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                int orderId;

                String sql
                        = "SELECT order_id "
                        + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "WHERE transaction_code = ? "
                        + "AND payment_method = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setString(1, ref);
                    ps.setString(2, method);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            connection.rollback();
                            return "01";
                        }

                        orderId = rs.getInt("order_id");
                    }
                }

                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                long transactionId;
                String transactionStatus;
                BigDecimal expectedAmount;

                sql
                        = "SELECT transaction_id, status, amount "
                        + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE transaction_code = ? "
                        + "AND payment_method = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setString(1, ref);
                    ps.setString(2, method);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không tìm thấy giao dịch."
                            );
                        }

                        transactionId = rs.getLong("transaction_id");
                        transactionStatus = rs.getString("status");
                        expectedAmount = rs.getBigDecimal("amount");
                    }
                }

                if (expectedAmount.compareTo(amount) != 0
                        || PaymentGateway.roundVnd(order.amount).compareTo(amount) != 0) {

                    connection.rollback();
                    return "04";
                }

                if ("SUCCESS".equals(transactionStatus)) {
                    connection.commit();
                    return "02";
                }

                if (success
                        && (providerId == null
                        || providerId.isEmpty()
                        || "0".equals(providerId))) {

                    connection.rollback();
                    return "99";
                }

                expire(connection, order);

                if (!success) {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                            + "SET status = 'FAILED', "
                            + "provider_response_code = ?, "
                            + "completed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                            + "WHERE transaction_id = ? "
                            + "AND status <> 'SUCCESS'",
                            code,
                            transactionId
                    );

                    connection.commit();
                    return "00";
                }

                update(
                        connection,
                        "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "SET status = 'SUCCESS', "
                        + "provider_transaction_id = ?, "
                        + "provider_response_code = ?, "
                        + "completed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                        + "WHERE transaction_id = ?",
                        providerId,
                        code,
                        transactionId
                );

                boolean canConfirm
                        = "PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                        && !"PAID".equals(order.payment)
                        && !order.restored
                        && method.equals(order.method)
                        && order.seconds > 0;

                if (canConfirm) {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                            + "SET payment_status = 'PAID', "
                            + "order_status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION', "
                            + "payment_expires_at = NULL "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                            orderId
                    );

                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                            + "SET status = 'CANCELLED' "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                            + "AND transaction_id <> ? "
                            + "AND status = 'PENDING'",
                            orderId,
                            transactionId
                    );

                    history(
                            connection,
                            orderId,
                            "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                    );

                } else {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "INSERT INTO dbo.AUDIT_LOG "
                            + "(action, entity_type, entity_id, description) "
                            + "VALUES ('PAYMENT_REVIEW', 'ORDER', ?, "
                            + "N'Giao dịch online thành công nhưng đơn không còn "
                            + "ở trạng thái chờ thanh toán. Cần đối soát thủ công.')",
                            orderId
                    );

                    if ("CANCELLED".equals(order.status)
                            || "EXPIRED".equals(order.status)) {

                        update(
                                connection,
                                "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                                + "SET payment_status = 'PAID' "
                                + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                                orderId
                        );
                    }
                }

                connection.commit();
                return "00";

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public void expireOrder(
            int userId,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                if (order.owner != userId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                expire(connection, order);
                connection.commit();

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public void expireBatch() throws SQLException {
        List<int[]> orders = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT TOP 200 order_id, user_id "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE order_status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' "
                + "AND payment_expires_at <= SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                + "ORDER BY order_id";

        try (
                Connection connection = open(); PreparedStatement ps
                = connection.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
            while (rs.next()) {
                orders.add(new int[]{
                    rs.getInt("order_id"),
                    rs.getInt("user_id")
                });
            }
        }

        for (int[] order : orders) {
            expireOrder(order[1], order[0]);
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Attribute;
import model.Brand;
import model.Category;
import model.Product;
import model.ProductImage;
import model.ProductSpec;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.sql.Types;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class ProductDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName());

    private static final String PRODUCT_SELECT
            = "SELECT "
            + "p.product_id, "
            + "p.category_id, "
            + "p.brand_id, "
            + "p.product_name, "
            + "p.description, "
            + "p.image_url, "
            + "p.created_at, "
            + "p.model_code, "
            + "p.is_active AS product_active, "
            + "p.updated_at, "
            + "c.category_name, "
            + "c.parent_id, "
            + "c.description AS category_description, "
            + "c.is_active AS category_active, "
            + "b.brand_name, "
            + "b.logo_url, "
            + "b.is_active AS brand_active, "
            + "(SELECT MIN(s.price) "
            + " FROM PRODUCT_SKU s "
            + " WHERE s.product_id = p.product_id "
            + " AND s.is_active = 1) AS min_price "
            + "FROM PRODUCT p "
            + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c "
            + "ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
            + "INNER JOIN BRAND b "
            + "ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id ";

    private Product mapProduct(ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        Integer parentId = (Integer) rs.getObject("parent_id");

        Category category = new Category(
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getString("category_name"),
                parentId,
                rs.getString("category_description"),
                rs.getBoolean("category_active")
        );

        Brand brand = new Brand(
                rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                rs.getString("brand_name"),
                rs.getString("logo_url"),
                rs.getBoolean("brand_active")
        );

        Product product = new Product(
                rs.getInt("product_id"),
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                rs.getString("product_name"),
                rs.getString("description"),
                rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                rs.getString("image_url"),
                category,
                brand
        );

        product.setModelCode(rs.getString("model_code"));
        product.setActive(rs.getBoolean("product_active"));
        product.setUpdatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("updated_at"));

        double minPrice = rs.getDouble("min_price");

        if (!rs.wasNull()) {
            product.setMinPrice(minPrice);
        }

        return product;
    }

    public List<Product> getList() {

        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = PRODUCT_SELECT
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapProduct(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Loi truy van danh sach san pham!",
                    ex
            );

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Khong the tai danh sach san pham tu database.",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Product> getActiveProducts() {

        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = PRODUCT_SELECT
                + "WHERE p.is_active = 1 "
                + "AND c.is_active = 1 "
                + "AND b.is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapProduct(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Loi truy van danh sach san pham dang ban!",
                    ex
            );

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Khong the tai san pham dang ban tu database.",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Product getById(int id) {

        String sql = PRODUCT_SELECT
                + "WHERE p.product_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapProduct(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy Product theo ID!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    public int insertReturnId(Product product) {

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT "
                + "(product_name, description, "
                + "category_id, brand_id, image_url, "
                + "model_code, is_active) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                sql,
                Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS
        )) {

            ps.setNString(1, product.getProductName());
            ps.setNString(2, product.getDescription());
            ps.setInt(3, product.getCategoryId());
            ps.setInt(4, product.getBrandId());
            ps.setString(5, product.getImageUrl());
            ps.setString(6, product.getModelCode());
            ps.setBoolean(7, product.isActive());

            if (ps.executeUpdate() > 0) {

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {

                    if (rs.next()) {
                        return rs.getInt(1);
                    }
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi thêm Product!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }

    public int update(Product product) {

        String sql
                = "UPDATE PRODUCT SET "
                + "product_name = ?, "
                + "description = ?, "
                + "category_id = ?, "
                + "brand_id = ?, "
                + "image_url = COALESCE(?, image_url), "
                + "model_code = COALESCE(?, model_code), "
                + "updated_at = GETDATE() "
                + "WHERE product_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, product.getProductName());
            ps.setNString(2, product.getDescription());
            ps.setInt(3, product.getCategoryId());
            ps.setInt(4, product.getBrandId());
            ps.setString(5, product.getImageUrl());
            ps.setString(6, product.getModelCode());
            ps.setInt(7, product.getProductId());

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi cập nhật Product!",
                    ex
            );
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int delete(int productId) {

        String sql = "DELETE FROM PRODUCT WHERE product_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi xóa sản phẩm!", ex);

            if (ex.getErrorCode() == 547) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Không thể xóa sản phẩm vì có dữ liệu liên quan."
                );
            }

            return 0;
        }
    }

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, productId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi cập nhật trạng thái Product!",
                    ex
            );

            return 0;
        }
    }

    public List<Product> searchProducts(String keyword) {

        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = PRODUCT_SELECT
                + "WHERE ("
                + "p.product_name LIKE ? "
                + "OR p.model_code LIKE ? "
                + "OR c.category_name LIKE ? "
                + "OR b.brand_name LIKE ?"
                + ") "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        String searchPattern
                = "%" + (keyword == null ? "" : keyword.trim()) + "%";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, searchPattern);
            ps.setNString(2, searchPattern);
            ps.setNString(3, searchPattern);
            ps.setNString(4, searchPattern);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapProduct(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi tìm kiếm Product!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public void insertGalleryImages(
            int productId,
            List<String> imageUrls) {

        if (imageUrls == null || imageUrls.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "(product_id, sku_id, image_url, "
                + "is_primary, display_order) "
                + "SELECT ?, NULL, ?, 0, ? "
                + "WHERE NOT EXISTS ("
                + "SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id IS NULL "
                + "AND image_url = ?"
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            int order = 0;

            for (String url : imageUrls) {

                if (url == null || url.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    continue;
                }

                String cleanUrl = url.trim();

                ps.setInt(1, productId);
                ps.setString(2, cleanUrl);
                ps.setInt(3, order++);
                ps.setInt(4, productId);
                ps.setString(5, cleanUrl);

                ps.addBatch();
            }

            ps.executeBatch();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lưu ảnh Gallery!",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    public List<ProductImage> getProductImages(int productId) {

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

    }

    public void saveProductSpecs(
            int productId,
            String[] attributeIds,
            String[] specValues) {

        Map<Integer, String> uniqueSpecs
                = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        if (attributeIds != null && specValues != null) {

            int len = Math.min(
                    attributeIds.length,
                    specValues.length
            );

            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {

                String attributeId = attributeIds[i];
                String value = specValues[i];

                if (attributeId == null
                        || attributeId.trim().isEmpty()
                        || value == null
                        || value.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    continue;
                }

                try {
                    int id = Integer.parseInt(
                            attributeId.trim()
                    );

                    if (id > 0) {
                        uniqueSpecs.put(id, value.trim());
                    }

                } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
                    LOGGER.log(
                            Level.WARNING,
                            "Attribute ID không hợp lệ: "
                            + attributeId,
                            ex
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        String sqlDelete
                = "DELETE FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION "
                + "WHERE product_id = ?";

        String sqlInsert
                = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION "
                + "(product_id, attribute_id, value) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection()) {

            boolean originalAutoCommit
                    = conn.getAutoCommit();

            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                try (PreparedStatement psDel
                        = conn.prepareStatement(sqlDelete)) {

                    psDel.setInt(1, productId);
                    psDel.executeUpdate();
                }

                if (!uniqueSpecs.isEmpty()) {

                    try (PreparedStatement psIns
                            = conn.prepareStatement(sqlInsert)) {

                        for (Map.Entry<Integer, String> entry
                                : uniqueSpecs.entrySet()) {

                            psIns.setInt(1, productId);
                            psIns.setInt(2, entry.getKey());
                            psIns.setNString(3, entry.getValue());

                            psIns.addBatch();
                        }

                        psIns.executeBatch();
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();

            } catch (SQLException ex) {

                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackEx) {
                    ex.addSuppressed(rollbackEx);
                }

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Lỗi lưu thông số kỹ thuật!",
                        ex
                );

            } finally {
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(originalAutoCommit);
                } catch (SQLException ex) {
                    LOGGER.log(
                            Level.WARNING,
                            "Không khôi phục được autoCommit!",
                            ex
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi kết nối khi lưu thông số!",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    public List<ProductSpec> getProductSpecsForAdmin(
            int productId) {

        List<ProductSpec> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "ps.product_id, "
                + "ps.attribute_id, "
                + "ps.value, "
                + "ps.numeric_value, "
                + "ps.boolean_value, "
                + "a.attribute_name, "
                + "a.unit, "
                + "ca.group_name, "
                + "ca.display_order "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps "
                + "INNER JOIN PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = ps.product_id "
                + "INNER JOIN ATTRIBUTE a "
                + "ON a.attribute_id = ps.attribute_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE ca "
                + "ON ca.category_id = p.category_id "
                + "AND ca.attribute_id = ps.attribute_id "
                + "WHERE ps.product_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY ca.display_order, "
                + "ps.attribute_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    ProductSpec spec = new ProductSpec();

                    spec.setProductId(
                            rs.getInt("product_id")
                    );

                    spec.setAttributeId(
                            rs.getInt("attribute_id")
                    );

                    spec.setAttributeName(
                            rs.getString("attribute_name")
                    );

                    spec.setValue(
                            rs.getString("value")
                    );

                    spec.setNumericValue(
                            rs.getBigDecimal("numeric_value")
                    );

                    Object booleanObject
                            = rs.getObject("boolean_value");

                    spec.setBooleanValue(
                            booleanObject == null
                                    ? null
                                    : rs.getBoolean("boolean_value")
                    );

                    spec.setGroupName(
                            rs.getString("group_name")
                    );

                    spec.setUnit(
                            rs.getString("unit")
                    );

                    spec.setDisplayOrder(
                            rs.getInt("display_order")
                    );

                    list.add(spec);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy thông số Product!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.ProductReview;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

public class ProductReviewDAO {

    public static final int SAVE_FAILED = -1;
    public static final int ALREADY_REVIEWED = -2;
    public static final int RATE_LIMIT_REACHED = -3;
    public static final int NOT_ELIGIBLE = -4;

    // Mỗi thao tác mở một kết nối riêng.
    private Connection getConnection() throws SQLException {
        Connection conn = new DBContext().getConnection();

        if (conn == null) {
            throw new SQLException("Cannot connect to OECS database");
        }

        return conn;
    }

    public int getSkuIdByOrderItemId(int orderItemId) {
        String sql = "SELECT sku_id FROM ORDER_ITEM "
                + "WHERE order_item_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("sku_id");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return -1;
    }

    public boolean canReview(int userId, int orderItemId, int skuId) {
        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "WHERE oi.order_item_id = ? "
                + "AND oi.sku_id = ? "
                + "AND o.user_id = ? "
                + "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.order_status))) "
                + "IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELIVERED') "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ( "
                + "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "WHERE pr.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id "
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);
            ps.setInt(3, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            java.util.logging.Logger
                    .getLogger(ProductReviewDAO.class.getName())
                    .log(
                            java.util.logging.Level.SEVERE,
                            "Lỗi kiểm tra quyền đánh giá", e);
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean alreadyReviewed(int orderItemId) {
        String sql = "SELECT review_id FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE order_item_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    public int insertReview(ProductReview review) {

        if (review == null
                || review.getUserId() <= 0
                || review.getOrderItemId() <= 0
                || review.getSkuId() <= 0
                || review.getRating() < 1
                || review.getRating() > 5
                || (review.getComment() != null
                && review.getComment().length() > 2000)) {
            return NOT_ELIGIBLE;
        }

        String lockUserSql
                = "SELECT user_id FROM dbo.[USER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE user_id = ?";

        String eligibleSql
                = "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id "
                + "WHERE oi.order_item_id = ? "
                + "AND oi.sku_id = ? "
                + "AND o.user_id = ? "
                + "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.order_status))) "
                + "IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELIVERED')";

        String existingSql
                = "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE order_item_id = ?";

        String countSql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "AND created_at >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, GETDATE())";

        String insertSql
                = "INSERT INTO dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "(user_id, order_item_id, sku_id, rating, comment, created_at) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, GETDATE())";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(lockUserSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getUserId());

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return NOT_ELIGIBLE;
                        }
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(eligibleSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getOrderItemId());
                    ps.setInt(2, review.getSkuId());
                    ps.setInt(3, review.getUserId());

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return NOT_ELIGIBLE;
                        }
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(existingSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getOrderItemId());

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return ALREADY_REVIEWED;
                        }
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(countSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getUserId());

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        rs.next();

                        if (rs.getInt(1) >= 10) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return RATE_LIMIT_REACHED;
                        }
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(
                                insertSql,
                                Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getUserId());
                    ps.setInt(2, review.getOrderItemId());
                    ps.setInt(3, review.getSkuId());
                    ps.setInt(4, review.getRating());
                    ps.setString(5, review.getComment());

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return SAVE_FAILED;
                    }

                    try (ResultSet keys = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                        if (!keys.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return SAVE_FAILED;
                        }

                        int reviewId = keys.getInt(1);
                        conn.commit();
                        return reviewId;
                    }
                }

            } catch (SQLException e) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
                }

                throw e;
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            java.util.logging.Logger
                    .getLogger(ProductReviewDAO.class.getName())
                    .log(
                            java.util.logging.Level.SEVERE,
                            "Atomic review insert failed", e);

            return SAVE_FAILED;
        }
    }

            ps.setInt(4, review.getUserId());

            e.printStackTrace();

        return false;
    }

    public boolean updateReviewWithImages(
            ProductReview review,
            List<String> removeImages,
            List<String> newImages) throws SQLException {

        if (review == null
                || review.getRating() < 1
                || review.getRating() > 5
                || (review.getComment() != null
                && review.getComment().length() > 2000)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Dữ liệu đánh giá không hợp lệ.");
        }

        List<String> toRemove = removeImages == null
                ? new ArrayList<>() : removeImages;

        List<String> toAdd = newImages == null
                ? new ArrayList<>() : newImages;

        String lockSql
                = "SELECT review_id "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE review_id = ? AND user_id = ?";

        String imageSql
                = "SELECT image_url "
                + "FROM dbo.REVIEW_IMAGES WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE review_id = ?";

        String updateSql
                = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "SET rating = ?, comment = ? "
                + "WHERE review_id = ? AND user_id = ?";

        String removeSql
                = "DELETE FROM dbo.REVIEW_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE review_id = ? AND image_url = ?";

        String addSql
                = "INSERT INTO dbo.REVIEW_IMAGES "
                + "(review_id, image_url) VALUES (?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(lockSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getReviewId());
                    ps.setInt(2, review.getUserId());

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                }

                Set<String> currentImages = new HashSet<>();

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(imageSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getReviewId());

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        while (rs.next()) {
                            currentImages.add(
                                    rs.getString("image_url"));
                        }
                    }
                }

                Set<String> removalSet = new HashSet<>(toRemove);

                if (removalSet.size() != toRemove.size()
                        || !currentImages.containsAll(removalSet)) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ảnh cần xóa không hợp lệ.");
                }

                int finalCount
                        = currentImages.size()
                        - removalSet.size()
                        + toAdd.size();

                if (finalCount > 3) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Mỗi đánh giá chỉ có tối đa 3 ảnh.");
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(updateSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, review.getRating());
                    ps.setString(2, review.getComment());
                    ps.setInt(3, review.getReviewId());
                    ps.setInt(4, review.getUserId());

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(removeSql)) {

                    for (String url : removalSet) {
                        ps.setInt(1, review.getReviewId());
                        ps.setString(2, url);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không thể xóa ảnh đánh giá.");
                        }
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(addSql)) {

                    for (String url : toAdd) {
                        ps.setInt(1, review.getReviewId());
                        ps.setString(2, url);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không thể thêm ảnh đánh giá.");
                        }
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
                }

                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean deleteReview(int reviewId, int userId) {
        String lockSql
                = "SELECT review_id "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE review_id = ? AND user_id = ?";

        String deleteImagesSql
                = "DELETE FROM dbo.REVIEW_IMAGES WHERE review_id = ?";

        String deleteReviewSql
                = "DELETE FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE review_id = ? AND user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(lockSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(deleteImagesSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                int deleted;

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(deleteReviewSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);

                    deleted = ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                if (deleted != 1) {
                    conn.rollback();
                    return false;
                }

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                conn.rollback();
                throw e;
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            java.util.logging.Logger
                    .getLogger(ProductReviewDAO.class.getName())
                    .log(
                            java.util.logging.Level.SEVERE,
                            "Không thể xóa đánh giá", e);

            return false;
        }
    }

    public List<ProductReview> getReviewsBySkuId(int skuId) {
        List<ProductReview> reviews = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT review_id, user_id, order_item_id, sku_id, "
                + "rating, comment, created_at "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ? AND is_hidden = 0 "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    ProductReview review = mapReview(rs);
                    review.setImages(
                            getReviewImages(review.getReviewId()));
                    reviews.add(review);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return reviews;
    }

    public List<ProductReview> getReviewsByProductId(int productId) {
        List<ProductReview> reviews = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT pr.review_id, pr.user_id, "
                + "pr.order_item_id, pr.sku_id, "
                + "pr.rating, pr.comment, pr.created_at "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ps ON pr.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "WHERE ps.product_id = ? "
                + "AND pr.is_hidden = 0 "
                + "ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC, pr.review_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    reviews.add(mapReview(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Lỗi tải đánh giá cho sản phẩm ID " + productId, e);
        }

        for (ProductReview review : reviews) {
            review.setImages(
                    getReviewImages(review.getReviewId()));
        }

        return reviews;
    }

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getDouble("average_rating");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }
