    public int getPurchaseCountByProductId(int productId) {
        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_item_id) AS purchase_count "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ps ON oi.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "WHERE ps.product_id = ? "
                + "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.order_status))) "
                + "IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELIVERED')";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("purchase_count");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }

    private ProductReview mapReview(ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        ProductReview review = new ProductReview();

        review.setReviewId(rs.getInt("review_id"));
        review.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
        review.setOrderItemId(rs.getInt("order_item_id"));
        review.setSkuId(rs.getInt("sku_id"));
        review.setRating(rs.getInt("rating"));
        review.setComment(rs.getString("comment"));
        review.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

        return review;
    }

    public ProductReview getReviewByOrderItemIdAndUserId(
            int orderItemId, int userId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT pr.review_id, pr.user_id, "
                + "pr.order_item_id, pr.sku_id, "
                + "pr.rating, pr.comment, pr.created_at "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "JOIN dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "ON oi.order_item_id = pr.order_item_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id "
                + "WHERE pr.order_item_id = ? "
                + "AND pr.user_id = ? AND o.user_id = ?";

        ProductReview review = null;

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            ps.setInt(3, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    review = mapReview(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Không thể tải đánh giá sản phẩm", e);
        }

        if (review != null) {
            review.setImages(
                    getReviewImages(review.getReviewId()));
        }

        return review;
    }

    public int countRecentReviews(int userId) {
        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "AND created_at >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, GETDATE())";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("total");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Không thể kiểm tra tần suất đánh giá", e);
        }

        return 0;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.ProductSku;
import model.SkuAttributeValue;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.sql.Types;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class ProductSkuDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(ProductSkuDAO.class.getName());

    private static final String SKU_SELECT
            = "SELECT "
            + "s.sku_id, "
            + "s.product_id, "
            + "s.sku_code, "
            + "s.price, "
            + "s.original_price, "
            + "s.stock_quantity, "
            + "s.created_at, "
            + "s.is_active, "
            + "s.variant_key, "
            + "sav.attribute_id, "
            + "sav.text_value, "
            + "sav.numeric_value, "
            + "sav.boolean_value, "
            + "a.attribute_name, "
            + "a.data_type, "
            + "a.unit "
            + "FROM PRODUCT_SKU s "
            + "LEFT JOIN SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE sav "
            + "ON sav.sku_id = s.sku_id "
            + "LEFT JOIN ATTRIBUTE a "
            + "ON a.attribute_id = sav.attribute_id ";

    private ProductSku mapSku(ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        BigDecimal originalPrice
                = rs.getBigDecimal("original_price");

        return new ProductSku(
                rs.getInt("sku_id"),
                rs.getInt("product_id"),
                rs.getString("sku_code"),
                rs.getDouble("price"),
                rs.getInt("stock_quantity"),
                rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                originalPrice == null
                        ? null
                        : originalPrice.doubleValue(),
                rs.getBoolean("is_active"),
                rs.getBytes("variant_key")
        );
    }

    private SkuAttributeValue mapAttributeValue(
            ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {

        Boolean booleanValue = null;

        Object rawBoolean
                = rs.getObject("boolean_value");

        if (rawBoolean != null) {
            booleanValue
                    = rs.getBoolean("boolean_value");
        }

        return new SkuAttributeValue(
                rs.getInt("sku_id"),
                rs.getInt("attribute_id"),
                rs.getString("text_value"),
                rs.getBigDecimal("numeric_value"),
                booleanValue,
                rs.getString("attribute_name"),
                rs.getString("data_type"),
                rs.getString("unit")
        );
    }

    private List<ProductSku> mapSkuList(ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        Map<Integer, ProductSku> skuMap
                = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        while (rs.next()) {

            int skuId = rs.getInt("sku_id");

            ProductSku sku = skuMap.get(skuId);

            if (sku == null) {
                sku = mapSku(rs);
                skuMap.put(skuId, sku);
            }

            Object attributeId
                    = rs.getObject("attribute_id");

            if (attributeId != null) {
                sku.getAttributeValues().add(
                        mapAttributeValue(rs)
                );
            }
        }

        return new ArrayList<>(skuMap.values());
    }

    public List<ProductSku> getByProductId(int productId) {

        String sql = SKU_SELECT
                + "WHERE s.product_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY s.sku_id DESC, "
                + "sav.attribute_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return mapSkuList(rs);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i láº¥y SKU theo Product ID!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public ProductSku getBySkuId(int skuId) {

        String sql = SKU_SELECT
                + "WHERE s.sku_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY sav.attribute_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                List<ProductSku> list = mapSkuList(rs);

                if (!list.isEmpty()) {
                    return list.get(0);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i láº¥y SKU theo ID!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    public List<ProductSku> getActiveByProductId(
            int productId) {

        String sql = SKU_SELECT
                + "WHERE s.product_id = ? "
                + "AND s.is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY s.sku_id DESC, "
                + "sav.attribute_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return mapSkuList(rs);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i láº¥y SKU Ä‘ang hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public int insert(ProductSku sku) {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "(product_id, sku_code, price, stock_quantity, original_price, is_active) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection()) {
            boolean oldAutoCommit = conn.getAutoCommit();
            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);
                int newSkuId = 0;
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                        sql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {
                    bindSkuInsert(ps, sku);
                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        throw new SQLException("KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ thÃªm SKU.");
                    }
                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                        if (rs.next()) {
                            newSkuId = rs.getInt(1);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (newSkuId <= 0) {
                    throw new SQLException("KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ láº¥y ID cá»§a SKU má»›i.");
                }
                SkuAdminInventoryAudit.recordOpening(
                        conn, newSkuId, sku.getStockQuantity());
                conn.commit();
                sku.setSkuId(newSkuId);
                return 1; 
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {
                rollbackQuietly(conn, ex);
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lá»—i thÃªm SKU!", ex);
                return 0;
            } finally {
                restoreAutoCommit(conn, oldAutoCommit);
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i khi thÃªm SKU!", ex);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int update(ProductSku sku) {
        String sql = "UPDATE PRODUCT_SKU SET sku_code = ?, price = ?, "
                + "stock_quantity = ?, original_price = ?, is_active = ? "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ? AND product_id = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection()) {
            boolean oldAutoCommit = conn.getAutoCommit();
            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);
                int previousStock = SkuAdminInventoryAudit.lockCurrentStock(
                        conn, sku.getProductId(), sku.getSkuId());
                int affected;
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    bindSkuUpdate(ps, sku);
                    affected = ps.executeUpdate();
                }
                if (affected != 1) {
                    throw new SQLException("KhÃ´ng cáº­p nháº­t Ä‘Æ°á»£c SKU.");
                }
                SkuAdminInventoryAudit.recordAdminCorrection(
                        conn, sku.getSkuId(), previousStock, sku.getStockQuantity());
                conn.commit();
                return 1;
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {
                rollbackQuietly(conn, ex);
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lá»—i cáº­p nháº­t SKU!", ex);
                return 0;
            } finally {
                restoreAutoCommit(conn, oldAutoCommit);
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i khi cáº­p nháº­t SKU!", ex);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int delete(int skuId) {

        return setSkuActive(skuId, false);
    }

    public int setSkuActive(int skuId, boolean active) {

        String sql
                = "UPDATE PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "SET is_active = ? "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i cáº­p nháº­t tráº¡ng thÃ¡i SKU!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }

    public boolean checkSkuCodeExists(String skuCode) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "WHERE sku_code = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, skuCode);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i kiá»ƒm tra trÃ¹ng SKU code!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean checkSkuCodeExistsForUpdate(
            String skuCode,
            int excludeSkuId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "WHERE sku_code = ? "
                + "AND sku_id <> ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, skuCode);
            ps.setInt(2, excludeSkuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i kiá»ƒm tra SKU code khi Update!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return false;
    }

    public List<SkuAttributeValue> getAttributeValuesBySkuId(
            int skuId) {

        List<SkuAttributeValue> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "sav.sku_id, "
                + "sav.attribute_id, "
                + "sav.text_value, "
                + "sav.numeric_value, "
                + "sav.boolean_value, "
                + "a.attribute_name, "
                + "a.data_type, "
                + "a.unit "
                + "FROM SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE sav "
                + "JOIN ATTRIBUTE a "
                + "ON a.attribute_id = sav.attribute_id "
                + "WHERE sav.sku_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY sav.attribute_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapAttributeValue(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i láº¥y thuá»™c tÃ­nh SKU!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public int insertWithAttributes(
            ProductSku sku,
            List<SkuAttributeValue> attributeValues) {

        if (sku == null || attributeValues == null) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "(product_id, sku_code, price, "
                + "stock_quantity, original_price, is_active) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection()) {

            boolean oldAutoCommit
                    = conn.getAutoCommit();

            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                int newSkuId = 0;

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(
                                sql,
                                Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS
                        )) {

                            bindSkuInsert(ps, sku);

                            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                                throw new SQLException(
                                        "KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ táº¡o SKU má»›i."
                                );
                            }

                            try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {

                                if (rs.next()) {
                                    newSkuId = rs.getInt(1);
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        if (newSkuId <= 0) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "KhÃ´ng láº¥y Ä‘Æ°á»£c ID cá»§a SKU má»›i."
                            );
                        }

                        replaceSkuAttributes(
                                conn,
                                newSkuId,
                                attributeValues
                        );

                        refreshVariantKey(conn, newSkuId);
                        SkuAdminInventoryAudit.recordOpening(
                                conn, newSkuId, sku.getStockQuantity());

                        conn.commit();

                        sku.setSkuId(newSkuId);

                        return newSkuId;

            } catch (SQLException
                    | IllegalArgumentException ex) {

                rollbackQuietly(conn, ex);

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Lá»—i thÃªm SKU kÃ¨m biáº¿n thá»ƒ!",
                        ex
                );

                return 0;

            } finally {
                restoreAutoCommit(conn, oldAutoCommit);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i khi thÃªm SKU!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }

    public int updateWithAttributes(
            ProductSku sku,
            List<SkuAttributeValue> attributeValues) {

        if (sku == null
                || sku.getSkuId() <= 0
                || attributeValues == null) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE PRODUCT_SKU SET "
                + "sku_code = ?, "
                + "price = ?, "
                + "stock_quantity = ?, "
                + "original_price = ?, "
                + "is_active = ? "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                + "AND product_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection()) {

            boolean oldAutoCommit
                    = conn.getAutoCommit();

            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                int previousStock = SkuAdminInventoryAudit.lockCurrentStock(
                        conn, sku.getProductId(), sku.getSkuId());
                int affectedRows;

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    bindSkuUpdate(ps, sku);

                    affectedRows = ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                if (affectedRows != 1) {
                    conn.rollback();
                    return 0;
                }

                replaceSkuAttributes(
                        conn,
                        sku.getSkuId(),
                        attributeValues
                );

                refreshVariantKey(
                        conn,
                        sku.getSkuId()
                );
                SkuAdminInventoryAudit.recordAdminCorrection(
                        conn, sku.getSkuId(), previousStock, sku.getStockQuantity());

                conn.commit();

                return 1;

            } catch (SQLException
                    | IllegalArgumentException ex) {

                rollbackQuietly(conn, ex);

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Lá»—i cáº­p nháº­t SKU kÃ¨m biáº¿n thá»ƒ!",
                        ex
                );

                return 0;

            } finally {
                restoreAutoCommit(conn, oldAutoCommit);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i khi cáº­p nháº­t SKU!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }

    private void bindSkuInsert(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            ProductSku sku) throws SQLException {

        if (sku == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "SKU khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c null."
            );
        }

        validateSku(sku);

        ps.setInt(1, sku.getProductId());
        ps.setString(2, sku.getSkuCode().trim());
        ps.setDouble(3, sku.getPrice());
        ps.setInt(4, sku.getStockQuantity());

        bindOriginalPrice(ps, 5, sku.getOriginalPrice());

        ps.setBoolean(6, sku.isActive());
    }

    private void bindSkuUpdate(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            ProductSku sku) throws SQLException {

        if (sku == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "SKU khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c null."
            );
        }

        validateSku(sku);

        ps.setString(1, sku.getSkuCode().trim());
        ps.setDouble(2, sku.getPrice());
        ps.setInt(3, sku.getStockQuantity());

        bindOriginalPrice(ps, 4, sku.getOriginalPrice());

        ps.setBoolean(5, sku.isActive());
        ps.setInt(6, sku.getSkuId());
        ps.setInt(7, sku.getProductId());
    }

    private void bindOriginalPrice(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            int parameterIndex,
            Double originalPrice) throws SQLException {

        if (originalPrice == null) {

            ps.setNull(
                    parameterIndex,
                    Types.DECIMAL
            );

        } else {

            ps.setDouble(
                    parameterIndex,
                    originalPrice
            );
        }
    }

    private void validateSku(ProductSku sku) {

        if (sku.getProductId() <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Product ID khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡."
            );
        }

        if (sku.getSkuCode() == null
                || sku.getSkuCode().trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "SKU code khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c trá»‘ng."
            );
        }

        if (sku.getSkuCode().trim().length() > 100) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "SKU code vÆ°á»£t quÃ¡ 100 kÃ½ tá»±."
            );
        }

        if (!Double.isFinite(sku.getPrice())
                || sku.getPrice() < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "GiÃ¡ bÃ¡n khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡."
            );
        }

        if (sku.getOriginalPrice() != null
                && (!Double.isFinite(sku.getOriginalPrice())
                || sku.getOriginalPrice() < 0)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "GiÃ¡ niÃªm yáº¿t khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡."
            );
        }

        if (sku.getStockQuantity() < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng tá»“n kho khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c Ã¢m."
            );
        }
    }

    private void replaceSkuAttributes(
            Connection conn,
            int skuId,
            List<SkuAttributeValue> values)
            throws SQLException {

        validateAttributeValues(values);

        String sqlDelete
                = "DELETE FROM SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sqlDelete)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);
            ps.executeUpdate();
        }

        if (values.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        String sqlInsert
                = "INSERT INTO SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE "
                + "(sku_id, attribute_id, "
                + "text_value, numeric_value, boolean_value) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sqlInsert)) {

            for (SkuAttributeValue value : values) {

                ps.setInt(1, skuId);
                ps.setInt(2, value.getAttributeId());

                if (value.getTextValue() != null) {

                    ps.setNString(
                            3,
                            value.getTextValue().trim()
                    );

                } else {

                    ps.setNull(
                            3,
                            Types.NVARCHAR
                    );
                }

                if (value.getNumericValue() != null) {

                    ps.setBigDecimal(
                            4,
                            value.getNumericValue()
                    );

                } else {

                    ps.setNull(
                            4,
                            Types.DECIMAL
                    );
                }

                if (value.getBooleanValue() != null) {

                    ps.setBoolean(
                            5,
                            value.getBooleanValue()
                    );

                } else {

                    ps.setNull(
                            5,
                            Types.BIT
                    );
                }

                ps.addBatch();
            }

            ps.executeBatch();
        }
    }

    private void validateAttributeValues(
            List<SkuAttributeValue> values) {

        if (values == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Danh sÃ¡ch thuá»™c tÃ­nh khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c null."
            );
        }

        Set<Integer> attributeIds = new HashSet<>();

        for (SkuAttributeValue value : values) {

            if (value == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Thuá»™c tÃ­nh SKU khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c null."
                );
            }

            if (value.getAttributeId() <= 0) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Attribute ID khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡."
                );
            }

            if (!attributeIds.add(
                    value.getAttributeId())) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Má»™t thuá»™c tÃ­nh bá»‹ láº·p trong SKU."
                );
            }

            int count = 0;

            if (value.getTextValue() != null) {

                if (value.getTextValue()
                        .trim().isEmpty()) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "GiÃ¡ trá»‹ TEXT khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c trá»‘ng."
                    );
                }

                if (value.getTextValue().length() > 255) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "GiÃ¡ trá»‹ TEXT vÆ°á»£t quÃ¡ 255 kÃ½ tá»±."
                    );
                }

                count++;
            }

            if (value.getNumericValue() != null) {
                count++;
            }

            if (value.getBooleanValue() != null) {
                count++;
            }

            if (count != 1) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Má»—i thuá»™c tÃ­nh SKU pháº£i cÃ³ "
                        + "Ä‘Ãºng má»™t kiá»ƒu giÃ¡ trá»‹."
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private void refreshVariantKey(
            Connection conn,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {
        SkuVariantKeyHelper.refresh(conn, skuId);
    }

    private void rollbackQuietly(
            Connection conn,
            Exception originalException) {

        try {
            conn.rollback();

        } catch (SQLException rollbackEx) {

            originalException.addSuppressed(
                    rollbackEx
            );

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lá»—i rollback transaction SKU!",
                    rollbackEx
            );
        }
    }

    private void restoreAutoCommit(
            Connection conn,
            boolean oldAutoCommit) {

        try {
            conn.setAutoCommit(oldAutoCommit);

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "KhÃ´ng khÃ´i phá»¥c Ä‘Æ°á»£c autoCommit!",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.SalesReport;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.Date;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.time.LocalDate;

public class ReportDAO extends DBContext {

    // Điều kiện ghi nhận doanh thu và sản phẩm bán thành công.
    private static final String SOLD_ORDER =
            "o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' ";

    // 1. Tổng hợp dữ liệu báo cáo trong cùng một transaction.
    public SalesReport loadFullReport(LocalDate start, LocalDate end) {
        LocalDate endExclusive = end.plusDays(1);
        SalesReport report = new SalesReport();

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException("Không kết nối được SQL Server.");
            }
            conn.setTransactionIsolation(Connection.TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE);
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                loadOrderStatistics(conn, start, endExclusive, report);
                loadRevenueByDate(conn, start, endExclusive, report);
                loadProductStatistics(conn, start, endExclusive, report);
                loadInventory(conn, report);
                loadPayments(conn, start, endExclusive, report);
                conn.commit();
                return report;
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollback) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollback);
                }
                throw e;
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Không thể tải báo cáo.", e);
        }
    }

    // 2. Đếm đơn theo trạng thái, không phụ thuộc thanh toán.
    private void loadOrderStatistics(Connection conn, LocalDate start,
            LocalDate endExclusive, SalesReport report) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT o.order_status, COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "GROUP BY o.order_status "
                + "ORDER BY total DESC, o.order_status";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            setDateRange(ps, start, endExclusive);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    String status = rs.getString("order_status");
                    int total = rs.getInt("total");
                    report.addStatus(new Object[]{status, total});
                    report.setTotalOrders(report.getTotalOrders() + total);
                    if ("COMPLETED".equals(status)) {
                        report.setCompletedOrders(total);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // 3. Doanh thu theo ngày tạo đơn: COMPLETED và PAID.
    private void loadRevenueByDate(Connection conn, LocalDate start,
            LocalDate endExclusive, SalesReport report) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) AS sale_date, "
                + "SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND " + SOLD_ORDER
                + "GROUP BY CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) "
                + "ORDER BY sale_date";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            setDateRange(ps, start, endExclusive);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    BigDecimal revenue = rs.getBigDecimal("revenue");
                    int count = rs.getInt("order_count");
                    report.addRevenueRow(new Object[]{
                        rs.getDate("sale_date"), revenue, count
                    });
                    report.setRevenue(report.getRevenue().add(revenue));
                    report.setRevenueOrders(report.getRevenueOrders() + count);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // 4. Số lượng bán ban đầu của đơn hoàn thành đã thanh toán.
    // Gom tất cả SKU của cùng một sản phẩm, xếp hạng từ cao xuống thấp.
    private void loadProductStatistics(Connection conn, LocalDate start,
            LocalDate endExclusive, SalesReport report) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_name, "
                + "SUM(CAST(oi.quantity AS BIGINT)) AS sold "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.sku_id = oi.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = s.product_id "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND " + SOLD_ORDER
                + "GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name "
                + "ORDER BY sold DESC, p.product_id";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            setDateRange(ps, start, endExclusive);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    int sold = Math.toIntExact(rs.getLong("sold"));
                    report.setProductsSold(Math.addExact(report.getProductsSold(), sold));
                    // Chỉ lấy 5 sản phẩm bán chạy, bỏ qua sản phẩm bán 0.
                    if (sold > 0 && report.getTopProducts().size() < 5) {
                        report.addTopProduct(new Object[]{rs.getString("product_name"), sold});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Tồn kho hiện tại theo SKU; không áp dụng ngày tạo đơn hàng.
    private void loadInventory(Connection conn, SalesReport report) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT s.sku_code, p.product_name, s.stock_quantity, "
                + "s.reserved_quantity, s.stock_quantity - s.reserved_quantity AS available "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = s.product_id "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_name, s.sku_code";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
                ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
            while (rs.next()) {
                report.addInventoryRow(new Object[]{rs.getString("sku_code"),
                    rs.getString("product_name"), rs.getInt("stock_quantity"),
                    rs.getInt("reserved_quantity"), rs.getInt("available")});
            }
        }
    }

    // Thống kê theo phương thức/trạng thái thanh toán của đơn tạo trong kỳ.
    // Giá trị đơn PAID là giá trị đã ghi nhận thanh toán, không phải đối soát hoàn tiền.
    private void loadPayments(Connection conn, LocalDate start,
            LocalDate endExclusive, SalesReport report) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT o.payment_method, o.payment_status, COUNT(*) AS total, "
                + "SUM(o.total_amount) AS order_value "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "GROUP BY o.payment_method, o.payment_status "
                + "ORDER BY o.payment_method, o.payment_status";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            setDateRange(ps, start, endExclusive);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    report.addPaymentRow(new Object[]{rs.getString("payment_method"),
                        rs.getString("payment_status"), rs.getInt("total"),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("order_value")});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void setDateRange(PreparedStatement ps, LocalDate start,
            LocalDate endExclusive) throws SQLException {
        ps.setDate(1, Date.valueOf(start));
        ps.setDate(2, Date.valueOf(endExclusive));
        ps.setQueryTimeout(30);
    }
}

package dao;

import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import db.DBContext;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public class ReturnExchangeDAO {

    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public ReturnExchangeDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public ReturnExchangeDAO(
            CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    private Connection getConnection() throws SQLException {
        Connection conn = connections.open();

        if (conn == null) {
            throw new SQLException(
                    "Không kết nối được database.");
        }

        return conn;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 1. KIỂM TRA ĐIỀU KIỆN TRẢ HÀNG
    // =====================================================

    public boolean canRequest(
            int orderId,
            int userId) throws SQLException {

        String sql =
                "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? "
                + "AND o.user_id = ? "
                + "AND o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL "
                + "AND o.delivered_at >= "
                + "DATEADD(DAY, -7, SYSDATETIME()) "
                + "AND o.delivered_at <= SYSDATETIME() "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ( "
                + "    SELECT 1 FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST r "
                + "    WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "    AND r.user_id = o.user_id "
                + "    AND r.request_status "
                + "    IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') "
                + ") "
                + "AND ( "
                + "    SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "    FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST r "
                + "    WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "    AND r.user_id = o.user_id "
                + "    AND r.request_status = 'REJECTED' "
                + ") < 2";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 2. LẤY SẢN PHẨM TRONG ĐƠN HÀNG
    // =====================================================

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getOrderItems(
            int orderId,
            int userId) throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> items =
                new ArrayList<>();

        String sql =
                "SELECT "
                + "oi.order_item_id, "
                + "oi.sku_id, "
                + "oi.quantity, "
                + "oi.price, "
                + "s.sku_code, "
                + "s.product_id, "
                + "p.product_name "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON o.order_id = oi.order_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "ON s.sku_id = oi.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = s.product_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? "
                + "AND o.user_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY oi.order_item_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    Map<String, Object> item =
                            new LinkedHashMap<>();

                    item.put(
                            "orderItemId",
                            rs.getInt("order_item_id"));

                    item.put(
                            "skuId",
                            rs.getInt("sku_id"));

                    item.put(
                            "quantity",
                            rs.getInt("quantity"));

                    item.put(
                            "price",
                            rs.getBigDecimal("price"));

                    item.put(
                            "skuCode",
                            rs.getString("sku_code"));

                    item.put(
                            "productId",
                            rs.getInt("product_id"));

                    item.put(
                            "productName",
                            rs.getString("product_name"));

                    items.add(item);
                }
            }
        }

        return items;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 3. CUSTOMER TẠO YÊU CẦU TRẢ HÀNG
    // =====================================================

    public int createRequest(
            int orderId,
            int userId,
            String requestType,
            String reason,
            List<Map<String, Integer>> items)
            throws SQLException {

        // Giữ tham số requestType để tương thích Service.
        // Hệ thống chỉ chấp nhận RETURN.

        if (!"RETURN".equals(requestType)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Hệ thống chỉ hỗ trợ trả hàng.");
        }

        if (reason == null || reason.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Vui lòng nhập lý do trả hàng.");
        }

        if (reason.trim().length() > 1000) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Lý do trả hàng không được vượt quá "
                    + "1000 ký tự.");
        }

        if (items == null || items.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một sản phẩm.");
        }

        String orderSql =
                "SELECT order_id "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ? "
                + "AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL "
                + "AND delivered_at >= "
                + "DATEADD(DAY, -7, SYSDATETIME()) "
                + "AND delivered_at <= SYSDATETIME()";

        String requestLimitSql =
                "SELECT "
                + "COUNT(CASE "
                + "WHEN request_status = 'REJECTED' "
                + "THEN 1 END) AS rejected_count, "
                + "COUNT(CASE "
                + "WHEN request_status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED') "
                + "THEN 1 END) AS blocked_count "
                + "FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ?";

        String itemSql =
                "SELECT quantity "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM "
                + "WHERE order_item_id = ? "
                + "AND order_id = ?";

        String usedSql =
                "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ri.quantity), 0) "
                + "FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM ri "
                + "JOIN dbo.RETURN_REQUEST r "
                + "ON r.request_id = ri.request_id "
                + "WHERE ri.order_item_id = ? "
                + "AND r.request_status "
                + "IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')";

        String insertRequestSql =
                "INSERT INTO dbo.RETURN_REQUEST "
                + "(order_id, user_id, reason, request_status) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'PENDING')";

        String insertItemSql =
                "INSERT INTO dbo.RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM "
                + "(request_id, order_item_id, quantity) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

        String historySql =
                "INSERT INTO dbo.RETURN_REQUEST_HISTORY "
                + "(request_id, status, updated_by, note) "
                + "VALUES (?, 'PENDING', ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {

                // Kiểm tra đơn hàng và khóa đơn hàng.
                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(orderSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Đơn hàng không hợp lệ "
                                    + "hoặc đã quá hạn 7 ngày.");
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Kiểm tra yêu cầu Return trước đó.
                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(requestLimitSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (rs.next()) {

                            int rejectedCount =
                                    rs.getInt("rejected_count");

                            int blockedCount =
                                    rs.getInt("blocked_count");

                            if (rejectedCount >= 2) {
                                throw new SQLException(
                                        "Đơn hàng đã bị từ chối "
                                        + "trả hàng 2 lần.");
                            }

                            if (blockedCount > 0) {
                                throw new SQLException(
                                        "Đơn hàng đã có yêu cầu "
                                        + "trả hàng đang chờ xử lý "
                                        + "hoặc đã được duyệt.");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Tạo yêu cầu trả hàng.
                int requestId;

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(
                                insertRequestSql,
                                Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);
                    ps.setString(3, reason.trim());

                    ps.executeUpdate();

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {

                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không tạo được yêu cầu trả hàng.");
                        }

                        requestId = rs.getInt(1);
                    }
                }

                // Tránh gửi trùng một orderItemId
                // trong cùng một yêu cầu.
                Set<Integer> selectedItemIds =
                        new HashSet<>();

                // Lưu danh sách sản phẩm muốn trả.
                for (Map<String, Integer> item : items) {

                    if (item == null
                            || item.get("orderItemId") == null
                            || item.get("quantity") == null) {

                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Thông tin sản phẩm không hợp lệ.");
                    }

                    int orderItemId =
                            item.get("orderItemId");

                    int quantity =
                            item.get("quantity");

                    if (quantity <= 0) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Số lượng trả phải lớn hơn 0.");
                    }

                    if (!selectedItemIds.add(orderItemId)) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Sản phẩm bị chọn trùng "
                                + "trong yêu cầu trả hàng.");
                    }

                    int orderedQuantity;

                    // Kiểm tra sản phẩm thuộc đơn hàng.
                    try (PreparedStatement ps =
                            conn.prepareStatement(itemSql)) {

                        ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);
                        ps.setInt(2, orderId);

                        try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                            if (!rs.next()) {
                                throw new SQLException(
                                        "Sản phẩm không thuộc đơn hàng.");
                            }

                            orderedQuantity =
                                    rs.getInt("quantity");
                        }
                    }

                    if (quantity > orderedQuantity) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Số lượng trả vượt quá "
                                + "số lượng đã mua.");
                    }

                    // Không cho trả vượt số lượng còn hợp lệ.
                    try (PreparedStatement ps =
                            conn.prepareStatement(usedSql)) {

                        ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);

                        try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                            if (rs.next()) {

                                int usedQuantity = rs.getInt(1);

                                if (usedQuantity + quantity
                                        > orderedQuantity) {

                                    throw new SQLException(
                                            "Số lượng đã được yêu cầu "
                                            + "trả trước đó vượt giới hạn.");
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Lưu chi tiết yêu cầu Return.
                    try (PreparedStatement ps =
                            conn.prepareStatement(insertItemSql)) {

                        ps.setInt(1, requestId);
                        ps.setInt(2, orderItemId);
                        ps.setInt(3, quantity);

                        ps.executeUpdate();
                    }
                }

                // Ghi lịch sử tạo yêu cầu.
                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(historySql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, requestId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);
                    ps.setString(
                            3,
                            "Khách hàng gửi yêu cầu trả hàng.");

                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                conn.commit();
                return requestId;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {

                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackEx) {
                    ex.addSuppressed(rollbackEx);
                }

                throw ex;
            }
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 4. STAFF XEM DANH SÁCH YÊU CẦU RETURN
    // =====================================================

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getAllRequests()
            throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> requests =
                new ArrayList<>();

        String sql =
                "SELECT "
                + "r.request_id, "
                + "r.order_id, "
                + "r.user_id, "
                + "u.username, "
                + "COALESCE(NULLIF(o.recipient_phone, ''), "
                + "u.phone) AS phone, "
                + "o.recipient_name, "
                + "o.shipping_address, "
                + "r.reason, "
                + "r.request_status, "
                + "r.created_at, "
                + "r.reviewed_at, "
                + "r.staff_note "
                + "FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST r "
                + "JOIN dbo.[USER] u "
                + "ON u.user_id = r.user_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON o.order_id = r.order_id "
                + "ORDER BY "
                + "CASE WHEN r.request_status = 'PENDING' "
                + "THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "
                + "r.created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(sql);
                ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                Map<String, Object> item =
                        new LinkedHashMap<>();

                item.put(
                        "requestId",
                        rs.getInt("request_id"));

                item.put(
                        "orderId",
                        rs.getInt("order_id"));

                item.put(
                        "userId",
                        rs.getInt("user_id"));

                item.put(
                        "username",
                        rs.getString("username"));

                item.put(
                        "phone",
                        rs.getString("phone"));

                item.put(
                        "recipientName",
                        rs.getString("recipient_name"));

                item.put(
                        "shippingAddress",
                        rs.getString("shipping_address"));

                // Tương thích các JSP cũ.
                // Không cần cột request_type trong DB.
                item.put("requestType", "RETURN");

                item.put(
                        "reason",
                        rs.getString("reason"));

                item.put(
                        "requestStatus",
                        rs.getString("request_status"));

                item.put(
                        "createdAt",
                        rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                item.put(
                        "reviewedAt",
                        rs.getTimestamp("reviewed_at"));

                item.put(
                        "staffNote",
                        rs.getString("staff_note"));

                requests.add(item);
            }
        }

        return requests;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getRequestItems(

                + "ORDER BY ri.request_item_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();

                        conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, requestId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    Map<String, Object> item =
                            new LinkedHashMap<>();

                    item.put(
