    // =====================================================
    // 6. STAFF DUYỆT / TỪ CHỐI YÊU CẦU RETURN
    // =====================================================

    public boolean reviewRequest(
            int requestId,
            int staffId,
            String newStatus,
            String staffNote) throws SQLException {

        if (requestId <= 0 || staffId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Mã yêu cầu hoặc nhân viên không hợp lệ.");
        }

        if (!"APPROVED".equals(newStatus)
                && !"REJECTED".equals(newStatus)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Trạng thái xử lý không hợp lệ.");
        }

        if ("REJECTED".equals(newStatus)
                && (staffNote == null
                || staffNote.trim().isEmpty())) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Vui lòng nhập lý do từ chối.");
        }

        String normalizedNote =
                staffNote == null ? null : staffNote.trim();

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                int customerId;
                int orderId;

                String lockSql =
                        "SELECT user_id, order_id, request_status "
                        + "FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE request_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(lockSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, requestId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }

                        String currentStatus =
                                rs.getString("request_status");

                        if (!"PENDING".equals(currentStatus)) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }

                        customerId = rs.getInt("user_id");
                        orderId = rs.getInt("order_id");
                    }
                }

                // Duyệt hoặc từ chối yêu cầu.
                String updateSql =
                        "UPDATE dbo.RETURN_REQUEST SET "
                        + "request_status = ?, "
                        + "reviewed_by = ?, "
                        + "reviewed_at = SYSDATETIME(), "
                        + "staff_note = ? "
                        + "WHERE request_id = ? "
                        + "AND request_status = 'PENDING'";

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(updateSql)) {

                    ps.setString(1, newStatus);
                    ps.setInt(2, staffId);
                    ps.setString(3, normalizedNote);
                    ps.setInt(4, requestId);

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                // Lưu lịch sử xét duyệt.
                String historySql =
                        "INSERT INTO dbo.RETURN_REQUEST_HISTORY "
                        + "(request_id, status, updated_by, note) "
                        + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(historySql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, requestId);
                    ps.setString(2, newStatus);
                    ps.setInt(3, staffId);
                    ps.setString(4, normalizedNote);

                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                // Thông báo cho khách hàng.
                new NotificationDAO()
                        .createReturnExchangeNotification(
                                conn,
                                customerId,
                                orderId,
                                "RETURN",
                                newStatus
                        );

                // Không tự cộng tồn kho tại đây.
                // Không tự thực hiện hoặc ghi nhận hoàn tiền.

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {

                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackEx) {
                    ex.addSuppressed(rollbackEx);
                }

                throw ex;
            }
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 7. LẤY YÊU CẦU RETURN MỚI NHẤT CỦA ĐƠN HÀNG
    // =====================================================

    public Map<String, Object> getLatestRequestByOrder(
            int orderId,
            int userId) throws SQLException {

        String sql =
                "SELECT TOP 1 "
                + "request_id, "
                + "request_status, "
                + "reason, "
                + "created_at, "
                + "reviewed_at, "
                + "staff_note "
                + "FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC, request_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    Map<String, Object> request =
                            new LinkedHashMap<>();

                    request.put(
                            "requestId",
                            rs.getInt("request_id"));

                    // Tương thích JSP chi tiết đơn hàng cũ.
                    request.put("requestType", "RETURN");

                    request.put(
                            "requestStatus",
                            rs.getString("request_status"));

                    request.put(
                            "reason",
                            rs.getString("reason"));

                    request.put(
                            "createdAt",
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                    request.put(
                            "reviewedAt",
                            rs.getTimestamp("reviewed_at"));

                    request.put(
                            "staffNote",
                            rs.getString("staff_note"));

                    return request;
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }
}
package dao;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class ReturnRefundHelper {
    private ReturnRefundHelper() { }

    private static final class Line {
        int id;
        int quantity;
        BigDecimal gross;
        BigDecimal amount;
    }

    public static void createPendingOnlineRefund(Connection conn, int orderId, int requestId)
            throws SQLException {
        String orderSql = "SELECT payment_method, payment_status, discount_amount, total_amount "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE order_id=?";
        String paymentMethod;
        String paymentStatus;
        BigDecimal discount;
        BigDecimal orderTotal;
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(orderSql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) throw new SQLException("Order not found for return refund.");
                paymentMethod = rs.getString("payment_method");
                paymentStatus = rs.getString("payment_status");
                discount = rs.getBigDecimal("discount_amount");
                orderTotal = rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount");
            }
        }
        if ("COD".equalsIgnoreCase(paymentMethod) || orderTotal.signum() == 0) {
            // No cash-refund transaction model is available in this DB.
            return;
        }
        if (!"PAID".equals(paymentStatus)) {
            throw new SQLException("Chỉ tạo yêu cầu hoàn tiền online cho đơn đã thanh toán.");
        }
        long transactionId;
        BigDecimal paid;
        String paySql = "SELECT TOP 1 transaction_id, amount FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                + "WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE order_id=? AND status='SUCCESS' "
                + "ORDER BY transaction_id DESC";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(paySql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) throw new SQLException("Không tìm thấy giao dịch online đã thu tiền.");
                transactionId = rs.getLong("transaction_id");
                paid = rs.getBigDecimal("amount");
            }
        }
        BigDecimal subtotal = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        String subtotalSql = "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price*quantity),0) FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM WHERE order_id=?";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(subtotalSql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) subtotal = rs.getBigDecimal(1);
            }
        }
        if (subtotal.signum() <= 0) return;
        BigDecimal ratio = subtotal.subtract(discount == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : discount)
                .max(BigDecimal.ZERO).divide(subtotal, 12, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
        List<Line> lines = new ArrayList<>();
        BigDecimal refundTotal = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        String detailSql = "SELECT ri.request_item_id,ri.quantity,oi.price "
                + "FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM ri "
                + "JOIN dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.order_item_id=ri.order_item_id "
                + "WHERE ri.request_id=? AND oi.order_id=? ORDER BY ri.request_item_id";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(detailSql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, requestId);
            ps.setInt(2, orderId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Line line = new Line();
                    line.id = rs.getInt("request_item_id");
                    line.quantity = rs.getInt("quantity");
                    line.gross = rs.getBigDecimal("price").multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(line.quantity));
                    line.amount = line.gross.multiply(ratio).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
                    if (line.amount.signum() > 0) {
                        lines.add(line);
                        refundTotal = refundTotal.add(line.amount);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (refundTotal.signum() == 0) return; // Fully discounted items: no money to refund.
        String bookedSql = "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount),0) FROM dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND "
                + "WHERE transaction_id=? AND refund_status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','SUCCESS')";
        BigDecimal booked = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(bookedSql)) {
            ps.setLong(1, transactionId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) booked = rs.getBigDecimal(1);
            }
        }
        if (refundTotal.compareTo(paid.subtract(booked)) > 0) {
            throw new SQLException("Số tiền yêu cầu hoàn vượt số đã thu chưa được hoàn.");
        }
        long refundId;
        String refundSql = "INSERT INTO dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND "
                + "(transaction_id,refund_amount,refund_type,reason) VALUES (?,?,'RETURN',?)";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(refundSql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {
            ps.setLong(1, transactionId);
            ps.setBigDecimal(2, refundTotal);
            ps.setNString(3, "Hoàn tiền hàng trả theo yêu cầu #" + requestId);
            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) throw new SQLException("Không tạo được yêu cầu hoàn tiền.");
            try (ResultSet keys = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                if (!keys.next()) throw new SQLException("Không đọc được refund ID.");
                refundId = keys.getLong(1);
            }
        }
        String allocationSql = "INSERT INTO dbo.REFUND_ALLOCATION "
                + "(refund_id,request_item_id,quantity,allocated_amount) VALUES (?,?,?,?)";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(allocationSql)) {
            for (Line line : lines) {
                ps.setLong(1, refundId);
                ps.setInt(2, line.id);
                ps.setInt(3, line.quantity);
                ps.setBigDecimal(4, line.amount);
                if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) throw new SQLException("Không tạo được phân bổ hoàn tiền.");
            }
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class ReviewReportDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final int MAX_REPORTS_PER_DAY = 5;

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getAllReports()
            throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> reports = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT rr.report_id, rr.review_id, "
                + "rr.reported_by, reporter.username AS reporter_name, "
                + "rr.reason, rr.report_status, rr.created_at, "
                + "rr.resolved_by, resolver.username AS resolver_name, "
                + "rr.resolved_at, "
                + "author.username AS review_author, "
                + "pr.rating, pr.comment, pr.is_hidden, "
                + "p.product_name, ps.sku_code "
                + "FROM dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS rr "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "ON rr.review_id = pr.review_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.[USER] reporter "
                + "ON rr.reported_by = reporter.user_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.[USER] resolver "
                + "ON rr.resolved_by = resolver.user_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.[USER] author "
                + "ON pr.user_id = author.user_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON pr.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p "
                + "ON ps.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "ORDER BY CASE WHEN rr.report_status = 'PENDING' "
                + "THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, rr.created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                Map<String, Object> report = new HashMap<>();

                report.put("reportId", rs.getInt("report_id"));
                report.put("reviewId", rs.getInt("review_id"));
                report.put("reporterName",
                        rs.getString("reporter_name"));
                report.put("reason", rs.getString("reason"));
                report.put("status", rs.getString("report_status"));
                report.put("createdAt",
                        rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
                report.put("resolverName",
                        rs.getString("resolver_name"));
                report.put("resolvedAt",
                        rs.getTimestamp("resolved_at"));
                report.put("reviewAuthor",
                        rs.getString("review_author"));
                report.put("rating", rs.getInt("rating"));
                report.put("comment", rs.getString("comment"));
                report.put("isHidden", rs.getBoolean("is_hidden"));
                report.put("productName",
                        rs.getString("product_name"));
                report.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));

                reports.add(report);
            }
        }

        return reports;
    }

   
    public String createReport(
            int reviewId,
            int productId,
            int reportedBy,
            String reason) throws SQLException {

        if (reviewId <= 0
                || productId <= 0
                || reportedBy <= 0
                || reason == null
                || reason.trim().isEmpty()
                || reason.trim().length() > 500) {

            return "INVALID";
        }

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {

                
                String lockUserSql
                        = "SELECT user_id "
                        + "FROM dbo.[USER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE user_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(lockUserSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reportedBy);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return "INVALID";
                        }
                    }
                }

                
                String findReview
                        = "SELECT pr.user_id, pr.is_hidden "
                        + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                        + "ON pr.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                        + "WHERE pr.review_id = ? "
                        + "AND ps.product_id = ?";

                Integer ownerId = null;
                boolean isHidden = false;

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(findReview)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
                    ps.setInt(2, productId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (rs.next()) {
                            ownerId = rs.getInt("user_id");
                            isHidden = rs.getBoolean("is_hidden");
                        }
                    }
                }

              
                if (ownerId == null || isHidden) {
                    conn.rollback();
                    return "NOT_FOUND";
                }

                
                if (ownerId == reportedBy) {
                    conn.rollback();
                    return "OWN_REVIEW";
                }

                
                String checkPending
                        = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total "
                        + "FROM dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS "
                        + "WHERE review_id = ? "
                        + "AND reported_by = ? "
                        + "AND report_status = 'PENDING'";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(checkPending)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
                    ps.setInt(2, reportedBy);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (rs.next()
                                && rs.getInt("total") > 0) {

                            conn.rollback();
                            return "DUPLICATE";
                        }
                    }
                }

                
                String countReportsSql
                        = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total "
                        + "FROM dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS "
                        + "WHERE reported_by = ? "
                        + "AND created_at >= "
                        + "DATEADD(HOUR, -24, GETDATE())";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(countReportsSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reportedBy);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (rs.next()) {

                            int totalReports
                                    = rs.getInt("total");

                            if (totalReports
                                    >= MAX_REPORTS_PER_DAY) {

                                conn.rollback();
                                return "RATE_LIMIT";
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                
                String insertSql
                        = "INSERT INTO dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS "
                        + "(review_id, reported_by, reason, "
                        + "report_status, created_at) "
                        + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'PENDING', GETDATE())";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(insertSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
                    ps.setInt(2, reportedBy);
                    ps.setString(3, reason.trim());

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return "FAILED";
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();
                return "SUCCESS";

            } catch (SQLException e) {

                conn.rollback();

                if (e.getErrorCode() == 2601
                        || e.getErrorCode() == 2627) {

                    return "DUPLICATE";
                }

                throw e;

            } catch (RuntimeException e) {

                conn.rollback();
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    
    public boolean resolveReport(
            int reportId,
            int staffId,
            String decision) throws SQLException {

        String newStatus;

        if ("HIDE".equals(decision)) {
            newStatus = "RESOLVED";

        } else if ("DISMISS".equals(decision)) {
            newStatus = "REJECTED";

        } else {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Quyết định không hợp lệ.");
        }

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {

                int reviewId;

                String findReport
                        = "SELECT review_id "
                        + "FROM dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE report_id = ? "
                        + "AND report_status = 'PENDING'";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(findReport)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reportId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }

                        reviewId = rs.getInt("review_id");
                    }
                }

               
                if ("HIDE".equals(decision)) {

                    String hideSql
                            = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                            + "SET is_hidden = 1 "
                            + "WHERE review_id = ?";

                    try (PreparedStatement ps
                            = conn.prepareStatement(hideSql)) {

                        ps.setInt(1, reviewId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() == 0) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                }

               
                String updateReport
                        = "UPDATE dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS "
                        + "SET report_status = ?, "
                        + "resolved_by = ?, "
                        + "resolved_at = GETDATE() "
                        + "WHERE report_id = ? "
                        + "AND report_status = 'PENDING'";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(updateReport)) {

                    ps.setString(1, newStatus);
                    ps.setInt(2, staffId);
                    ps.setInt(3, reportId);

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() == 0) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                conn.rollback();
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }
}

    public Product getProductDetail(int productId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "p.product_id, "
                + "p.product_name, "
                + "p.description, "
                + "p.created_at, "
                + "p.image_url, "
                + "p.model_code, "
                + "c.category_id, "
                + "c.category_name, "
                + "b.brand_id, "
                + "b.brand_name "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c "
                + "ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b "
                + "ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE p.product_id = ? "
                + "AND p.is_active = 1";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    Product product = mapProduct(rs);

                    product.setModelCode(
                            rs.getString("model_code")
                    );

                    return product;
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy chi tiết sản phẩm",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    public List<ProductSku> getProductSkus(
            int productId) {

        List<ProductSku> skus = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "sku_id, "
                + "product_id, "
                + "sku_code, "
                + "price, "
                + "original_price, "
                + "stock_quantity, "
                + "is_active "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY is_active DESC, price ASC, sku_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            Map<Integer, ProductSku> skuMap
                    = new LinkedHashMap<>();

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    ProductSku sku = new ProductSku(
                            rs.getInt("sku_id"),
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("sku_code"),
                            rs.getDouble("price"),
                            rs.getInt("stock_quantity")
                    );

                    BigDecimal originalPrice
                            = rs.getBigDecimal("original_price");

                    if (originalPrice != null) {

                        sku.setOriginalPrice(
                                originalPrice.doubleValue()
                        );
                    }

                    sku.setActive(
                            rs.getBoolean("is_active")
                    );

                    skus.add(sku);

                    skuMap.put(
                            sku.getSkuId(),
                            sku
                    );
                }
            }

            if (!skuMap.isEmpty()) {

                loadSkuAttributeValues(
                        conn,
                        productId,
                        skuMap
                );
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy danh sách SKU",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return skus;
    }

    private void loadSkuAttributeValues(
            Connection conn,
            int productId,
            Map<Integer, ProductSku> skuMap)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "v.sku_id, "
                + "v.attribute_id, "
                + "a.attribute_name, "
                + "v.text_value, "
                + "v.numeric_value, "
                + "v.boolean_value "
                + "FROM SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE v "
                + "INNER JOIN PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "ON v.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "INNER JOIN ATTRIBUTE a "
                + "ON v.attribute_id = a.attribute_id "
                + "WHERE s.product_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY v.sku_id, v.attribute_id";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    int skuId = rs.getInt("sku_id");

                    ProductSku sku = skuMap.get(skuId);

                    if (sku == null) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    SkuAttributeValue value
                            = new SkuAttributeValue();

                    value.setAttributeId(
                            rs.getInt("attribute_id")
                    );

                    value.setAttributeName(
                            rs.getString("attribute_name")
                    );

                    value.setTextValue(
                            rs.getString("text_value")
                    );

                    value.setNumericValue(
                            rs.getBigDecimal("numeric_value")
                    );

                    boolean bit
                            = rs.getBoolean("boolean_value");

                    if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                        value.setBooleanValue(bit);
                    }

                    sku.getAttributeValues().add(value);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public List<ProductSpec> getProductSpecs(
            int productId) {

        List<ProductSpec> specs = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    specs.add(
                            new ProductSpec(
                                    rs.getString("attribute_name"),
                                    rs.getString("value")
                            )
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy thông số kỹ thuật",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return specs;
    }

    public List<ProductImage> getProductImages(

    public Map<Integer, List<ProductImage>>
            getSkuImagesByProduct(int productId) {

        Map<Integer, List<ProductImage>> result
                = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "pi.image_id, "
                + "pi.product_id, "
                + "pi.sku_id, "
                + "pi.image_url, "
                + "pi.is_primary, "
                + "pi.display_order, "
                + "pi.alt_text "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES pi "
                + "INNER JOIN PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "ON pi.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "WHERE pi.product_id = ? "
                + "AND s.product_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY pi.sku_id, "
                + "pi.is_primary DESC, "
                + "pi.display_order ASC, "
                + "pi.image_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);
            ps.setInt(2, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    int skuId = rs.getInt("sku_id");

                    ProductImage image = new ProductImage(
                            rs.getInt("image_id"),
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("image_url")
                    );

                    image.setSkuId(skuId);

                    image.setPrimary(
                            rs.getBoolean("is_primary")
                    );

                    image.setDisplayOrder(
                            rs.getInt("display_order")
                    );

                    image.setAltText(
                            rs.getString("alt_text")
                    );

                    result.computeIfAbsent(
                            skuId,
                            key -> new ArrayList<>()
                    ).add(image);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy ảnh riêng của SKU",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return result;
    }

    private String removeAccents(String text) {

        if (text == null) {
            return "";
        }

        return Normalizer.normalize(
                text,
                Normalizer.Form.NFD
        )
                .replaceAll(
                        "\\p{InCombiningDiacriticalMarks}+",
                        ""
                )
                .replace('đ', 'd')
                .replace('Đ', 'd')
                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
                .replaceAll("[^a-z0-9\\s]", " ")
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
    }

    private String normalizeUserQuery(
            String rawKeyword) {

        String keyword = removeAccents(rawKeyword);

        if (keyword.isEmpty()) {
            return "";
        }

        return keyword
                .replace(
                        "sac dien thoai",
                        "sac"
                )
                .replace(
                        "cap dien thoai",
                        "cap"
                )
                .replace(
                        "balo laptop",
                        "balo"
                )
                .replace(
                        "tui laptop",
                        "balo"
                )
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
    }

    private String getCategorySynonyms(
            String categoryName) {

        switch (categoryName) {

            case "smartphone":
            case "dien thoai":
                return "dien thoai smartphone "
                        + "di dong phone dt";

            case "dong ho thong minh":
                return "dong ho thong minh "
                        + "smartwatch watch";

            case "tai nghe":
                return "tai nghe headphone "
                        + "earphone airpods buds";

            case "sac dien thoai":
                return "sac cu sac adapter "
                        + "charger fast charger";

            case "cap sac":
                return "cap sac day sac "
                        + "day cap cable";

            case "laptop van phong":
                return "laptop may tinh "
                        + "xach tay van phong";

            case "laptop gaming":
                return "laptop may tinh "
                        + "xach tay gaming";

            case "balo laptop":
                return "balo tui chong soc backpack";

            case "chuot":
                return "chuot mouse";

            case "ban phim":
                return "ban phim keyboard";

            case "may anh":
            case "may anh mirrorless":
            case "may anh compact":
                return categoryName
                        + " may anh camera mirrorless compact";

            default:
                return categoryName;
        }
    }

    private int calculateMatchScore(
            Product product,
            String normalizedQuery) {

        if (normalizedQuery == null
                || normalizedQuery.isEmpty()) {

            return 0;
        }

        String[] queryWords
                = normalizedQuery.split(" ");

        String categoryName
                = product.getCategory() != null
                ? removeAccents(
                        product.getCategory().getCategoryName()
                )
                : "";

        String brandName
                = product.getBrand() != null
                ? removeAccents(
                        product.getBrand().getBrandName()
                )
                : "";

        String productName
                = removeAccents(
                        product.getProductName()
                );

        String cleanName
                = "balo laptop".equals(categoryName)
                ? productName
                        .replace("laptop", "")
                        .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                        .trim()
                : productName;

        String searchableText
                = (cleanName + " "
                        + getCategorySynonyms(categoryName)
                        + " "
                        + brandName).trim();

        String[] searchableTokens
                = searchableText.split(" ");

        String[] nameTokens
                = cleanName.split(" ");

        int score = 0;

        for (String word : queryWords) {

            boolean matched = false;

            for (String token : searchableTokens) {

                if (token.equals(word)) {

                    score += 30;
                    matched = true;
                    break;

                } else if (token.startsWith(word)) {

                    score += 20;
                    matched = true;
                    break;

                } else if (word.length() >= 3
                        && token.contains(word)) {

                    score += 10;
                    matched = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (!matched) {
                return 0;
            }

            for (String token : nameTokens) {

                if (token.startsWith(word)
                        || (word.length() >= 3
                        && token.contains(word))) {

                    score += 25;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (cleanName.contains(normalizedQuery)) {
            score += 50;
        }

        if (!"sac dien thoai".equals(categoryName)
                && !"cap sac".equals(categoryName)
                && !"balo laptop".equals(categoryName)) {

            score += 15;
        }

        return score;
    }

    public List<Product> searchProducts(
            String keyword) {

        if (keyword == null
                || keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return new ArrayList<>();
        }

        List<Product> matched
                = getFilteredCatalog(
                        keyword,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        if (matched.size() <= 5) {
            return matched;
        }

        return new ArrayList<>(
                matched.subList(0, 5)
        );
    }

    public List<Product> getFilteredCatalog(
            String keyword,
            String[] categoryIds,
            String priceRange,
            String minRating,
            String sort) {

        List<Product> products = new ArrayList<>();

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "SELECT "
                + "p.product_id, "
                + "p.product_name, "
                + "p.description, "
                + "p.created_at, "
                + "p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, "
                + "c.category_name, "
                + "b.brand_id, "
                + "b.brand_name, "
                + "ISNULL(mp.min_price, 0) AS min_price, "
                + "ISNULL(rv.avg_rating, 0) AS avg_rating, "
                + "ISNULL(rv.review_count, 0) AS review_count "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c "
                + "ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b "
                + "ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN ( "
                + "    SELECT product_id, "
                + "           MIN(price) AS min_price "
                + "    FROM PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "    WHERE is_active = 1 "
                + "    GROUP BY product_id "
                + ") mp "
                + "ON p.product_id = mp.product_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN ( "
                + "    SELECT s.product_id, "
                + "           AVG(CAST(r.rating AS FLOAT)) "
                + "               AS avg_rating, "
                + "           COUNT(r.review_id) "
                + "               AS review_count "
                + "    FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS r "
                + "    INNER JOIN PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "    ON r.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "    WHERE r.is_hidden = 0 "
                + "    GROUP BY s.product_id "
                + ") rv "
                + "ON p.product_id = rv.product_id "
                + "WHERE p.is_active = 1 "
        );

        List<Integer> parameters = new ArrayList<>();

        List<Integer> validCategoryIds
                = new ArrayList<>();

        if (categoryIds != null) {

            for (String rawId : categoryIds) {

                try {

                    int id
                            = Integer.parseInt(
                                    rawId.trim()
                            );

                    if (id > 0
                            && !validCategoryIds.contains(id)) {

                        validCategoryIds.add(id);
                    }

                } catch (NumberFormatException
                        | NullPointerException ex) {

                }
            }
        }

        if (!validCategoryIds.isEmpty()) {

            StringBuilder placeholders
                    = new StringBuilder();

            for (int i = 0;
                    i < validCategoryIds.size(); i++) {

                if (i > 0) {
                    placeholders.append(", ");
                }

                placeholders.append("?");
            }

            sql.append(
                    "AND (c.category_id IN ("
            ).append(
                    placeholders
            ).append(
                    ") OR c.parent_id IN ("
            ).append(
                    placeholders
            ).append(
                    ")) "
            );

            parameters.addAll(validCategoryIds);
            parameters.addAll(validCategoryIds);
        }

        if ("under5".equals(priceRange)) {

            sql.append(
                    "AND mp.min_price > 0 "
                    + "AND mp.min_price < 5000000 "
            );

        } else if ("5to15".equals(priceRange)) {

            sql.append(
                    "AND mp.min_price BETWEEN "
                    + "5000000 AND 15000000 "
            );

        } else if ("over15".equals(priceRange)) {

            sql.append(
                    "AND mp.min_price > 15000000 "
            );
        }

        if (minRating != null
                && !minRating.trim().isEmpty()) {

            try {

                int rating
                        = Integer.parseInt(
                                minRating.trim()
                        );

                if (rating >= 1 && rating <= 5) {

                    sql.append(
                            "AND rv.review_count > 0 "
                            + "AND FLOOR(rv.avg_rating) = ? "
                    );

                    parameters.add(rating);
                }

            } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {

                // Bỏ qua rating không hợp lệ.
            }
        }

        if ("priceAsc".equals(sort)) {

            sql.append(
                    "ORDER BY "
                    + "CASE WHEN mp.min_price IS NULL "
                    + "THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, "
                    + "mp.min_price ASC, "
                    + "p.product_id DESC"
            );

        } else if ("priceDesc".equals(sort)) {

            sql.append(
                    "ORDER BY "
                    + "CASE WHEN mp.min_price IS NULL "
                    + "THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, "
                    + "mp.min_price DESC, "
                    + "p.product_id DESC"
            );

        } else if ("ratingDesc".equals(sort)) {

            sql.append(
                    "ORDER BY "
                    + "ISNULL(rv.avg_rating, 0) DESC, "
                    + "ISNULL(rv.review_count, 0) DESC, "
                    + "p.product_id DESC"
            );

        } else {

            sql.append(
                    "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC"
            );
        }

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(
                        sql.toString()
                )) {

            for (int i = 0;
                    i < parameters.size(); i++) {

                ps.setInt(
                        i + 1,
                        parameters.get(i)
                );
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    Product product = mapProduct(rs);

                    product.setMinPrice(
                            rs.getDouble("min_price")
                    );

                    product.setAverageRating(
                            rs.getDouble("avg_rating")
                    );

                    product.setReviewCount(
                            rs.getInt("review_count")
                    );

                    products.add(product);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lọc catalog",
                    ex
            );
        }

        if (keyword != null
                && !keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {

            String normalizedQuery
                    = normalizeUserQuery(keyword);

            if (!normalizedQuery.isEmpty()) {

                Map<Product, Integer> scores
                        = new HashMap<>();

                products.removeIf(product -> {

                    int score
                            = calculateMatchScore(
                                    product,
                                    normalizedQuery
                            );

                    if (score <= 0) {
                        return true;
                    }

                    scores.put(product, score);

                    return false;
                });

                if (!"priceAsc".equals(sort)
                        && !"priceDesc".equals(sort)
                        && !"ratingDesc".equals(sort)) {

                    products.sort(
                            (first, second)
                            -> Integer.compare(
                                    scores.get(second),
                                    scores.get(first)
                            )
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        return products;
    }

    public List<Product> getRelatedProducts(
            int productId,
            int categoryId) {

        List<Product> relatedProducts
                = new ArrayList<>();

        if (productId <= 0 || categoryId <= 0) {
            return relatedProducts;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT TOP (8) "
                + "p.product_id, "
                + "p.product_name, "
                + "p.description, "
                + "p.created_at, "
                + "p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, "
                + "c.category_name, "
                + "b.brand_id, "
                + "b.brand_name, "
                + "s.min_price "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c "
                + "ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b "
                + "ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "INNER JOIN ( "
                + "    SELECT "
                + "        product_id, "
                + "        COALESCE( "
                + "            MIN( "
                + "                CASE "
                + "                    WHEN stock_quantity > 0 "
                + "                    THEN price "
                + "                END "
                + "            ), "
                + "            MIN(price) "
                + "        ) AS min_price, "
                + "        SUM(stock_quantity) AS total_stock "
                + "    FROM PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "    WHERE is_active = 1 "
                + "    GROUP BY product_id "
                + ") s "
                + "ON p.product_id = s.product_id "
                + "WHERE p.category_id = ? "
                + "AND p.product_id <> ? "
                + "AND p.is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY "
                + "CASE "
                + "    WHEN s.total_stock > 0 "
                + "    THEN 0 "
                + "    ELSE 1 "
                + "END, "
                + "p.created_at DESC, "
                + "p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);
            ps.setInt(2, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    Product product = mapProduct(rs);

                    product.setMinPrice(
                            rs.getDouble("min_price")
                    );

                    relatedProducts.add(product);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy sản phẩm tương tự, productId="
                    + productId
                    + ", categoryId="
                    + categoryId,
                    ex
            );
        }

        return relatedProducts;
    }

    private Product mapProduct(ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        Category category = new Category(
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getString("category_name"),
                null
        );

        Brand brand = new Brand(
                rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                rs.getString("brand_name"),
                null
        );

        Product product = new Product(
                rs.getInt("product_id"),
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                rs.getString("product_name"),
                rs.getString("description"),
                rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                category,
                brand
        );

        product.setImageUrl(
                rs.getString("image_url")
        );

        return product;
    }

    public Map<String, List<ProductSpec>> getProductSpecGroups(
            int productId) {

        Map<String, List<ProductSpec>> groups
                = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ca.group_name)), ''), "
                + "N'Thông số khác') AS group_name, "
                + "a.attribute_name, "
                + "ps.value "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = ps.product_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.ATTRIBUTE a "
                + "ON a.attribute_id = ps.attribute_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE ca "
                + "ON ca.category_id = p.category_id "
                + "AND ca.attribute_id = ps.attribute_id "
                + "WHERE ps.product_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY "
                + "COALESCE(ca.group_name, N'Thông số khác'), "
                + "COALESCE(ca.display_order, 9999), "
                + "a.attribute_name";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    String groupName
                            = rs.getString("group_name");

                    ProductSpec spec = new ProductSpec(
                            rs.getString("attribute_name"),
                            rs.getString("value")
                    );

                    groups.computeIfAbsent(
                            groupName,
                            k -> new ArrayList<>()
                    ).add(spec);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Không thể tải nhóm thông số sản phẩm",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return groups;
    }

}
package dao;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;

public final class SkuAdminInventoryAudit {

    private SkuAdminInventoryAudit() {
    }

    public static int lockCurrentStock(Connection conn, int productId, int skuId)
            throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT stock_quantity FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? AND sku_id = ?";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, productId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new SQLException("SKU không tồn tại hoặc không thuộc sản phẩm.");
                }
                int qty = rs.getInt(1);
                if (rs.wasNull()) {
                    throw new SQLException("Tồn kho SKU không được NULL.");
                }
                return qty;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void recordOpening(Connection conn, int skuId, int quantity)
            throws SQLException {
        if (quantity < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Tồn kho khởi tạo không được âm.");
        }
        insert(conn, skuId, "OPENING", 0, quantity, "Khởi tạo SKU qua Admin");
    }

    public static void recordAdminCorrection(Connection conn, int skuId,
            int before, int after) throws SQLException {
        if (before == after) {
            return;
        }
        insert(conn, skuId, "SET", before, after, "Điều chỉnh tồn kho từ quản lý SKU");
    }

    private static void insert(Connection conn, int skuId, String type,
            int before, int after, String note) throws SQLException {
        if (conn == null || skuId <= 0 || before < 0 || after < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Thông tin biến động kho không hợp lệ.");
        }
        long delta = (long) after - (long) before;
        if (delta < Integer.MIN_VALUE || delta > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Biến động tồn kho vượt giới hạn SQL.");
        }
        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.INVENTORY_MOVEMENT "
                + "(sku_id, movement_type, quantity_delta, quantity_before, "
                + "quantity_after, note, actor_user_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL)";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, skuId);
            ps.setString(2, type);
            ps.setInt(3, (int) delta);
            ps.setInt(4, before);
            ps.setInt(5, after);
            ps.setNString(6, note);
            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new SQLException("Không ghi được lịch sử tồn kho SKU.");
            }
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;

public class SkuHardDeleteDAO extends DBContext {

    public String deletePermanently(
            int productId,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            conn.setTransactionIsolation(
                    Connection.TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE
            );

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {

                String skuCode = null;

                String sqlSku
                        = "SELECT sku_code "
                        + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                        + "AND product_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(sqlSku)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, skuId);
                    ps.setInt(2, productId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (rs.next()) {
                            skuCode = rs.getString("sku_code");
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (skuCode == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy SKU thuộc sản phẩm này."
                    );
                }

                if (exists(
                        conn,
                        "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?",
                        skuId)) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không thể xóa SKU đã phát sinh "
                            + "đơn hàng. Hãy dùng Ngừng bán."
                    );
                }

                if (exists(
                        conn,
                        "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?",
                        skuId)) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không thể xóa SKU đã có đánh giá."
                    );
                }

                if (exists(
                        conn,
                        "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.CART_ITEMS "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?",
                        skuId)) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "SKU đang nằm trong giỏ hàng. "
                            + "Cần xử lý giỏ hàng trước khi xóa."
                    );
                }

                if (exists(
                        conn,
                        "SELECT 1 "
                        + "FROM dbo.INVENTORY_MOVEMENT "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                        + "AND movement_type <> 'OPENING'",
                        skuId)) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "SKU đã phát sinh lịch sử "
                            + "nhập/xuất hoặc thay đổi tồn kho. "
                            + "Không thể xóa vĩnh viễn."
                    );
                }

                executeDelete(
                        conn,
                        "DELETE FROM dbo.PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                        + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                        + "AND sku_id = ?",
                        productId,
                        skuId
                );

                executeDeleteBySku(
                        conn,
                        "DELETE FROM dbo.SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?",
                        skuId
                );

                executeDeleteBySku(
                        conn,
                        "DELETE FROM dbo.INVENTORY_MOVEMENT "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                        + "AND movement_type = 'OPENING'",
                        skuId
                );

                int deleted = executeDelete(
                        conn,
                        "DELETE FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                        + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                        + "AND sku_id = ?",
                        productId,
                        skuId
                );

                if (deleted != 1) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Không thể xóa SKU khỏi PRODUCT_SKU."
                    );
                }

                conn.commit();

                return skuCode;

            } catch (SQLException ex) {

                conn.rollback();

                if (ex.getErrorCode() == 547) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "SKU vẫn được dữ liệu khác tham chiếu. "
                            + "Không thể xóa vĩnh viễn.",
                            ex
                    );
                }

                throw ex;

            } catch (RuntimeException ex) {

                conn.rollback();
                throw ex;
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean exists(
            Connection conn,
            String sql,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        }
    }

    private int executeDelete(
            Connection conn,
            String sql,
            int productId,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    private int executeDeleteBySku(
            Connection conn,
            String sql,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            return ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.SQLException;

public final class SkuVariantKeyHelper {

    private SkuVariantKeyHelper() {
    }

    public static void refresh(Connection conn, int skuId) throws SQLException {
        if (conn == null || skuId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Connection hoặc SKU ID không hợp lệ.");
        }

        final String sql
                = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU SET variant_key = ("
                + " SELECT HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', STRING_AGG("
                + " CAST(CONCAT(sav.attribute_id, N'=',"
                + " CASE WHEN sav.text_value IS NOT NULL"
                + " THEN N'T:' + UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(sav.text_value)))"
                + " WHEN sav.numeric_value IS NOT NULL"
                + " THEN N'N:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(60), sav.numeric_value)"
                + " ELSE N'B:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1), sav.boolean_value) END"
                + " ) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), N'|')"
                + " WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sav.attribute_id))"
                + " FROM dbo.SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE sav WHERE sav.sku_id = ?"
                + ") WHERE sku_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, skuId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);
            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new SQLException("Không cập nhật được variant_key cho SKU ID " + skuId);
            }
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class StaffReviewDAO extends DBContext {

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getAllReviewsForStaff()
            throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> reviews = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT pr.review_id, pr.user_id, "
                + "u.username AS reviewer_name, "
                + "pr.order_item_id, pr.sku_id, "
                + "ps.sku_code, p.product_name, "
                + "pr.rating, pr.comment, pr.created_at, "
                + "pr.is_hidden "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "LEFT JOIN [USER] u ON pr.user_id = u.user_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps ON pr.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p ON ps.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC";

        Map<Integer, Map<String, Object>> byId = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> review = new HashMap<>();

                    review.put("reviewId", rs.getInt("review_id"));
                    review.put("userId", rs.getInt("user_id"));
                    review.put("reviewerName", rs.getString("reviewer_name"));
                    review.put("orderItemId", rs.getInt("order_item_id"));
                    review.put("skuId", rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                    review.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    review.put("productName", rs.getString("product_name"));
                    review.put("rating", rs.getInt("rating"));
                    review.put("comment", rs.getString("comment"));
                    review.put("createdAt", rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
                    review.put("isHidden", rs.getBoolean("is_hidden"));

                    review.put("images", new ArrayList<String>());
                    reviews.add(review);
                    byId.put(rs.getInt("review_id"), review);
                }
            }

            String imageSql
                    = "SELECT review_id, image_url "
                    + "FROM dbo.REVIEW_IMAGES "
                    + "ORDER BY review_id, image_id";

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(imageSql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> review
                            = byId.get(rs.getInt("review_id"));

                    if (review != null) {
                        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                        List<String> images
                                = (List<String>) review.get("images");

                        images.add(rs.getString("image_url"));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return reviews;
    }

    public boolean setReviewHidden(int reviewId, boolean hidden)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql = "UPDATE PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "SET is_hidden = ? "
                + "WHERE review_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, hidden);
            ps.setInt(2, reviewId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;

    public User login(String account, String rawPassword) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.email, "
                + "u.is_active, u.role_id, r.role_name "
                + "FROM [USER] u "
                + "JOIN ROLES r ON u.role_id = r.role_id "
                + "WHERE (u.username = ? OR u.email = ?) "
                + "AND u.password_hash = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setString(1, account);
            statement.setString(2, account);
            statement.setString(3, hashMd5(rawPassword));

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    User user = new User();
                    user.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
                    user.setUsername(rs.getString("username"));
                    user.setEmail(rs.getString("email"));
                    user.setActive(rs.getBoolean("is_active"));
                    user.setRoleId(rs.getInt("role_id"));
                    user.setRoleName(rs.getString("role_name"));
                    return user;
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi đăng nhập!", ex);
        }

        return null;
    }

    public List<User> getAllUsers(
            String keyword,
            Integer roleId,
            String status,
            String sort) {

        List<User> userList = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Object> params = new ArrayList<>();

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder();

        sql.append(
                "SELECT "
                + "u.user_id, "
                + "u.username, "
                + "u.email, "
                + "u.phone, "
                + "u.is_active, "
                + "u.created_at, "
                + "u.role_id, "
                + "r.role_name "
                + "FROM [USER] u "
                + "JOIN ROLES r ON u.role_id = r.role_id "
                + "WHERE 1 = 1 "
        );

        if (keyword != null && !keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {

            sql.append(
                    "AND ("
                    + "u.username LIKE ? "
                    + "OR u.email LIKE ? "
                    + "OR u.phone LIKE ?"
                    + ") "
            );

            String searchKeyword = "%" + keyword.trim() + "%";

            params.add(searchKeyword);
            params.add(searchKeyword);
            params.add(searchKeyword);
        }

        if (roleId != null) {

            sql.append("AND u.role_id = ? ");

            params.add(roleId);
        }

        if ("active".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {

            sql.append("AND u.is_active = 1 ");

        } else if ("locked".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {

            sql.append("AND u.is_active = 0 ");
        }

        if (sort == null || sort.trim().isEmpty()) {
            sort = "newest";
        }

        switch (sort) {

            case "oldest":
                sql.append("ORDER BY u.created_at ASC ");
                break;

            case "username_asc":
                sql.append("ORDER BY u.username ASC ");
                break;

            case "username_desc":
                sql.append("ORDER BY u.username DESC ");
                break;

            case "newest":
            default:
                sql.append("ORDER BY u.created_at DESC ");
                break;
        }

        try (Connection connection = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            for (int i = 0; i < params.size(); i++) {
                statement.setObject(i + 1, params.get(i));
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    User user = new User();

                    user.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
                    user.setUsername(rs.getString("username"));
                    user.setEmail(rs.getString("email"));
                    user.setPhone(rs.getString("phone"));
                    user.setActive(rs.getBoolean("is_active"));
                    user.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
                    user.setRoleId(rs.getInt("role_id"));
                    user.setRoleName(rs.getString("role_name"));

                    userList.add(user);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi lấy danh sách User!", e);
        }

        return userList;
    }

    public User getUserById(int userId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.email, "

                + "FROM [USER] u "
                + "JOIN ROLES r ON u.role_id = r.role_id "
                + "WHERE u.user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return new User(
                            rs.getInt("user_id"),

                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),

                            rs.getString("role_name"),
                            rs.getBoolean("is_active")
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy user theo ID!", ex);
        }

        return null;
    }
