                            categoryId
                    );

            if (configs.isEmpty()) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Danh mục chưa cấu hình "
                        + "thuộc tính biến thể."
                );
            }

            List<VariantDimension> dimensions
                    = prepareDimensions(
                            configs,
                            options
                    );

            List<Map<Integer, NormalizedValue>> combinations
                    = new ArrayList<>();

            generateCombinations(
                    dimensions,
                    0,
                    new HashMap<>(),
                    combinations
            );

            Set<String> existingKeys
                    = loadExistingVariantKeys(
                            conn,
                            productId,
                            dimensions
                    );

            Set<String> usedSkuCodes
                    = loadUsedSkuCodes(conn);

            List<ProductSku> preview
                    = new ArrayList<>();

            String prefix = skuPrefix.trim();

            int nextSequence = 1;

            for (Map<Integer, NormalizedValue> combination
                    : combinations) {

                String combinationKey
                        = buildCombinationKey(
                                combination
                        );

                if (existingKeys.contains(combinationKey)) {
                    continue;
                }

                String skuCode;

                do {

                    skuCode
                            = buildSkuCode(
                                    prefix,
                                    nextSequence++
                            );

                } while (usedSkuCodes.contains(
                        skuCode.toUpperCase(
                                java.util.Locale.ROOT
                        )
                ));

                usedSkuCodes.add(
                        skuCode.toUpperCase(
                                java.util.Locale.ROOT
                        )
                );

                ProductSku sku = new ProductSku(
                        0,
                        productId,
                        skuCode,
                        price,
                        stock
                );

                sku.setOriginalPrice(originalPrice);
                sku.setActive(active);

                List<Integer> attributeIds
                        = new ArrayList<>(
                                combination.keySet()
                        );

                Collections.sort(attributeIds);

                for (Integer attributeId : attributeIds) {

                    NormalizedValue value
                            = combination.get(attributeId);

                    SkuAttributeValue attributeValue
                            = new SkuAttributeValue();

                    attributeValue.setAttributeId(
                            attributeId
                    );

                    attributeValue.setTextValue(
                            value.textValue
                    );

                    attributeValue.setNumericValue(
                            value.numericValue
                    );

                    attributeValue.setBooleanValue(
                            value.booleanValue
                    );

                    sku.getAttributeValues().add(
                            attributeValue
                    );
                }

                preview.add(sku);

                existingKeys.add(combinationKey);
            }

            return preview;
        }
    }

    private void validateBasicInput(
            int productId,
            Map<Integer, List<String>> options,
            String skuPrefix,
            double price,
            Double originalPrice,
            int stock) {

        if (productId <= 0) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Product ID không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        if (options == null || options.isEmpty()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Chưa chọn thuộc tính để tạo SKU."
            );
        }

        if (skuPrefix == null
                || skuPrefix.trim().isEmpty()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Tiền tố mã SKU không được để trống."
            );
        }

        if (skuPrefix.trim().length() > 95) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Tiền tố SKU quá dài."
            );
        }

        validateMoney(price, "Giá bán");

        if (originalPrice != null) {

            validateMoney(
                    originalPrice,
                    "Giá niêm yết"
            );
        }

        if (stock < 0) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Tồn kho không được âm."
            );
        }
    }

    private void validateMoney(
            double amount,
            String fieldName) {

        if (!Double.isFinite(amount)
                || amount < 0) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    fieldName + " không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        BigDecimal decimal
                = BigDecimal.valueOf(amount);

        try {

            decimal = decimal.setScale(
                    0,
                    RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY
            );

        } catch (ArithmeticException ex) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    fieldName
                    + " phải là số VNĐ nguyên."
            );
        }

        if (decimal.precision() > 16) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    fieldName + " vượt giới hạn SQL."
            );
        }
    }

    private int getProductCategoryId(
            Connection conn,
            int productId)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT category_id, is_active "
                + "FROM PRODUCT "
                + "WHERE product_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (!rs.next()) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy sản phẩm."
                    );
                }

                if (!rs.getBoolean("is_active")) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Sản phẩm đã ngừng kinh doanh. "
                            + "Không thể tạo SKU hàng loạt."
                    );
                }

                return rs.getInt("category_id");
            }
        }
    }

    private List<VariantConfig> loadVariantConfigs(
            Connection conn,
            int categoryId)
            throws SQLException {

        List<VariantConfig> configs
                = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT ca.attribute_id, "
                + "ca.is_required, "
                + "a.attribute_name, "
                + "a.data_type "
                + "FROM CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE ca "
                + "JOIN ATTRIBUTE a "
                + "ON a.attribute_id = ca.attribute_id "
                + "WHERE ca.category_id = ? "
                + "AND ca.attribute_type IN "
                + "('VARIANT', 'BOTH') "
                + "AND a.is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY ca.display_order, "
                + "ca.attribute_id";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    configs.add(
                            new VariantConfig(
                                    rs.getInt("attribute_id"),
                                    rs.getString("attribute_name"),
                                    rs.getString("data_type"),
                                    rs.getBoolean("is_required")
                            )
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        return configs;
    }

    private List<VariantDimension> prepareDimensions(
            List<VariantConfig> configs,
            Map<Integer, List<String>> options) {

        Map<Integer, VariantConfig> allowed
                = new HashMap<>();

        for (VariantConfig config : configs) {

            allowed.put(
                    config.attributeId,
                    config
            );
        }

        for (Integer attributeId : options.keySet()) {

            if (attributeId == null
                    || !allowed.containsKey(attributeId)) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Thuộc tính biến thể "
                        + "không thuộc danh mục: "
                        + attributeId
                );
            }
        }

        List<VariantDimension> dimensions
                = new ArrayList<>();

        long combinationCount = 1;

        for (VariantConfig config : configs) {

            List<String> rawValues
                    = options.get(config.attributeId);

            if (rawValues == null
                    || rawValues.isEmpty()) {

                if (config.required) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Thiếu thuộc tính bắt buộc: "
                            + config.attributeName
                    );
                }

                continue;
            }

            List<NormalizedValue> normalized
                    = new ArrayList<>();

            Set<String> uniqueValues
                    = new HashSet<>();

            for (String rawValue : rawValues) {

                NormalizedValue value
                        = normalizeValue(
                                config,
                                rawValue
                        );

                if (uniqueValues.add(
                        value.canonicalValue
                )) {

                    normalized.add(value);
                }
            }

            if (normalized.isEmpty()) {

                if (config.required) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Thuộc tính không có giá trị: "
                            + config.attributeName
                    );
                }

                continue;
            }

            if (combinationCount
                    > MAX_COMBINATIONS / normalized.size()) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Số tổ hợp vượt giới hạn "
                        + MAX_COMBINATIONS + " SKU/lần."
                );
            }

            combinationCount *= normalized.size();

            dimensions.add(
                    new VariantDimension(
                            config.attributeId,
                            normalized
                    )
            );
        }

        if (dimensions.isEmpty()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Không có giá trị biến thể hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        return dimensions;
    }

    private NormalizedValue normalizeValue(
            VariantConfig config,
            String rawValue) {

        if (rawValue == null
                || rawValue.trim().isEmpty()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Giá trị biến thể không được trống: "
                    + config.attributeName
            );
        }

        String value = rawValue.trim();

        if ("TEXT".equals(config.dataType)) {

            if (value.length() > MAX_ATTRIBUTE_LENGTH) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Giá trị vượt 255 ký tự: "
                        + config.attributeName
                );
            }

            return new NormalizedValue(
                    value,
                    null,
                    null,
                    "T:" + value
            );
        }

        if ("NUMBER".equals(config.dataType)) {

            BigDecimal number;

            try {

                number = new BigDecimal(value)
                        .setScale(
                                4,
                                RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY
                        );

            } catch (NumberFormatException
                    | ArithmeticException ex) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Giá trị NUMBER không hợp lệ: "
                        + config.attributeName,
                        ex
                );
            }

            if (number.precision() > 18) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Giá trị vượt DECIMAL(18,4): "
                        + config.attributeName
                );
            }

            return new NormalizedValue(
                    null,
                    number,
                    null,
                    "N:" + number.stripTrailingZeros()
                            .toPlainString()
            );
        }

        if ("BOOLEAN".equals(config.dataType)) {

            boolean booleanValue;

            if ("true".equalsIgnoreCase(value)
                    || "1".equals(value)
                    || "Có".equalsIgnoreCase(value)) {

                booleanValue = true;

            } else if ("false".equalsIgnoreCase(value)
                    || "0".equals(value)
                    || "Không".equalsIgnoreCase(value)) {

                booleanValue = false;

            } else {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Giá trị BOOLEAN không hợp lệ: "
                        + config.attributeName
                );
            }

            return new NormalizedValue(
                    null,
                    null,
                    booleanValue,
                    booleanValue ? "B:1" : "B:0"
            );
        }

        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Kiểu thuộc tính không hợp lệ: "
                + config.attributeName
        );
    }

    private void generateCombinations(
            List<VariantDimension> dimensions,
            int index,
            Map<Integer, NormalizedValue> current,
            List<Map<Integer, NormalizedValue>> results) {

        if (index == dimensions.size()) {

            results.add(
                    new HashMap<>(current)
            );

            return;
        }

        VariantDimension dimension
                = dimensions.get(index);

        for (NormalizedValue value : dimension.values) {

            current.put(
                    dimension.attributeId,
                    value
            );

            generateCombinations(
                    dimensions,
                    index + 1,
                    current,
                    results
            );
        }

        current.remove(dimension.attributeId);
    }

    private Set<String> loadExistingVariantKeys(
            Connection conn,
            int productId,
            List<VariantDimension> dimensions)
            throws SQLException {

        Map<Integer, Map<Integer, NormalizedValue>> bySku
                = new HashMap<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT s.sku_id, "
                + "v.attribute_id, "
                + "v.text_value, "
                + "v.numeric_value, "
                + "v.boolean_value "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SKU s "
                + "LEFT JOIN SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE v "
                + "ON v.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "WHERE s.product_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY s.sku_id, v.attribute_id";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    int skuId = rs.getInt("sku_id");

                    Map<Integer, NormalizedValue> attributes
                            = bySku.computeIfAbsent(
                                    skuId,
                                    key -> new HashMap<>()
                            );

                    int attributeId
                            = rs.getInt("attribute_id");

                    if (rs.wasNull()) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    String textValue
                            = rs.getString("text_value");

                    BigDecimal numericValue
                            = rs.getBigDecimal("numeric_value");

                    Boolean booleanValue = null;

                    boolean bit
                            = rs.getBoolean("boolean_value");

                    if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                        booleanValue = bit;
                    }

                    String canonical;

                    if (textValue != null) {

                        canonical = "T:" + textValue.trim();

                    } else if (numericValue != null) {

                        canonical
                                = "N:" + numericValue
                                        .stripTrailingZeros()
                                        .toPlainString();

                    } else if (booleanValue != null) {

                        canonical
                                = booleanValue ? "B:1" : "B:0";

                    } else {
                        continue;
                    }

                    attributes.put(
                            attributeId,
                            new NormalizedValue(
                                    textValue,
                                    numericValue,
                                    booleanValue,
                                    canonical
                            )
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        Set<Integer> selectedAttributeIds
                = new HashSet<>();

        for (VariantDimension dimension : dimensions) {

            selectedAttributeIds.add(
                    dimension.attributeId
            );
        }

        Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>();

        for (Map<Integer, NormalizedValue> attributes
                : bySku.values()) {

            if (!attributes.keySet().equals(
                    selectedAttributeIds
            )) {
                continue;
            }

            keys.add(
                    buildCombinationKey(attributes)
            );
        }

        return keys;
    }

    private String buildCombinationKey(
            Map<Integer, NormalizedValue> attributes) {

        List<Integer> ids
                = new ArrayList<>(attributes.keySet());

        Collections.sort(ids);

        StringBuilder key = new StringBuilder();

        for (Integer attributeId : ids) {

            String value
                    = attributes.get(attributeId).canonicalValue;

            key.append(attributeId)
                    .append(':')
                    .append(value.length())
                    .append(':')
                    .append(value)
                    .append(';');
        }

        return key.toString();
    }

    private Set<String> loadUsedSkuCodes(
            Connection conn)
            throws SQLException {

        Set<String> codes = new HashSet<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT sku_code FROM PRODUCT_SKU";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                String code = rs.getString("sku_code");

                if (code != null) {

                    codes.add(
                            code.toUpperCase(
                                    java.util.Locale.ROOT
                            )
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        return codes;
    }

    private String buildSkuCode(
            String prefix,
            int sequence) {

        String code = prefix
                + "-"
                + String.format(
                        java.util.Locale.ROOT,
                        "%03d",
                        sequence
                );

        if (code.length() > MAX_SKU_CODE_LENGTH) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Mã SKU sinh ra vượt quá "
                    + MAX_SKU_CODE_LENGTH + " ký tự."
            );
        }

        return code;
    }

    private static class VariantConfig {

        private final int attributeId;
        private final String attributeName;
        private final String dataType;
        private final boolean required;

        private VariantConfig(
                int attributeId,
                String attributeName,
                String dataType,
                boolean required) {

            this.attributeId = attributeId;
            this.attributeName = attributeName;
            this.dataType = dataType;
            this.required = required;
        }
    }

    private static class VariantDimension {

        private final int attributeId;
        private final List<NormalizedValue> values;

        private VariantDimension(
                int attributeId,
                List<NormalizedValue> values) {

            this.attributeId = attributeId;
            this.values = values;
        }
    }

    private static class NormalizedValue {

        private final String textValue;
        private final BigDecimal numericValue;
        private final Boolean booleanValue;
        private final String canonicalValue;

        private NormalizedValue(
                String textValue,
                BigDecimal numericValue,
                Boolean booleanValue,
                String canonicalValue) {

            this.textValue = textValue;
            this.numericValue = numericValue;
            this.booleanValue = booleanValue;
            this.canonicalValue = canonicalValue;
        }
    }
}
package service;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;

import db.DBContext;
import model.ProductImage;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class SkuImageService extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(SkuImageService.class.getName());

    public List<ProductImage> getImagesBySkuId(
            int productId,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        validateIds(productId, skuId);

        List<ProductImage> images = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT image_id, product_id, sku_id, "
                + "image_url, is_primary, display_order, "
                + "alt_text, created_at "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? AND sku_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY is_primary DESC, "
                + "display_order ASC, image_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    ProductImage image = new ProductImage(
                            rs.getInt("image_id"),
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("image_url")
                    );

                    image.setSkuId(rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                    image.setPrimary(
                            rs.getBoolean("is_primary")
                    );
                    image.setDisplayOrder(
                            rs.getInt("display_order")
                    );
                    image.setAltText(
                            rs.getString("alt_text")
                    );
                    image.setCreatedAt(
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at")
                    );

                    images.add(image);
                }
            }
        }

        return images;
    }

    public Map<Integer, List<ProductImage>> getImagesByProductId(
            int productId) throws SQLException {

        if (productId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Product ID khong hop le."
            );
        }

        Map<Integer, List<ProductImage>> imagesBySkuId
                = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "image_id, "
                + "product_id, "
                + "sku_id, "
                + "image_url, "
                + "is_primary, "
                + "display_order, "
                + "alt_text, "
                + "created_at "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id IS NOT NULL "
                + "ORDER BY sku_id, "
                + "is_primary DESC, "
                + "display_order ASC, "
                + "image_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    int skuId = rs.getInt("sku_id");

                    ProductImage image = new ProductImage(
                            rs.getInt("image_id"),
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("image_url")
                    );

                    image.setSkuId(skuId);
                    image.setPrimary(
                            rs.getBoolean("is_primary")
                    );
                    image.setDisplayOrder(
                            rs.getInt("display_order")
                    );
                    image.setAltText(
                            rs.getString("alt_text")
                    );
                    image.setCreatedAt(
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at")
                    );

                    imagesBySkuId.computeIfAbsent(
                            skuId,
                            key -> new ArrayList<>()
                    ).add(image);
                }
            }
        }

        return imagesBySkuId;
    }

    public int addImages(
            int productId,
            int skuId,
            List<String> imageUrls) throws SQLException {

        validateIds(productId, skuId);
        validateImageUrls(imageUrls);

        if (imageUrls == null || imageUrls.isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            boolean oldAutoCommit = conn.getAutoCommit();

            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                lockSku(conn, productId, skuId);

                int nextOrder = getNextDisplayOrder(
                        conn, productId, skuId
                );

                if ((long) nextOrder + imageUrls.size() - 1
                        > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Thứ tự ảnh vượt giới hạn."
                    );
                }

                String sql
                        = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                        + "(product_id, sku_id, image_url, "
                        + "is_primary, display_order) "
                        + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, 0, ?)";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    for (String url : imageUrls) {

                        ps.setInt(1, productId);
                        ps.setInt(2, skuId);
                        ps.setString(3, url.trim());
                        ps.setInt(4, nextOrder++);

                        ps.addBatch();
                    }

                    ps.executeBatch();
                }

                ensurePrimaryImage(conn, productId, skuId);

                conn.commit();

                return imageUrls.size();

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {

                rollback(conn, ex);
                throw ex;

            } finally {
                restoreAutoCommit(conn, oldAutoCommit);
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean setPrimaryImage(
            int productId,
            int skuId,
            int imageId) throws SQLException {

        validateIds(productId, skuId);
        validateImageId(imageId);

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            boolean oldAutoCommit = conn.getAutoCommit();

            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                lockSku(conn, productId, skuId);

                if (!imageExists(
                        conn, productId, skuId, imageId)) {

                    conn.rollback();
                    return false;
                }

                String clearSql
                        = "UPDATE PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                        + "SET is_primary = 0 "
                        + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                        + "AND sku_id = ? "
                        + "AND is_primary = 1";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(clearSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, productId);
                    ps.setInt(2, skuId);
                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                String setSql
                        = "UPDATE PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                        + "SET is_primary = 1 "
                        + "WHERE image_id = ? "
                        + "AND product_id = ? "
                        + "AND sku_id = ?";

                int updated;

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(setSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, imageId);
                    ps.setInt(2, productId);
                    ps.setInt(3, skuId);

                    updated = ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                if (updated != 1) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Không thể đặt ảnh chính cho SKU."
                    );
                }

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {

                rollback(conn, ex);
                throw ex;

            } finally {
                restoreAutoCommit(conn, oldAutoCommit);
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean reorderImages(
            int productId,
            int skuId,
            List<Integer> orderedImageIds)
            throws SQLException {

        validateIds(productId, skuId);

        if (orderedImageIds == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Danh sách ảnh không được null."
            );
        }

        Set<Integer> submitted = new HashSet<>();

        for (Integer id : orderedImageIds) {

            if (id == null || id <= 0
                    || !submitted.add(id)) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Danh sách ảnh chứa ID không hợp lệ "
                        + "hoặc bị trùng."
                );
            }
        }

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            boolean oldAutoCommit = conn.getAutoCommit();

            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                lockSku(conn, productId, skuId);

                Set<Integer> existing
                        = getImageIds(conn, productId, skuId);

                if (!existing.equals(submitted)) {

                    conn.rollback();
                    return false;
                }

                String sql
                        = "UPDATE PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                        + "SET display_order = ? "
                        + "WHERE image_id = ? "
                        + "AND product_id = ? "
                        + "AND sku_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    for (int i = 0;
                            i < orderedImageIds.size(); i++) {

                        ps.setInt(1, i);
                        ps.setInt(2, orderedImageIds.get(i));
                        ps.setInt(3, productId);
                        ps.setInt(4, skuId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không thể sắp xếp ảnh SKU."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {

                rollback(conn, ex);
                throw ex;

            } finally {
                restoreAutoCommit(conn, oldAutoCommit);
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean deleteImage(
            int productId,
            int skuId,
            int imageId) throws SQLException {

        validateIds(productId, skuId);
        validateImageId(imageId);

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            boolean oldAutoCommit = conn.getAutoCommit();

            try {
                conn.setAutoCommit(false);

                lockSku(conn, productId, skuId);

                String sql
                        = "DELETE FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                        + "WHERE image_id = ? "
                        + "AND product_id = ? "
                        + "AND sku_id = ?";

                int affected;

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, imageId);
                    ps.setInt(2, productId);
                    ps.setInt(3, skuId);

                    affected = ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                if (affected != 1) {

                    conn.rollback();
                    return false;
                }

                ensurePrimaryImage(conn, productId, skuId);

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {

                rollback(conn, ex);
                throw ex;

            } finally {
                restoreAutoCommit(conn, oldAutoCommit);
            }
        }
    }

    private void lockSku(
            Connection conn,
            int productId,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SKU WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ? AND product_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);
            ps.setInt(2, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "SKU không tồn tại hoặc "
                            + "không thuộc sản phẩm."
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean imageExists(
            Connection conn,
            int productId,
            int skuId,
            int imageId) throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE image_id = ? "
                + "AND product_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, imageId);
            ps.setInt(2, productId);
            ps.setInt(3, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        }
    }

    private Set<Integer> getImageIds(
            Connection conn,
            int productId,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        Set<Integer> ids = new HashSet<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT image_id FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? AND sku_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {
                    ids.add(rs.getInt("image_id"));
                }
            }
        }

        return ids;
    }

    private int getNextDisplayOrder(
            Connection conn,
            int productId,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT MAX(display_order) AS max_order "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    int maxOrder = rs.getInt("max_order");

                    if (rs.wasNull()) {
                        return 0;
                    }

                    if (maxOrder == Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Đã đạt giới hạn thứ tự ảnh."
                        );
                    }

                    return maxOrder + 1;
                }
            }
        }

        return 0;
    }

    private void ensurePrimaryImage(
            Connection conn,
            int productId,
            int skuId) throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT TOP (1) image_id, is_primary "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE product_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY is_primary DESC, "
                + "display_order ASC, image_id ASC";

        Integer selectedId = null;
        boolean hasPrimary = false;

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    selectedId = rs.getInt("image_id");

                    hasPrimary
                            = rs.getBoolean("is_primary");
                }
            }
        }

        if (selectedId == null || hasPrimary) {
            return;
        }

        String updateSql
                = "UPDATE PRODUCT_IMAGES "
                + "SET is_primary = 1 "
                + "WHERE image_id = ? "
                + "AND product_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(updateSql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, selectedId);
            ps.setInt(2, productId);
            ps.setInt(3, skuId);

            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Không thể thiết lập ảnh chính SKU."
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private void validateIds(int productId, int skuId) {

        if (productId <= 0 || skuId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Product ID hoặc SKU ID không hợp lệ."
            );
        }
    }

    private void validateImageId(int imageId) {

        if (imageId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Image ID không hợp lệ."
            );
        }
    }

    private void validateImageUrls(
            List<String> imageUrls) {

        if (imageUrls == null) {
            return;
        }

        for (String url : imageUrls) {

            if (url == null
                    || url.trim().isEmpty()
                    || url.length() > 2048) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Đường dẫn ảnh SKU không hợp lệ."
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private void rollback(
            Connection conn,
            Exception originalException) {

        try {
            conn.rollback();

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            originalException.addSuppressed(ex);

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Rollback SkuImageService thất bại",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }

    private void restoreAutoCommit(
            Connection conn,
            boolean oldAutoCommit) {

        try {
            conn.setAutoCommit(oldAutoCommit);

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "Không khôi phục được autoCommit",
                    ex
            );
        }
    }
}

CREATE TABLE ROLES (
    role_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    role_name NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description NVARCHAR(MAX)
);

CREATE TABLE [USER] (
    user_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    phone VARCHAR(20),
    role_id INT NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT SYSDATETIME(),
    is_active BIT NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_USER_IsActive DEFAULT (1),
    failed_login_attempts INT NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_USER_FailedLogin DEFAULT (0),
    locked_until DATETIME2 NULL,
    deleted_at DATETIME2 NULL,

    CONSTRAINT FK_USER_ROLES
        FOREIGN KEY (role_id)
        REFERENCES ROLES(role_id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_USER_FailedLogin CHECK (failed_login_attempts >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_USER_Email CHECK (email LIKE '%_@_%._%')
);

CREATE TABLE ADDRESSBOOK (
    address_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    recipient_name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    phone_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    address_line NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL,
    is_default BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT (0),
    is_deleted BIT NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_ADDRESSBOOK_is_deleted DEFAULT (0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_AddressBook_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT UQ_AddressBook_Id_User UNIQUE (address_id, user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE CATEGORY (
    category_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    category_name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    parent_id INT NULL,
    description NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
    is_active BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_CATEGORY_IsActive DEFAULT (1),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Category_Parent FOREIGN KEY (parent_id)
        REFERENCES CATEGORY(category_id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Category_NotSelfParent
        CHECK (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> category_id)
);

CREATE TABLE BRAND (
    brand_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    brand_name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    logo_url VARCHAR(2048),
    is_active BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_BRAND_IsActive DEFAULT (1)
);

CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (

    category_id INT NOT NULL,
    brand_id INT NOT NULL,
    product_name NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT SYSDATETIME(),
    image_url VARCHAR(2048) NULL,
    model_code VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    is_active BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_PRODUCT_IsActive DEFAULT (1),
    updated_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Product_Category FOREIGN KEY (category_id)
        REFERENCES CATEGORY(category_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Product_Brand FOREIGN KEY (brand_id)
        REFERENCES BRAND(brand_id)
);

        PRIMARY KEY (product_id, attribute_id),

        REFERENCES PRODUCT(product_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

        REFERENCES ATTRIBUTE(attribute_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CREATE TABLE PRODUCT_SKU (
    sku_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id INT NOT NULL,
    sku_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    price DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL,
    stock_quantity INT DEFAULT (0),
    reserved_quantity INT NOT NULL
    CONSTRAINT DF_SKU_Reserved DEFAULT (0),
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT SYSDATETIME(),
    original_price DECIMAL(18,2) NULL,
    is_active BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_SKU_IsActive DEFAULT (1),
    variant_key VARBINARY(32) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT CK_SKU_Price CHECK (price >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_SKU_OriginalPrice CHECK (original_price IS NULL OR original_price >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_SKU_Stock CHECK (stock_quantity IS NULL OR stock_quantity >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_SKU_Reserved CHECK (
        reserved_quantity >= 0
        AND reserved_quantity <= stock_quantity
    ),
    CONSTRAINT CK_OECS_Inventory_StockValid CHECK (stock_quantity IS NOT NULL AND stock_quantity >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_SKU_IdProduct UNIQUE (sku_id, product_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_SKU_Product FOREIGN KEY (product_id)
        REFERENCES PRODUCT(product_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE PRODUCT_IMAGES (
    image_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id INT NOT NULL,
    image_url VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT SYSDATETIME(),
    sku_id INT NULL,
    is_primary BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_PI_Primary DEFAULT (0),
    display_order INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_PI_Order DEFAULT (0),
    alt_text NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT CK_PI_DisplayOrder CHECK (display_order >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_PI_SKU_Product FOREIGN KEY (sku_id, product_id) REFERENCES dbo.PRODUCT_SKU(sku_id, product_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_ProductImages_Product FOREIGN KEY (product_id) 
        REFERENCES PRODUCT(product_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

    cart_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT SYSDATETIME(),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Cart_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE CART_ITEMS (
    cart_item_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    cart_id INT NOT NULL,
    sku_id INT NOT NULL,
    quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT (1),

    CONSTRAINT FK_CartItems_Cart
        FOREIGN KEY (cart_id)
        REFERENCES CART(cart_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT FK_CartItems_SKU
        FOREIGN KEY (sku_id)
        REFERENCES PRODUCT_SKU(sku_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT UQ_CartItems_Cart_SKU
        UNIQUE (cart_id, sku_id),

    CONSTRAINT CK_CartItems_Quantity
        CHECK (quantity > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE VOUCHER (
    voucher_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    min_order_value DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_Voucher_MinOrder DEFAULT (0),
    valid_from DATETIME2 NOT NULL,
    valid_to DATETIME2 NOT NULL,
    discount_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    discount_value DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL,
    max_discount DECIMAL(18,2) NULL,
    usage_limit INT NULL,
    per_user_limit INT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_DiscountType
        CHECK (discount_type IN ('AMOUNT', 'PERCENT')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_DiscountValue
        CHECK (discount_value > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_MinOrder
        CHECK (min_order_value >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_ValidDate
        CHECK (valid_to > valid_from),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_MaxDiscount
        CHECK (max_discount IS NULL OR max_discount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_UsageLimit
        CHECK (usage_limit IS NULL OR usage_limit > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_PerUserLimit
        CHECK (per_user_limit IS NULL OR per_user_limit > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_PerUserVsTotal
        CHECK (
            usage_limit IS NULL
            OR per_user_limit IS NULL
            OR per_user_limit <= usage_limit
        ),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_MaxDiscountType
        CHECK (discount_type = 'PERCENT' OR max_discount IS NULL)
);

CREATE TABLE [ORDER] (
    order_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    address_id INT NOT NULL,
    total_amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL,
    shipping_fee DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT (0),
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSDATETIME(),
    order_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION',
    payment_method VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    payment_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNPAID',
    payment_expires_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    recipient_name NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    recipient_phone VARCHAR(20) NULL,
    shipping_address NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
    discount_amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT (0),
    stock_restored_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    checkout_token VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    delivered_at DATETIME2 NULL,

    cancellation_source VARCHAR(20) NULL,
    cancelled_at DATETIME2 NULL,

    cancel_request_status VARCHAR(20) NULL,
    cancel_request_reason NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
    cancel_requested_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    cancel_reviewed_by INT NULL,
    cancel_reviewed_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    cancel_review_note NVARCHAR(500) NULL,

    CONSTRAINT FK_Order_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id),

    CONSTRAINT FK_Order_Address FOREIGN KEY (address_id)
        REFERENCES ADDRESSBOOK(address_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Order_AddressOwner FOREIGN KEY (address_id, user_id)
        REFERENCES ADDRESSBOOK(address_id, user_id),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_Order_Id_User UNIQUE (order_id, user_id),

    CONSTRAINT FK_Order_CancelReviewer FOREIGN KEY (cancel_reviewed_by)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Order_CancelRequest CHECK (
        (cancel_request_status IS NULL
         AND cancel_request_reason IS NULL AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL
         AND cancel_reviewed_by IS NULL AND cancel_reviewed_at IS NULL
         AND cancel_review_note IS NULL)
        OR (
            cancel_request_status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED')
            AND (cancel_request_status <> 'PENDING' OR order_status IN ('CONFIRMED','PACKING'))
            AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(cancel_request_reason)), N'') IS NOT NULL
            AND cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL
            AND (
                (cancel_request_status = 'PENDING'
                 AND cancel_reviewed_by IS NULL AND cancel_reviewed_at IS NULL
                 AND cancel_review_note IS NULL)
                OR (cancel_request_status IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED')
                    AND cancel_reviewed_by IS NOT NULL AND cancel_reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)
            )
            AND (cancel_request_status <> 'REJECTED'
                 OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(cancel_review_note)), N'') IS NOT NULL)
        )
    ),

    CONSTRAINT CK_Order_CancellationSource
        CHECK (
            cancellation_source IS NULL
            OR cancellation_source IN ('CUSTOMER', 'STAFF', 'SYSTEM')
        ),

    CONSTRAINT CK_Order_Amounts
        CHECK (total_amount >= 0 AND shipping_fee >= 0 AND discount_amount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Order_Status CHECK (order_status IN
        ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION','PENDING_PAYMENT','CONFIRMED','PACKING','SHIPPING',
         'COMPLETED','CANCELLED','EXPIRED','RETURNED')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Order_PaymentMethod CHECK (payment_method IN
        ('COD','VNPAY','MOMO')),
    
    CONSTRAINT CK_Order_PaymentStatus
        CHECK (
            payment_status IN (
                'UNPAID',
                'PENDING',
                'PAID',
                'FAILED',
                'CANCELLED',
                'EXPIRED'
            )
        )
    );

CREATE INDEX IX_Order_CustomerCancellationPolicy
ON dbo.[ORDER] (
    user_id,
    cancellation_source,
    cancelled_at
)
INCLUDE (order_id);

CREATE TABLE ORDER_ITEM (

    sku_id INT NOT NULL,

    quantity INT NOT NULL,
    product_name_snapshot NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    sku_code_snapshot VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_OrderItem_Order FOREIGN KEY (order_id)
        REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_OrderItem_SKU FOREIGN KEY (sku_id)
        REFERENCES PRODUCT_SKU(sku_id),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_OrderItem_Id_SKU UNIQUE (order_item_id, sku_id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_OrderItem_Quantity CHECK (quantity > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_OrderItem_Price CHECK (price >= 0)
);

CREATE TABLE ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY (
    status_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    status NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    updated_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT SYSDATETIME(),
    old_status NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
    actor_type VARCHAR(20) NULL,
    changed_by INT NULL,
    reason NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_StatusHistory_Order FOREIGN KEY (order_id)
        REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_StatusHistory_User FOREIGN KEY (changed_by)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_StatusHistory_Actor
        CHECK (actor_type IS NULL OR actor_type IN ('CUSTOMER', 'STAFF', 'SYSTEM')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_StatusHistory_Status CHECK (status IN
        ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION','PENDING_PAYMENT','CONFIRMED','PACKING','SHIPPING',
         'COMPLETED','CANCELLED','EXPIRED','RETURNED')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_StatusHistory_OldStatus CHECK (old_status IS NULL OR old_status IN
        ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION','PENDING_PAYMENT','CONFIRMED','PACKING','SHIPPING',
         'COMPLETED','CANCELLED','EXPIRED','RETURNED')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_OECS_CancelHistory_RequiredFields
    CHECK (
        status <> N'CANCELLED'
        OR (
            actor_type IN ('CUSTOMER', 'STAFF', 'SYSTEM')
            AND reason IS NOT NULL
            AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(reason))) > 0
            AND updated_at IS NOT NULL
            AND (
                (actor_type IN ('CUSTOMER', 'STAFF') AND changed_by IS NOT NULL)
                OR actor_type = 'SYSTEM'
            )
        )
    )

);

        REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id),

        REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_VoucherUsage_OrderOwner FOREIGN KEY (order_id, user_id)
        REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id, user_id)
);

    notification_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

        CONSTRAINT DF_Notification_CreatedAt DEFAULT (SYSDATETIME()),

    CONSTRAINT FK_Notification_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Notification_Order FOREIGN KEY (order_id)
        REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

    ON NOTIFICATION(user_id, is_read)
    WHERE is_read = 0;

CREATE TABLE REVIEW_REPORTS (
    report_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    review_id INT NOT NULL,
    reported_by INT NOT NULL,
    reason NVARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    report_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_REVIEW_REPORTS_status DEFAULT ('PENDING'),
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_REVIEW_REPORTS_created_at DEFAULT (SYSDATETIME()),
    resolved_by INT NULL,
    resolved_at DATETIME2 NULL,

    CONSTRAINT CK_REVIEW_REPORTS_status
        CHECK (report_status IN ('PENDING', 'RESOLVED', 'REJECTED')),
    CONSTRAINT FK_REVIEW_REPORTS_review FOREIGN KEY (review_id)
        REFERENCES PRODUCT_REVIEWS(review_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_REVIEW_REPORTS_reporter FOREIGN KEY (reported_by)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_REVIEW_REPORTS_resolver FOREIGN KEY (resolved_by)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IX_REVIEW_REPORTS_status_created
    ON REVIEW_REPORTS(report_status, created_at DESC);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_REVIEW_REPORTS_one_pending_per_user
    ON REVIEW_REPORTS(review_id, reported_by)
    WHERE report_status = 'PENDING';

CREATE TABLE PAYMENT_TRANSACTION (
    transaction_id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1)
        CONSTRAINT PK_PAYMENT_TRANSACTION PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    payment_method VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL,
    transaction_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    provider_transaction_id VARCHAR(150) NULL,
    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_PaymentTransaction_Status DEFAULT ('PENDING'),
    provider_response_code VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_PaymentTransaction_Created DEFAULT (SYSDATETIME()),
    completed_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    pay_url NVARCHAR(2048) NULL,

    CONSTRAINT FK_PaymentTransaction_Order FOREIGN KEY (order_id)
        REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_PaymentTransaction_Code UNIQUE (transaction_code),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentTransaction_Method
        CHECK (payment_method IN ('VNPAY', 'MOMO')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentTransaction_Amount CHECK (amount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentTransaction_Status
        CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED'))
);

CREATE TABLE ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY (
    user_id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    violation_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT (0),
    blocked_until DATETIME2 NULL,
    CONSTRAINT CK_OrderCustomerPolicy_Count CHECK (violation_count BETWEEN 0 AND 3)
);



CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Payment_Provider_Success
    ON PAYMENT_TRANSACTION(payment_method, provider_transaction_id)
    WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND provider_transaction_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IX_PaymentTransaction_Order
    ON PAYMENT_TRANSACTION(order_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IX_Order_Expiry
    ON [ORDER](order_status, payment_expires_at);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Order_CheckoutToken
    ON [ORDER](checkout_token)
    WHERE checkout_token IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_AddressBook_OneDefault
    ON ADDRESSBOOK(user_id)
    WHERE is_default = 1 AND is_deleted = 0;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PRODUCT_REVIEWS_order_item
    ON PRODUCT_REVIEWS(order_item_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_VoucherUsages_Voucher_Order
    ON VOUCHER_USAGES(voucher_id, order_id);

CREATE INDEX IX_VoucherUsages_Voucher_User
    ON VOUCHER_USAGES(voucher_id, user_id);

CREATE INDEX IX_Order_User_CreatedAt
    ON [ORDER](user_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IX_OrderItem_Order
    ON ORDER_ITEM(order_id);

CREATE INDEX IX_OrderItem_SKU
    ON ORDER_ITEM(sku_id);

CREATE INDEX IX_OrderStatusHistory_Order
    ON ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY(order_id, updated_at);


CREATE TABLE PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN (
    reset_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    expires_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL,
    used_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT SYSDATETIME(),
    CONSTRAINT FK_PasswordReset_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE AUDIT_LOG (
    log_id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    actor_user_id INT NULL,
    actor_identifier VARCHAR(150) NULL,
    action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    entity_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    entity_id BIGINT NULL,
    description NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
    ip_address VARCHAR(45) NULL,
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_AuditLog_CreatedAt DEFAULT (SYSDATETIME()),

    CONSTRAINT FK_AuditLog_Actor FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

CREATE TABLE BANNER (
    banner_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    image_url NVARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL,
    alt_text NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    target_url NVARCHAR(2048) NULL,
    is_active BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT (1),
    display_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT (0),
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT (SYSDATETIME())
);

CREATE TABLE RETURN_REQUEST (
    request_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    reason NVARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
    request_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT ('PENDING'),
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT (SYSDATETIME()),
    reviewed_by INT NULL,
    reviewed_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    staff_note NVARCHAR(1000) NULL,

    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_ORDER_OWNER
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id, user_id)
    REFERENCES dbo.[ORDER](order_id, user_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_REVIEWER FOREIGN KEY (reviewed_by)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_RETURN_REQUEST_STATUS
        CHECK (request_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_RETURN_REQUEST_REASON CHECK (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(reason))) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_RETURN_REQUEST_REVIEW_PAIR CHECK
       ((request_status = 'PENDING' AND reviewed_by IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL)
        OR (request_status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') AND reviewed_by IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CONSTRAINT CK_RETURN_REQUEST_REJECT_REASON CHECK
       (request_status <> 'REJECTED' OR LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(staff_note, N'')))) > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM (
    request_item_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    request_id INT NOT NULL,
    order_item_id INT NOT NULL,
    quantity INT NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM_REQUEST FOREIGN KEY (request_id)
        REFERENCES RETURN_REQUEST(request_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM_ORDER_ITEM FOREIGN KEY (order_item_id)
        REFERENCES ORDER_ITEM(order_item_id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM_QUANTITY CHECK (quantity > 0),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM UNIQUE(request_id, order_item_id),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM_ID_REQUEST UNIQUE(request_item_id, request_id)
);


CREATE TABLE RETURN_REQUEST_HISTORY (
    history_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    request_id INT NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    updated_by INT NULL,
    note NVARCHAR(1000) NULL,
    updated_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT (SYSDATETIME()),

    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_HISTORY_REQUEST FOREIGN KEY (request_id)
        REFERENCES RETURN_REQUEST(request_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_HISTORY_USER FOREIGN KEY (updated_by)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE dbo.CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE (
        category_id INT NOT NULL,
        attribute_id INT NOT NULL,

        group_name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_CA_Group
            DEFAULT (N'ThÃ´ng sá»‘ khÃ¡c'),

        attribute_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_CA_Type
            DEFAULT ('SPECIFICATION'),

        is_required BIT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_CA_Required DEFAULT (0),

        is_filterable BIT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_CA_Filterable DEFAULT (0),

        display_order INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_CA_Order DEFAULT (0),

        CONSTRAINT PK_CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE
            PRIMARY KEY (category_id, attribute_id),

        CONSTRAINT FK_CA_Category
            FOREIGN KEY (category_id)
            REFERENCES dbo.CATEGORY(category_id),

        CONSTRAINT FK_CA_Attribute
            FOREIGN KEY (attribute_id)
            REFERENCES dbo.ATTRIBUTE(attribute_id),

        CONSTRAINT CK_CA_Type
            CHECK (
                attribute_type IN (
                    'SPECIFICATION',
                    'VARIANT',
                    'BOTH'
                )
            ),

        CONSTRAINT CK_CA_Order
            CHECK (display_order >= 0)
    );


CREATE TABLE dbo.SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE (
        sku_id INT NOT NULL,
        attribute_id INT NOT NULL,

        text_value NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
        numeric_value DECIMAL(18,4) NULL,
        boolean_value BIT NULL,

        CONSTRAINT PK_SKU_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE
            PRIMARY KEY (sku_id, attribute_id),

        CONSTRAINT FK_SAV_SKU
            FOREIGN KEY (sku_id)
            REFERENCES dbo.PRODUCT_SKU(sku_id)
            ON DELETE CASCADE,

        CONSTRAINT FK_SAV_Attribute
            FOREIGN KEY (attribute_id)
            REFERENCES dbo.ATTRIBUTE(attribute_id),

        CONSTRAINT CK_SAV_OneValue
            CHECK (
                (CASE WHEN text_value IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
              + (CASE WHEN numeric_value IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
              + (CASE WHEN boolean_value IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                = 1
            ),

        CONSTRAINT CK_SAV_NonEmpty
            CHECK (
                text_value IS NULL
                OR LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(text_value))) > 0
            )
    );


CREATE TABLE dbo.INVENTORY_MOVEMENT (
        movement_id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT PK_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT PRIMARY KEY,
        sku_id INT NOT NULL,
        movement_type VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
        quantity_delta INT NOT NULL,
        quantity_before INT NOT NULL,
        quantity_after INT NOT NULL,
        note NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
        actor_user_id INT NULL,
        created_at DATETIME2(3) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_created_at DEFAULT SYSDATETIME(),
        CONSTRAINT FK_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_SKU FOREIGN KEY (sku_id)
            REFERENCES dbo.PRODUCT_SKU(sku_id),
        CONSTRAINT FK_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_USER FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id)
            REFERENCES dbo.[USER](user_id),
        CONSTRAINT CK_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_type CHECK
            (movement_type IN ('OPENING', 'IN', 'OUT', 'SET', 'SYSTEM')),
        CONSTRAINT CK_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_balances CHECK
            (quantity_before >= 0 AND quantity_after >= 0
             AND quantity_delta = quantity_after - quantity_before)
    );




CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PI_PrimaryProduct
    ON dbo.PRODUCT_IMAGES(product_id) WHERE sku_id IS NULL AND is_primary = 1;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PI_PrimarySKU
    ON dbo.PRODUCT_IMAGES(sku_id) WHERE sku_id IS NOT NULL AND is_primary = 1;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_SKU_ProductVariant
    ON dbo.PRODUCT_SKU(product_id,variant_key) WHERE variant_key IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IX_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_sku_time
    ON dbo.INVENTORY_MOVEMENT(sku_id, movement_id DESC);
